descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

A Sulzer Ellon, farai parte di uno dei nostri principali centri di assistenza UK e di un centro riconosciuto di eccellenza per i servizi di attrezzature rotanti. Con oltre 100 professionisti qualificati in loco, offriamo soluzioni di riparazione, manutenzione e aggiornamento di livello mondiale per attrezzature critiche nei settori dell'energia, della produzione di energia e dell'industria.

Specializzato in pompe, turbine, compressori e altri macchinari rotanti, il nostro team collabora con alcuni dei principali operatori del mondo per massimizzare l'affidabilità, migliorare le prestazioni e prolungare la durata dell'attrezzatura. Sia che supporti grandi progetti di turnaround, revisioni complesse o programmi di aggiornamento innovativi, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella fornitura di soluzioni ingegneristiche che mantengono le industrie critiche in esecuzione in modo sicuro ed efficiente. Le vostre principali responsabilità:

• In qualità di Customer Support Engineer, sarai il collegamento vitale tra i nostri clienti e il nostro team operativo.

• Potrai gestire i progetti da ordine alla consegna, assicurando tempi, qualità e obiettivi commerciali sono soddisfatti.

• Rapporti con i propri clienti – tenerli informati, anticipare le esigenze e fornire un servizio eccezionale.

• Coordinate i progetti complessi – limare con i team tecnici, di qualità e di produzione per mantenere tutto in pista.

• Guidare il miglioramento continuo – abbracciare i principi magre e aiutarci a rimanere avanti in sicurezza, qualità ed efficienza.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Forte conoscenza tecnica di macchine e sistemi rotanti.

• Ottima comunicazione e capacità organizzative.

• La consapevolezza commerciale e l'esperienza in un ruolo simile.

• Idealmente, un HNC o equivalente in ingegneria.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Uno stipendio base competitivo

• Programma di bonus a livello aziendale

• 33 giorni di congedo annuale.

• Contributi pensionistici definiti.

• L'accesso a Medicash ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.

• Sostegno confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.

• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping più l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.

• Auto personale a noleggio per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.

• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.

• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• In qualità di titolare del premio d'argento del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e volontari adulti Cadet con politiche di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre a una crescente rete militare interna.

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Ellon, you'll be part of one of our flagship UK service centres and a recognised centre of excellence for rotating equipment services. With more than 100 skilled professionals on site, we deliver world-class repair, maintenance and upgrade solutions for critical equipment across the energy, power generation and industrial sectors.

Specialising in pumps, turbines, compressors and other rotating machinery, our team works alongside some of the world's leading operators to maximise reliability, improve performance and extend equipment life. Whether supporting major turnaround projects, complex overhauls or innovative upgrade programmes, you'll play a key role in delivering engineering solutions that keep critical industries running safely and efficiently. Your main responsibilities:

• As a Customer Support Engineer, you’ll be the vital link between our clients and our operations team.

• You’ll manage projects from order to delivery, ensuring timelines, quality, and commercial targets are met.

• Own client relationships – keep them informed, anticipate needs, and deliver exceptional service.

• Coordinate complex projects – liaise with technical, quality, and production teams to keep everything on track.

• Drive continuous improvement – embrace lean principles and help us stay ahead in safety, quality, and efficiency.

What We’re Looking For:

• Strong technical knowledge of rotating machinery and systems.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• Commercial awareness and experience in a similar role.

• Ideally, an HNC or equivalent in engineering.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Bei Sulzer Ellon werden Sie Teil eines unserer Flaggschiff-Servicezentren in Großbritannien und eines anerkannten Kompetenzzentrums für rotierende Gerätedienste. Mit mehr als 100 qualifizierten Fachkräften vor Ort liefern wir erstklassige Reparatur-, Wartungs- und Upgrade-Lösungen für kritische Geräte in den Bereichen Energie, Stromerzeugung und Industrie.

Spezialisiert auf Pumpen, Turbinen, Kompressoren und andere rotierende Maschinen, arbeitet unser Team mit einigen der weltweit führenden Betreibern zusammen, um die Zuverlässigkeit zu maximieren, die Leistung zu verbessern und die Lebensdauer zu verlängern. Ob Sie große Turnaround-Projekte, komplexe Überholungen oder innovative Upgrade-Programme unterstützen, Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bereitstellung von Engineering-Lösungen, die kritische Branchen sicher und effizient am Laufen halten. Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

• Als Customer Support Engineer sind Sie das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Operationsteam.

• Sie verwalten Projekte von der Bestellung bis zur Lieferung und stellen sicher, dass Zeitpläne, Qualität und kommerzielle Ziele erreicht werden.

• Eigene Kundenbeziehungen – halten Sie sie auf dem Laufenden, antizipieren Sie Bedürfnisse und bieten Sie außergewöhnlichen Service.

• Koordinieren Sie komplexe Projekte – arbeiten Sie mit technischen, qualitativen und Produktionsteams zusammen, um alles auf Kurs zu halten.

• Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen – nehmen Sie Lean-Prinzipien an und helfen Sie uns, bei Sicherheit, Qualität und Effizienz die Nase vorn zu haben.

Was wir suchen:

• Starkes technisches Wissen über rotierende Maschinen und Systeme.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.

• Kommerzielles Bewusstsein und Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle.

• Idealerweise ein HNC oder ein Äquivalent im Engineering.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt

• Unternehmensweites Bonussystem

• 33 Tage Jahresurlaub.

• Definierte Rentenbeiträge.

• Der Zugang zu Medicash hilft Ihnen, die täglichen Gesundheitskosten wie zahnärztliche Optik und Physiotherapie sowie eine Reihe von Wohlbefindensvorteilen zu decken.

• Vertrauliche Unterstützung über Employee Assistance Programme.

• Zugang zu Rabatten auf Shopping-Entertainment-Lifestyle sowie die Möglichkeit, sich für eine Costco-Mitgliedschaft zu bewerben.

• Discounted persönliches Auto Leasing für Sie Ihre Familie und Freunde.

• Long Service Awards feiern Ihr Engagement.

• Kontinuierliche Lernmöglichkeiten durch Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Als Silberpreisträger des MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme begrüßen und unterstützen wir Veteranen, Reservisten und Cadet Adult Volunteers mit Richtlinien für Training, Lager und Einsatz sowie einem wachsenden internen militärischen Netzwerk.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer Ellon, vous ferez partie de l'un de nos centres de services phares au Royaume-Uni et d'un centre d'excellence reconnu pour les services d'équipement tournant. Avec plus de 100 professionnels qualifiés sur place, nous offrons des solutions de réparation, d'entretien et de mise à niveau de calibre mondial pour les équipements essentiels dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de la production d'électricité et de l'industrie.

Spécialisé dans les pompes, turbines, compresseurs et autres machines tournantes, notre équipe travaille aux côtés de certains des principaux opérateurs du monde pour maximiser la fiabilité, améliorer les performances et prolonger la durée de vie des équipements. Que vous souteniez des projets d'envergure, des révisions complexes ou des programmes de mise à niveau innovants, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la fourniture de solutions d'ingénierie qui permettent aux industries critiques de fonctionner en toute sécurité et efficacement. Vos principales responsabilités :

• En tant qu'ingénieur de soutien à la clientèle, vous serez le lien vital entre nos clients et notre équipe opérationnelle.

• Vous gérerez les projets de la commande à la livraison, en veillant à ce que les délais, la qualité et les objectifs commerciaux soient atteints.

• Les relations avec les clients – les tenir informés, prévoir les besoins et offrir un service exceptionnel.

• Coordonner les projets complexes – assurer la liaison avec les équipes techniques, de qualité et de production pour maintenir tout sur la bonne voie.

• Conduire l'amélioration continue – adopter des principes maigres et nous aider à rester en avance dans la sécurité, la qualité et l'efficacité.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Forte connaissance technique des machines et des systèmes rotatifs.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en organisation.

• Sensibilisation commerciale et expérience dans un rôle similaire.

• Idéalement, un HNC ou l'équivalent en génie.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un salaire de base compétitif

• Régime de primes à l'échelle de l'entreprise

• 33 jours de congé annuel.

• Cotisations définies.

• Accès à Medicash vous aidant à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.

• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.

• Accès à des rabais sur le style de vie de divertissement d'achat et possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.

• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.

• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.

• Possibilités d'apprentissage continu par l'entremise de Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• En tant que récipiendaire du Prix d'argent du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la Défense, nous accueillons et soutenons les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes bénévoles dans le cadre de politiques d'instruction, de camps et de déploiement, ainsi qu'un réseau militaire interne en pleine expansion.

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Group Data & Analytics Specialist is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to support business decisions. This role develops reports and dashboards and ensures data accuracy and consistency. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Group organization. Key Responsibilities Analyze large datasets to generate actionable insights. Build and maintain dashboards and reports. Collaborate with business units to understand data needs. Ensure data integrity and support data governance. Assist in the development of data models and KPIs. Skills & Qualifications Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 5–7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role. Proficiency in data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Excel). Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Experience with data visualization and reporting. Knowledge of data governance and quality standards.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary (54,000-64,000 EUR depending on experience) as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Nuevos Ministerios

* Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Votre mission principale sera de vous assurer du respect des exigences qualité & sûreté nucléaire tout au long de la réalisation de la commande client (de la prise de commandes jusqu’à la livraison). Activités significatives : Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes - Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client. - Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire. - Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres. - Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres. Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication - Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité. - Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP). - Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur. Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire - Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur. - Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …). - Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs. - Vérification des documents qualité interne. - Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités. - Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration. Après la livraison client - Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI). - Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties. Compétences requises : Compétences métier – technique
• Connaissances générales en ingénierie des matériaux (différents aciers, forge, fonderie)
• Connaissances de l’environnement industriel et métallurgie (mécanique de précision, petites et moyennes séries).
• Compétences en CND (Contrôle Non Destructif)
• Compétences en procédés de fabrication de la métallurgie.
• Connaissance de la métrologie (documentation en fonction des normes, notions de mesure) vérification des PV de métrologies

• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical ​engineering; CAD or Lean certification is an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Lead and manage mechanical design projects related to fire water pump systems, from sales order review to production handover. Ensure compliance with Aramco engineering standards, NFPA 20, and other applicable codes. Provide technical leadership in the design, documentation, and execution of fire protection pumping systems. Key Responsibilities
• Review and interpret Aramco project specifications and NFPA 20 requirements to develop compliant fire water pump designs.
• Prepare and deliver customer‑facing documents including Pump Cross Section drawings, General Arrangement drawings, P&ID diagrams, and when required, relevant calculations.
• Approve and coordinate buyout component documentation for motors, couplings, seals, gearboxes, valves, and diesel engines.
• Collaborate with instrumentation team to ensure proper integration of fire system controls and monitoring.
• Generate and manage Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP ERP.
• Liaise with customers, Aramco representatives, and sub-suppliers to ensure design alignment and approvals.
• Support cross-functional teams (Operations, Procurement, Quality, Testing) throughout the project lifecycle.
• Provide commissioning support and troubleshooting for fire pump systems at site or on test bed.
• Prepare and submit design calculations and technical reports for client and regulatory approval.
• Ensure designs meet safety, reliability, and performance standards required for fire protection systems. Qualifications / Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.
• 5–10 years of experience in centrifugal pump design, with a focus on fire water systems.
• Moderate understanding of both horizontal and vertical pump design and operation.
• Strong working knowledge of NFPA 20, API standards, and Aramco engineering specifications.
• Proficiency in Autodesk (AutoCAD, Inventor), Siemens NX, & Teamcenter.
• Experience with SAP for BOM and project tracking.
• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and interface with clients and regulatory bodies.
• Strong ownership, attention to detail, and results-oriented mindset. What we offer you
• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il ruolo è responsabile della lavorazione di progetti di progettazione assegnati attraverso la fase di progettazione per la consegna alla produzione, tra cui pompa a stelo nudo e imballaggio, osservando la necessità di applicare soluzioni efficaci di costo e assicurando che i costi siano controllati entro stime fornite nella fase di gara. Responsabilità del lavoro

• Assumere la responsabilità per le attività di progettazione e supporto, coordinare con il reparto R&D la preparazione di documenti tecnici per lo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e il trasferimento di prodotti.

• Creare BOM per BSP e pacchetto e rilasciare il BOM in SAP per ogni ordine e contratto, includono la creazione di disegni di tubazioni 3D per la guida di officina.

• Specifiche di emissione per la selezione, la specificazione e l'ordinazione di attrezzature fattorie come guarnizioni meccaniche, sistemi di tenuta e accoppiamenti ecc.

• Dare supporto ad altri reparti su problemi di ingegneria, tra cui la trasmissione di dati di proposizione di ingegneria a R&D, Advance Engineering e Vendite.

Qualifiche

• Tipicamente una laurea in ingegneria meccanica.

• Almeno 3-5 anni di esperienza rilevante all'interno dell'industria correlata, compresa la conoscenza delle pratiche e degli standard del settore.

• Familiare con API 610/682 e relativo standard industriale.

• Le competenze di progettazione e disegno, i software Inventor/NX e 3D sono precedenti.

• Flessibilità e capacità di adattarsi al cambiamento.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 11 giorni festivi e massimo 15 giorni di ferie annuali.

• Feste e regali di compleanno.

Le rôle est de traiter les projets de conception de produits assignés jusqu'à la phase de conception pour les transférer à la production, y compris la pompe à arbre nu et l'emballage, en observant la nécessité d'appliquer des solutions rentables et en veillant à ce que les coûts soient contrôlés dans les limites des estimations fournies au stade de l'appel d'offres. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Sales Representative to join our team in Orange, TX or Pasadena, TX . In this role, you will work closely with senior sales leaders to support account management, drive new business development, and ensure a seamless customer experience. This is an excellent opportunity for an aspiring professional to gain hands-on field experience, develop deep industry knowledge, and contribute to the overall success of our sales operations

Responsibilities:

• Support senior sales representatives in managing and growing assigned customer accounts

• Conduct customer visits alongside senior team members to build relationships and gain field experience

• Assist in identifying new business opportunities through prospecting, site visits, and customer engagement

• Support preparation of quotes and proposals, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up

• Participate in project-related communications, including status updates and coordination with customers, operations, and internal stakeholders

• Maintain and update sales pipeline and customer activities in D365 and Salesforce

• Help coordinate customer visits, facility tours, and test runs (e.g., TDI, inspections)

• Collaborate with inside sales and operations to support order processing, delivery timelines, and customer expectations

• Attend sales meetings, production/WIP meetings, and contribute to action tracking and follow-ups

Ideal Background and Minimum Qualifications:

• 1–2 years of experience in an inside sales or support role, ideally within the industrial or manufacturing sectors.

• You have a working knowledge of electromechanical equipment, including pumps, motors, generators, or industrial repair services.

• A degree is preferred but not required; we value hands-on experience and aptitude.

• You are as comfortable explaining technical solutions over the phone as you are planning to eventually present them in person.

• High School diploma or GED equivalent

Nous recherchons un directeur commercial expérimenté et axé sur les résultats pour diriger notre équipe commerciale, stimuler la croissance des revenus et augmenter la part de marché de Sulzer Pumps en Afrique du Sud. Ce rôle consiste à élaborer et à mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de vente efficaces, à favoriser de solides relations avec la clientèle et à assurer la réalisation des objectifs de vente pour notre gamme variée de solutions de pompage. Résumé de l'emploi

Nous recherchons un directeur commercial expérimenté et axé sur les résultats pour diriger notre équipe commerciale, stimuler la croissance des revenus et augmenter la part de marché de Sulzer Pumps en Afrique du Sud. Ce rôle consiste à élaborer et à mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de vente efficaces, à favoriser de solides relations avec la clientèle et à assurer la réalisation des objectifs de vente pour notre gamme variée de solutions de pompage.

Responsabilités professionnelles

* Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies globales de vente et des plans d'action pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente sur le marché sud-africain.
* Dirigez, mentorez et motivez une équipe de professionnels de la vente, fournissant des conseils, de la formation et des évaluations de rendement pour optimiser leur efficacité.
* Identifier et cultiver de nouvelles occasions d'affaires, en poursuivant activement des comptes clés et des partenariats stratégiques.
* Gérer les relations client existantes, en assurant des niveaux élevés de satisfaction et de rétention de la clientèle.
* Effectuer des études de marché et des analyses concurrentielles pour déterminer les tendances, les possibilités et les défis, et adapter les stratégies de vente en conséquence.
* Préparer et présenter des prévisions de ventes, des rapports et des budgets à la haute direction.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques, d'ingénierie et de service pour assurer un soutien à la clientèle et la livraison de produits sans faille.
* Négocier et fermer les contrats de vente, garantissant des accords rentables pour l'entreprise.
* Représenter les pompes Sulzer à des événements industriels, des salons et des conférences pour promouvoir nos produits et services.
* Assurer le respect de toutes les politiques, procédures et normes éthiques de l'entreprise.

Qualifications d'emploi

* Baccalauréat en génie, administration des affaires, marketing ou un domaine connexe.
* Minimum de 7-10 ans d'expérience progressive dans les ventes, avec au moins 3-5 ans dans un rôle de gestion des ventes, de préférence dans les pompes industrielles, la manutention des fluides, ou les secteurs d'ingénierie connexes.
* Des antécédents avérés d'atteinte ou de dépassement constant des objectifs de vente.
* Une bonne compréhension du marché industriel sud-africain et des besoins des clients.
* Excellent leadership, communication, relations interpersonnelles et compétences en négociation.
* Capacité d'établir et de maintenir des relations solides avec divers intervenants.
* Compétence en logiciel CRM et suite Microsoft Office.
* Permis de conduire valide et volonté de voyager largement en Afrique du Sud.
* Une approche axée sur les résultats, dotée de solides capacités de réflexion et de réflexion stratégiques.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e soluzioni di sviluppo innovative che consentono una società di successo e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Sales Engineering Specialist supporta il processo di vendita fornendo competenze tecniche e aiutando i clienti a capire come i prodotti soddisfano le loro esigenze. Questo ruolo colma il divario tra ingegneria e vendita, garantendo precisione tecnica e soddisfazione del cliente. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti che applicano conoscenze avanzate di un'area di lavoro. Richiesto di gestire progetti / processi indipendentemente con supervisione limitata. In genere allena e recensioni il lavoro di professionisti di livello inferiore. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di vendita senior per unire il nostro team Flow Equipment in Francia. Come Ingegnere di Vendite, si svolgerà un ruolo essenziale nello sviluppo del nostro business collegando competenze tecniche e le esigenze del cliente. Ti aiuterà a rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato e offrire un valore aggiunto eccezionale ai nostri clienti. Le tue azioni avranno un impatto diretto sul nostro successo e sul futuro dell'azienda. Sarete responsabili dello sviluppo, della promozione e della rappresentazione delle attività di SULZER Flow (pompi per i settori dell'energia e delle infrastrutture) al fine di soddisfare al meglio le esigenze dei nostri clienti. Le vostre missioni principali:
• Sii il principale punto di contatto per tutte le attività commerciali riguardanti determinati clienti.
• Gestione del supporto nel piano di sviluppo e nei bilanci.
• Partecipa a riunioni di lavoro.
• Aggiornare il CRM SULZER.
• Assicurare una crescita redditizia nel Territorio.
• Sviluppare e mantenere le relazioni con i clienti.
• Gestione delle offerte e dei documenti tecnici.
• Coordinare scambi tecnici e commerciali.
• Collaborare con la rete di fabbrica globale.
• Negoziare e chiudere le vendite.
• Progetti di monitoraggio.
• Facilitare la comunicazione tra clienti francesi e fabbriche.
• Seguire sviluppi di mercato / clienti / concorrenti. Profilo ricercato:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in un settore simile: Oil & Gas o Energy. Un'esperienza nell'attrezzatura rotante (pompi, turbine, compressori) è essenziale.
• Competenze nella comunicazione, nella negoziazione e nella relazione con il cliente.
• Autonomia, organizzazione e motivazione.
• Inglese (Livello C1)
• Disponibilità per i viaggi.
• Flessibilità e creatività Stiamo cercando qualcuno con base in Francia. Questa posizione è ammissibile per il 100% del telelavoro. Cosa ti offriamo Cosa offriamo
• Vantaggio 1: Coinvolgere progetti importanti e strategici per il Gruppo
• Vantaggio 2: Buchelay: riferimento nucleare all'interno del Gruppo SULZER

• Vantaggio 4: Accesso al Comitato economico e sociale (CES)
• Vantaggio 5: Biglietto ristorante - Vantaggio reciproco - Interessi e partecipazione Premium – RTT - Premio obiettivo
• E molti altri... Sulzer è una parità di opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employee 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Comme premier point de contact pour les visiteurs, les clients et les collègues, vous serez une présence amicale et confiante qui aime construire des rapports et interagir avec les gens à tous les niveaux de l'entreprise. Il s'agit d'un rôle à la fois rapide et rapide pour quelqu'un qui remarque naturellement ce qu'il faut faire et s'y met. Vous allez prendre en charge les tâches, résoudre les problèmes au fur et à mesure qu'ils surviennent et aider à maintenir tout fonctionne en douceur dans les coulisses. Travaillant dans le cadre d'une équipe de soutien de l'administration, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les ministères de l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant un soutien pratique, une coordination et des idées pour aider les équipes à travailler efficacement. Ce que vous ferez
• Travailler dans le cadre de l'équipe administrative pour assurer des opérations quotidiennes sans heurts – fournir un soutien souple aux équipes de tout le site lorsque les besoins opérationnels le requièrent.
• Accueillir les visiteurs et gérer toutes les activités en première maison avec professionnalisme et chaleur
• Traitement des appels entrants, des requêtes et des plaintes des clients, assurant une résolution rapide et efficace
• Supervision de la gestion des salles de réunion
• Gestion des systèmes d'entreprise (SAP, Concur, Egencia, Softworks) et production de rapports
• Coordonner les initiatives de bien-être et les communications clés du site
• Administrer les cartes d'horloge, les configurations SAP, la manutention des postes, les permis de stationnement et la logistique des visiteurs
• Soutenir les procédures d'urgence et promouvoir un environnement de travail sûr
• Assurer une excellente expérience client à chaque point de contact – représentant l'équipe de l'Administration de l'engagement à la collaboration, service à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Ce que vous apporterez
• Fortes compétences en matière de relations interpersonnelles et de service à la clientèle
• Grande capacité organisationnelle et grande attention aux détails
• Confiance dans le travail indépendant et prise en charge des tâches
• Flexibilité, résolution de problèmes et capacité d'adaptation dans un environnement rapide
• Expérience en administration ou en fonctions d'assistant
• Bonne connaissance pratique des paquets Microsoft Office Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un salaire de base compétitif
• Régime de primes à l'échelle de l'entreprise
• 33 jours de congé annuel.
• Cotisations définies.
• Accès à Medicash vous aidant à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.
• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.
• Accès à des rabais sur le style de vie de divertissement d'achat et possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.
• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.
• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.
• Possibilités d'apprentissage continu par l'entremise de Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• Étaient fiers de soutenir ceux qui ont servi. Sulzer est titulaire d'un prix de bronze dans le cadre du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la défense, ce qui signifie que nous accueillons et soutenons activement les anciens militaires et réservistes dans la construction de carrières réussies avec nous. Chez Sulzer Leeds, nous favorisons un environnement de travail dynamique où votre expertise et votre dévouement sont vraiment appréciés. Profitez de avantages passionnants et d'avantages exclusifs, notamment :
• Un club sportif et social animé avec des tirages hebdomadaires et mensuels, des sorties inoubliables, des surprises d'anniversaire, et plus encore
• Gym 24/7 sur place pour vous garder sous tension
• Distributeurs automatiques subventionnés

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il ruolo è responsabile del test e dell'ispezione dei prodotti per garantire che soddisfino gli standard di qualità e sicurezza. Questo ruolo supporta il processo di produzione identificando difetti, mantenendo le attrezzature e seguendo i protocolli di produzione. Responsabilità del lavoro

• Assemblare e testare i prodotti secondo le specifiche.

• Ispezione di beni finiti per difetti e problemi di relazione.

• Mantenere e pulire attrezzature di produzione.

• Seguire gli standard di sicurezza e qualità.

• Attività di produzione e risultati dei test.

• Assistere nella risoluzione dei problemi e nella manutenzione di base.

• Collabora con i membri del team per raggiungere gli obiettivi di produzione.

Qualifiche

• Può richiedere la formazione professionale di base (o l'esperienza lavorativa equivalente) e fino a 2 anni di esperienza rilevante.

• Competenze meccaniche e tecniche di base.

• Attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di seguire le istruzioni.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra.

• Familiarità con procedure di sicurezza e qualità.

• Volontà di imparare e crescere in un ambiente di produzione.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 11 giorni festivi e massimo 15 giorni di ferie annuali.

• Assicurazione commerciale supplementare.

• Esame fisico annuale.

• Feste e regali di compleanno.

• Premi di servizio lunghi.

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

About the role

Job Summary
The role is responsible for testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols. Job Responsibilities

• Assemble and test products according to specifications.

• Inspect finished goods for defects and report issues.

• Maintain and clean production equipment.

• Follow safety and quality standards.

• Document production activities and test results.

• Assist in troubleshooting and basic maintenance.

• Collaborate with team members to meet production goals.

• Basic mechanical and technical skills.

• Attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.

• Good communication and teamwork abilities.

• Familiarity with safety and quality procedures.

• Willingness to learn and grow in a manufacturing environment.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Die Rolle ist für die Prüfung und Inspektion von Produkten verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erfüllen. Diese Rolle unterstützt den Herstellungsprozess durch die Erkennung von Defekten, die Wartung von Geräten und die Einhaltung von Produktionsprotokollen. Aufgabenbereich

• Assemble und Testprodukte nach Spezifikationen.

• Überprüfen Sie fertige Waren auf Mängel und melden Sie Probleme.

• Wartung und Reinigung der Produktionsanlagen.

• Befolgen Sie Sicherheit und Qualitätsstandards.

• Dokumentenproduktion und Testergebnisse.

• Unterstützung bei der Fehlersuche und grundlegenden Wartung.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Teammitgliedern zusammen, um die Produktionsziele zu erreichen.

Qualifikationen

• Kann eine berufliche Grundausbildung (oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung) und bis zu 2 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung erfordern.

• Grundlegende mechanische und technische Fähigkeiten.

• Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Fähigkeit, Anweisungen zu befolgen.

• Gute Kommunikation und Teamfähigkeit.

• Vertrautheit mit Sicherheits- und Qualitätsverfahren.

• Bereitschaft, in einer Produktionsumgebung zu lernen und zu wachsen.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 11 Feiertage und maximal 15 Urlaubstage.

• Zusätzliche gewerbliche Versicherung.

• Jährliche körperliche Untersuchung.

• Festival & Geburtstagsgeschenke.

• Long Service Awards.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Le rôle est de tester et d'inspecter les produits pour s'assurer qu'ils répondent aux normes de qualité et de sécurité. Ce rôle appuie le processus de fabrication en identifiant les défauts, en maintenant l'équipement et en suivant les protocoles de production. Responsabilités professionnelles

• Assembler et tester les produits selon les spécifications.

• Inspecter les produits finis pour déceler les défauts et signaler les problèmes.

• Entretien et nettoyage du matériel de production.

• Suivre les normes de sécurité et de qualité.

• Documenter les activités de production et les résultats des essais.

• Aider dans le dépannage et l'entretien de base.

• Collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe pour atteindre les objectifs de production.

Compétences

• Peut nécessiter une formation professionnelle de base (ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente) et jusqu'à 2 ans d'expérience pertinente.

• Compétences mécaniques et techniques de base.

• Attention aux détails et capacité de suivre les instructions.

• Bonnes capacités de communication et de travail d'équipe.

• Connaissance des procédures de sécurité et de qualité.

• Volonté d'apprendre et de grandir dans un environnement manufacturier.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 11 jours fériés et 15 jours de congé annuel maximum.

• Assurance commerciale complémentaire.

• Examen physique annuel.

• Festival & Cadeaux d'anniversaire.

• Prix de longue durée.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Nous recherchons un/une Technicien Suivi de Fabrication et activités chantiers pour rejoinder nos équipes. Réaliser des opérations d’assemblage de mécanique de précision au sein de l’atelier (prototypes & petites séries) :
• Pour la partie « service » : assurer le démontage, l’expertise et le remontage de pompes hydrauliques, quelque soit la marque (Sulzer et concurrence).
• Pour la partie « produits neufs » : assurer le montage et l’assemblage des pompes à partir des informations transmises par le management d’atelier et la gestion de production. Le monteur mécanicien intervient sur tout type de pompe et sur des marchés exigeants (notamment le nucléaire). Vos principales tâches et responsabilités :
• Démonter, expertiser et monter les équipements mécaniques (pompes), à l’aide notamment d’instrument de mesure.
• Réaliser l’inventaire des pièces mises à disposition par le client et contrôler leur état de fonctionnement.
• Remettre à disposition, les pièces de rechange non consommées auprès de l’expédition.
• S’assurer de la bonne gestion des outillages, de leur rangement et de leur maintien en bon état.
• Assurer un niveau de propreté irréprochable sur son espace de travail. Informer immédiatement sa hiérarchie toute situation potentiellement préjudiciable à la qualité, la sécurité, l’hygiène et l’environnement. Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin : Compétences métier – technique
• Compétences de base en montage mécanique
• Compétences en lecture de plans
• Compétences en utilisation des instruments de mesure pour expertiser la pompe en atelier (savoir relever les côtes). Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire
• Culture sûreté
• Prendre le réflexe de regarder le dossier de référence de la machine sur matériel IPS
• Habilitations SCN2, HN2 et CS Vous serez basé en Ile-de-France, dans les Yvelines, à Buchelay. Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO (rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com) et nous serons heureux de vous répondre! What we offer you

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Nous recherchons un/une Responsable atelier Service pour rejoindre notre équipe. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités : Management de l’atelier du site de Buchelay.
• Ordonnancement de la charge et des priorités de l’atelier au quotidien suivant les informations communiquées par le service planning.
• Affecter les monteurs mécaniciens sur les différentes missions en fonction de leurs compétences et des besoins de production.
• Définir les besoins en matière de compétences et développer la polyvalence de son équipe (formation, suivi du tableau de polyvalence…).
• Organiser la communication et l’information au sein de son équipe (réunions, suivi des indicateurs, remontée d’infos…).
• Rechercher et développer les sources de motivation de son personnel, être à l’écoute et entretenir un bon climat social. Démonter, expertiser, régler, monter des équipements (tout type de machine tournante) S’assurer de l’appropriation et du respect par son équipe des règles en matière d’hygiène, sécurité et environnement. Partager les succès comme les problématiques techniques avec les autres centres de services. Participation aux réunions de revue de production (pièces de rechange et services) en présence de la qualité, des chefs de projets et du management. Apporter une expertise technique opérationnelle auprès de l’ensemble des équipes Sulzer en France et de toute la production (support technique à la production et sur site le cas échéant). Assurer les visites externes (clients, fournisseurs). Vérifier que la partie documentaire (Dossier de suivi d’intervention, respect des règles du dossier de référence notamment) est conforme aux exigences du marché nucléaire et aux règles internes de l’entreprise. Veiller au strict respect de ces règles par son équipe. Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin : Compétences métier – technique
• Compétences en Machines tournantes (Pompes, Turbines, compresseurs) : pratique opérationnelle sur site (après une expérience en maintenance, mise en service, réparation)
• Compétences métrologie (utilisation des instruments de mesure)

About the role

Job Summary

Engineering position is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Recruiting for a Mechanical or Electrical Engineer (both job descriptions available)

Mechanical Engineer Position Summary:
The individual with this position will have to coordinate between the machine shop, quotation department and the customer. This position is mainly an on-site position but might involve up to 10% field service work. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on tasks along with office responsibilities. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of the on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate.

Job requirements
- Preferred 3 years’ experience in rotating equipment repairs
- The preferred experience is in rotating equipment repairs, but acceptable experience includes
o Rotating equipment manufacturing
o Rotating equipment package design and assembly
o Vibration analysis
o Field Service-Overhauls
- Proficient with CAD software: AutoDesk or Solidworks
- Preferred Knowhow of the following topics
o Rolling element bearings, sleeve babbitt bearings
o Oil seals and their functionality
o Vibration spectrums and how to interpret them
o Alignment
- Proficient in the usage of micrometers
- Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred if not it is expected this topic is learnt by the engineer as part of on-the-job training.
Role
- The mechanical engineer will need to bridge the communication to the customers on the mechanical portion of the repair.
- The mechanical engineer will need to be involved on the discovery side of the inspections to assist in developing an accurate workscope.
- Should be proficient in CAD software to document design changes and create drawings to be shared with the customers.
- This role will require the individual to be hands-on and involved in the day-to day operations.
- The role will require performing or confirming precise measurements using micrometers and calipers.
Mandatory Attributes
- The individual must be self-motivated and must be prepared for on-the-job training.
- The individual must take responsibility of their assigned task and finish it in a timely manner.
Qualifications
- Undergraduate/Graduate Degree mechanical engineering or related field

Electrical Engineer Position Summary:
The individual with this position will have to split their time in-between the engineering team objectives, field service, field service reports and shop engineering support. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on-responsibilities along with other engineering tasks. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate.
Job Requirements
- Preferred 0 – 4 years’ experience in the following field of electrical engineering.
o Electric motor, generators repairs and design.
o Transformer repair and design
o Switch gear design and diagnostics
o Power Semiconductors
- Proficient in basic power theory,
- Knowhow in the following topics
o Operations of induction motors
o Operations of synchronous motors
o Transformer principle
o Operation of semiconductors.
o Winding Insulation Tests
Role
- The electrical engineer will be responsible to perform on-site field service preventive maintenance and troubleshooting on electromechanical equipment.
- They will also be responsible to provide the reports for the job performed to the customer in a timely m

About the role Job Summary Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced MRO Gas Turbine Engineer to provide technical expertise and support for the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) of gas turbine components and systems. This role is crucial in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of critical equipment for our clients. Job Responsibilities
• Setting technical specifications for the overhaul, inspection, and repair of aero-derivative gas turbines
• Overseeing disassembly, inspection and reassembly activities, ensuring compliance with engineering drawings, tolerances and standards
• Leading troubleshooting and diagnostic investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions
• Driving continuous improvement initiatives, applying Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams including design engineers, OEMs, supply chain, and operations to deliver seamless project execution Job Qualifications
• Strong technical expertise in gas turbines and rotating equipment, with practical experience of MRO environments
• Proven track record in repair schemes, diagnostics, and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of RB211 and/or Avon products (desirable but not essential)
• Experience in root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions
• The ability to interpret data from sensors and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve faults
• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience (preferred)
• A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills and attention to detail What we offer you
• A competitive base salary
• Annual Bonus scheme based on personal and company performance
• 33 days’ annual leave
• Private Medical Insurance (Self)
• Access free on-site parking and employee discounts across shopping, lifestyle, and entertainment
• Use our Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support services and wellbeing resources
• Develop your skills through continuous learning and Sulzer Learning Pathways
• Be part of a supportive, innovative team with genuine opportunities for career progression Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Frequently review work in progress (WIP) reports for material needs and delivery times.
• Expediting orders, quotes, backorders, work scope changes, etc.
• Order restock items such as general, consumables, safety, welding, machine tooling, C-stock items and office supplies
• Pick up parts from vendors if needed
• Operates material handling equipment such as pallet jacks, forklifts, dollies and other related equipment.
• Other duties as assigned such as filing; assisting in the office or with special projects. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Senior Pump Mechanic is responsible for the inspection, disassembly, repair, reassembly, balancing, and testing of industrial pumps and rotating equipment in a high-quality service center environment. This role serves as a technical expert for complex repairs, including precision balancing of impellers and assembled rotors, ensuring all work meets OEM specifications, safety standards, and customer requirements. The Senior Pump Mechanic also supports mentoring junior mechanics and contributes to continuous improvement within the repair process. Key Responsibilities

• Perform complete teardown, inspection, and rebuild of centrifugal pumps, multistage pumps, vertical pumps, and other rotating equipment

• Diagnose mechanical issues including wear, imbalance, misalignment, and hydraulic performance problems

• Balance individual components such as impellers as well as fully assembled rotors to meet OEM and industry standards

• Assemble rotating elements including shafts, sleeves, bearings, and impellers with proper fits and tolerances

• Conduct hydrostatic testing on pump cases

• Measure and record tolerances using precision tools (micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, etc.)

• Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and OEM specifications

• Restore pumps to OEM or engineered specifications

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

• Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements

• Ensure all repairs, assemblies, and balancing activities meet quality standards and customer expectations

• Participate in quality audits and continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications

• 5–10+ years of experience in pump repair or rotating equipment maintenance

• Strong knowledge of centrifugal pumps and rotating assemblies

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications

• Proficiency with precision measuring instruments

• Solid mechanical troubleshooting skills

• Demonstrate willingness and ability to cross-train in multiple work centers

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments, determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing work instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements. Key Responsibilities

• Under supervision of the Service Center Manager (SCM) or Customer Service Manager completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages that includes work order generation complying with internal procedures, policies, inspection documentation, etc.

• Analyses inspection results and works with internal personnel and resources to disposition and create scope of supply required to repair equipment.

• Under supervision of the SCM or Customer Service Manager plans and generates Repair Proposals including labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost.

• Under supervision of the SCM or Customer Service Manager create and/or review drawings per internal procedures and ISO standards

• Under supervision or of Service Center Manager or Customer Service Manager, procures all required materials, services, and equipment used in repair jobs for the service center. Expedites parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepares and coordinates all inbound/outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs or parts to ensure compliance with customer commitments. This would include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities.

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Technical Discipline (Engineering preferred) or closely related field or equivalent work related experience required

• Minimum of two years’ experience in closely related job/industry, preferred.

• Experience with Microsoft Office products required. SAP knowledge is preferred

• Ability to proactively organize and meet deadlines. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in English.

• Basic understanding of ISO, QMS, ESH and ASME, required.

• Preferred knowledge of API standards, Welding properties and procedures, Pump failure analysis, single, multi, horizontal and vertical pumps

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

Main tasks and responsibilities
• Carrying out reparations and inspections inside and outside the country at customer sites.
• Provision of safe and effective site and workshop overhaul, repair, installation and commissioning services for Electro Mechanical family rotating equipment.
• Be the first point of contact for allocated customers in respect of any issues relating to agreed on-site scopes of work.
• Develop strong relationships with key client contacts.
• Be responsible for on-site Health & Safety.
• Compile on-site Risk Assessments for scopes of work.
• Lead and supervise on-site repair teams during site contract execution.
• Provide continuous improvement in repair, installation and commissioning activities.
• Develop and maintain good and effective relationships with clients to optimise further service opportunities.
• Liaise with technical departments within Sulzer to develop engineering solutions.
• Manage relevant suppliers and subcontractors.
• Compilation of comprehensive site reports in line with company quality management system.
• Communication: communicates (in English as well) with Supervisor Field Service, Site Manager, contractors, and internal Sulzer Services departments.
• Writing daily reports.
• Work with: PC, MS Office package, telephone, hand tools, lifting equipment and gear, Sulzer regulations, OEM instructions, customer rules and regulations and local safety regulations. Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)
• Requirement: Min D3 engineering background: Mechanical or Electrical.
• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall Electric Motor and Turbo Generator maintenance. Familiar with tools, hand tools, and special tools.

• Familiar with technical drawing, symbols and legend, P&ID diagram.

• Relevant experience of minimum 5 years of working on Electric Motor and Turbo Generator.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we help customers keep critical operations running—supporting industries where performance, uptime, and reliability are non-negotiable. Across our global network, we partner with operators in power generation, oil & gas, and industrial sectors to deliver responsive, high-quality service solutions for gas turbine equipment.

Our Gas Turbine Aero business is known for its agility, customer focus, and ability to deliver when it matters most. We’re a trusted partner across EMEA, helping customers maximise the value of their assets and keep their operations moving. As Area Sales Manager, you’ll take ownership of a diverse and high-potential EMEA territory, with the freedom to shape your approach, target key accounts, and drive growth. If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities, and closing deals in a competitive market—this is your platform to make a real impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Owning and delivering revenue growth across your EMEA territory

• Proactively identifying and converting new business opportunities

• Building strong, lasting relationships with key decision-makers

• Developing and executing account plans and territory strategies

• Leading commercial discussions and negotiating high-value deals

• Maintaining a strong pipeline and delivering consistent results

• Acting as the voice of the customer within the business

What We’re Looking For

• Proven track record in sales within the gas turbine sector (essential)

• Strong commercial mindset with a passion for winning new business

• Experience managing complex, multi-country accounts

• Confident communicator with the ability to influence at all levels

• Self-driven, independent, and comfortable working home-based

• Willingness to travel across the EMEA region

What we offer you

Given the role can be based anywhere across the EMEA region and the candidate is open to travel, we will always look to employ individuals on a local, in‑country contract, with relevant local terms and conditions applied.

Alongside this, you can expect a competitive base salary, an annual bonus scheme linked to both individual and company performance, continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways, and the opportunity to develop your career within a global organisation.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for collecting outstanding receivables and maintaining accurate records of collection activities. The role involves interacting with customers, assessing account status, and supporting timely payments. The objective is to maintain cash flow, reduce DSO, resolve disputes, and coordinate with internal teams to address billing or service issues affecting payments.

Key Responsibilities

• Collection Efforts: Contact customers via phone and email to follow up on past-due invoices and secure payments.

• Account Reconciliation: Review accounts to ensure payments are applied correctly and resolve discrepancies.

• Negotiation: Develop payment plans with customers for outstanding debt.

• Reporting: Submit daily/weekly reports on aging accounts and high-risk customers to management.

• Process Improvement: Recommend adjustments to improve AR collection process.

• Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of collection activities and customer correspondence.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor: in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.

• Previous experience in credit and collections or accounts receivable.

• Strong written/verbal communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.

• Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle) and MS Excel.

• Languages: Arabic & English.

• A great working environment.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di tecnico del servizio sul campo (m/f/d), sei un punto di contatto centrale per i nostri clienti nel settore e garantisci un funzionamento affidabile dei nostri impianti di trattamento acque e acque reflue. Si assume la responsabilità per le operazioni di servizio, la manutenzione e la messa in servizio direttamente sul sito e contribuiscono in modo significativo all'alta qualità del servizio della nostra azienda. Attendere con ansia una variegata attività con un sacco di responsabilità tecnica, contatto diretto con i clienti e attrezzature di lavoro modernamente attrezzate. I loro compiti

• Garantire una sequenza di servizio fluida, conveniente e orientata al cliente

• Attuazione delle operazioni di servizio negli impianti di trattamento delle acque e delle acque reflue

• Sostituzione di parti di ricambio e usura, nonché l'esecuzione di riparazioni, lavori di ristrutturazione e manutenzione direttamente presso il sito del cliente

• Analisi e correzione di guasti tecnici

• Lavoro di officina e assemblaggio

• Costruzione e smantellamento e messa in servizio dei nostri impianti di prova

• Preparazione di relazioni analitiche e relazioni tecniche di base dettagliate

• Supporto dei nostri clienti, compresa l'implementazione della formazione dei clienti

Il tuo profilo

• Formazione tecnica completa, ad esempio in ingegneria meccanica, manutenzione, ingegneria idrica o qualifica equivalente

• La conoscenza nella saldatura E e TIG è vantaggiosa

• Patente di guida nella categoria B (ex classe 3)

• Alta disponibilità a viaggiare nel contesto delle attività di servizio esterno

• Metodo di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e conveniente

• Lavoro di squadra, indipendenza e flessibilità

• Forte comunicazione e forza di ragionamento

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco in parola e scrittura, conoscenza dell'inglese desiderabile

• Conoscenza di base di MS Word e Excel e l'esperienza nel trattare con Salesforce

Cosa ti offriamo

• Una posizione sicura in un'azienda moderna e orientata al futuro

• Un ambiente di lavoro piacevole e collegiale

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a field service technician (m/f/d), you are a central point of contact for our customers in the field and ensure reliable operation of our water and wastewater treatment plants. You assume responsibility for service operations, maintenance and commissioning directly on site and contribute significantly to the high service quality of our company. Look forward to a varied activity with a lot of technical responsibility, direct customer contact and modernly equipped work equipment. Their tasks

• Ensuring a smooth, cost-conscious and customer-oriented service sequence

• Implementation of service operations at water and wastewater treatment plants

• Replacement of spare and wear parts as well as carrying out repairs, renovations and maintenance work directly at the customer's site

• Analysis and correction of technical failures

• Workshop and assembly work

• Construction and dismantling as well as commissioning of our test facilities

• Preparation of analytical reports and detailed basic technical reports

• Support of our customers including implementation of customer training

Your profile

• Completed technical training, e.g. in mechanical engineering, maintenance, water engineering or equivalent qualification

• Knowledge in E and TIG welding is advantageous

• Driving licence in category B (formerly class 3)

• High willingness to travel in the context of external service activities

• Self-responsible, structured and cost-conscious working method

• Teamwork, independence and flexibility

• Strong communication and reasoning strength

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing, knowledge of English desirable

• Basic knowledge of MS Word and Excel as well as experience in dealing with Salesforce

What we offer you

• A secure position in a modern and future-oriented company

• A pleasant and collegial working atmosphere

• Intensive familiarisation and regular training

• High personal responsibility and varied tasks

• Attractive social benefits, e.g. occupational pensions and direct insurance

• Company vehicle (workshop car), company mobile phone and company notebook

• Possibility of use directly from the place of residence

• Various further and further training opportunities

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Ipswich and Southampton Service Centres. This is a pivotal, multi-site leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Southampton and Ipswich sites bring together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating machinery. Working with major global energy companies, utilities, and industrial operators, we’re focused on reliability, innovation, and customer success. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Own the P&L for both the Southampton and Ipswich Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.
• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.
• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.
• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.
• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams at both sites, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.
• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).
• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.
• Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly, both within and across the wider regional operations organisation. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across multiple sites in an Industrial Engineering environment
• Experience in business management, P&L ownership, and aftermarket or service-based environments.
• A track record of driving transformation, growth, or organisational change.
• Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements.
• LEAN/Continuous Improvement experience (desirable).
• NEBOSH qualification (desirable). What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• An annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and your individual contribution
• Private Medical Insurance
• Car / Car Allowance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. Le rôle consiste notamment à coacher les jeunes professionnels, à résoudre des problèmes complexes et à assurer la réussite du projet grâce à un leadership technique et analytique. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels spécialisés qui appliquent des connaissances avancées d'un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer les projets/processus de façon indépendante avec une supervision limitée. En général, il entraîne et examine le travail des professionnels de niveau inférieur. • Planificar y coordinar las actividades del proyecto conforme a requerimientos contractales.
