Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role involves providing engineering troubleshooting & solutions. Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts. Manage internal and external subcontracted work. Develop repair specifications, drawings, forms, and processes. Including support project management Technical Representative Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step. Your main tasks and responsibilities: Responsible for all technical information and specifications for each project including:
• Repair specifications, Inspection forms, drawings / prints, material specifications
• Respond to internal requests for inspection and budgetary repair work scopes
• Issue inspection work scopes and estimates
• Review inspection results and evaluate repair solutions
• Write repair work scopes and submit estimates
• Maintain/update repair and inspection service profile templates
• Provide engineering troubleshooting & solutions
• Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Engineering degree or at least 4 years’ experience in turbo machinery. No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role. Do you have a question about the role? Reach out to Jerome Blalack at Jerome.Blalack@sulzer.com or Hiring Manager – Billy Bottera. What we offer you
• 11 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Sr. Manager is responsible for managing senior-level professionals in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals. This role ensures the accuracy and competitiveness of tenders and supports strategic sales initiatives.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of more senior expert-level employees (P20–P40, M20). Purpose of the job:

Management of the company tender and sales support function in order to meet the
objectives of the company's overall business plans and strategies

Main tasks and responsibilities:
• 1. Deputizing for Regional Sales Director for SSA region where appropriate
• 2. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and
• best practice guidelines
• 3. Mentoring, directing, motivating, supervising, and monitoring the performance of all
• members of the allocated team in SSA region
• 4. Identify and initiate department training on a regular basis
• 5. Day to day review of enquiries in conjunction with the Regional Sales Director for SSA Region
• 6. Support, assist and initiate new client contract agreements as and when identified
• 7. Allocation of enquiries to the tendering resource ensuring optimum use of that
• resource in all groups.
• 8. Provide support during the pre-tender process starting from evaluating/assessing
• tenders, assessing risk factors to arrive at bid decisions, and estimating all the
• required material, equipment, and manpower needs to be able to arrive at reliable
• cost estimates for bidding spares, service to turnkey projects.
• 9. Study, analyze and evaluate tender documents and identify risk factors, ensure
• that technical terms comply with the relevant standards and coordinates with the
• Division Heads, and Regional Sales Director for the overall risk assessment and
• bid decision for SSA region
• 10. Overall responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst
• meeting SSA targets
• 11. Overall responsibility to ensure that tenders for PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE meet
• company commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance
• with the delegation of authority guidelines
• 12. Overall responsibility together with the Regional Sales Director for maintaining the
• profit margin on SSA tenders
• 13. Proactively engage with procurement to ensure competitive bidding is possible
• 14. Review and finalize project cost estimates as prepared by the Tendering Engineer
• in terms of the required material as per bill of quantities (BOQ), amount of work,
• material/ equipment/ and manpower requirements during the tendering phase; this
• includes all systems, products and services to client specifications/ requirements.
• 15. Finalize estimation of all direct and indirect costs and consolidate tender documents for management review and approval.
• 16. Ensure in conjunction with sales that the Preliminary eTOA and eTOA tool is
• utilized in line with the eTOA regulation requirements for tenders meeting this
• criteria
• 17. Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements
• in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time
• 18. Overall responsibility to ensure that Order Entry Documentation is completed in
• accordance with handover guidelines and procedures and company KPIs.
• 19. Ensure tender margins are accurate for order entry.
• 20. Overall responsibility to ensure that the sales team are adequately supported and
• that projects are launched in a timely and professional manner
• 21. Ensure that handover meetings with projects are effective and result in a smooth
• transition from pre to post order status
• 22. Provide all the necessary project clarifications/ information upon project award to
• the Project Manager as per the project budget; advises the Project Manager on
• contractual rights, re

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il responsabile Tendering Sr. Manager è responsabile della gestione di professionisti di alto livello nella preparazione di proposte tecniche e commerciali. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza e la competitività delle offerte e sostiene iniziative strategiche di vendita.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a People Managers di dipendenti più esperti (P20–P40, M20). Scopo del lavoro:

Gestione dell'offerta aziendale e della funzione di supporto vendite al fine di soddisfare la
obiettivi dei piani aziendali e delle strategie generali dell'azienda

Principali compiti e responsabilità:
• 1. Deputazione per il Direttore regionale delle vendite per la regione SSA, se del caso
• 2. Assicurare l'applicazione di strumenti e politiche, procedure, codici di condotta e
• migliori orientamenti di pratica
• 3. Mentoring, diretto, motivante, supervisione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni di tutti
• membri del team assegnato nella regione SSA
• 4. Identificare e avviare regolarmente la formazione del reparto
• 5. Riesame giornaliero delle richieste in collaborazione con il Direttore Regionale Vendite per la Regione SSA
• 6. Sostenere, assistere e avviare nuovi accordi contrattuali con i clienti come e quando identificato
• 7. Locazione delle richieste alla risorsa di gara assicurando un uso ottimale di tale
• risorse in tutti i gruppi.
• 8. Fornire supporto durante il processo pre-tender a partire dalla valutazione/valutazione
• le offerte, la valutazione dei fattori di rischio per arrivare a decisioni di offerta e la stima di tutti i fattori di rischio
• materiale necessario, attrezzature e manodopera devono essere in grado di arrivare ad affidabile
• stime dei costi per le offerte, servizio ai progetti chiavi in mano.
• 9. Studiare, analizzare e valutare i documenti teneri e identificare i fattori di rischio, garantire
• che i termini tecnici siano conformi alle norme e alle coordinate pertinenti
• Capo divisione e Direttore regionale delle vendite per la valutazione generale del rischio e
• decisione di offerta per la regione SSA
• 10. Responsabilità complessiva per garantire che i requisiti del cliente siano soddisfatti mentre
• soddisfare gli obiettivi SSA
• 11. Responsabilità complessiva per garantire che le offerte per PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE si incontrano
• le linee guida commerciali aziendali e hanno il segno necessario fuori in conformità
• con la delegazione degli orientamenti dell'autorità
• 12. Responsabilità complessiva insieme al Direttore Vendite Regionale per il mantenimento della
• margine di profitto sulle offerte SSA
• 13. Proattivamente impegnarsi con gli appalti per garantire l'offerta competitiva è possibile
• 14. Verificare e finalizzare le stime dei costi del progetto come preparate dall'Ingegnere di Tendering
• in termini di materiale richiesto per fattura di quantità (BOQ), quantità di lavoro,
• requisiti di materiale/attrezzatura e di manodopera durante la fase di appalto;
• comprende tutti i sistemi, i prodotti e i servizi alle specifiche/ esigenze del cliente.
• 15. Finalizzare la stima di tutti i costi diretti e indiretti e consolidare i documenti d'appalto per la revisione e l'approvazione della gestione.
• 16. Assicurarsi in combinazione con le vendite che lo strumento preliminare eTOA ed eTOA è
• utilizzato in linea con i requisiti di regolamentazione eTOA per le offerte che soddisfano questo
• criteri
• 17. Responsabilità complessiva di garantire che i progetti avviati soddisfino i requisiti aziendali
• in termini di selezione, prezzi, termini e condizioni e tempi di consegna
• 18. Responsabilità complessiva di garantire che la documentazione di ammissione dell'ordine sia completata in
• secondo le linee guida e le procedure di consegna e i KPI aziendali.
• 19. Assicurare margini di gara sono accurati per l'entrata dell'ordine.
• 20. Responsabilità complessiva per garantire che il team di vendita sia adeguatamente supportato e
• che i progetti siano avviati in modo tempestivo e professionale
• 21. Assicurarsi che le riunioni di consegna con i progetti siano efficaci e si traducano in modo uniforme
• passaggio da pre a post stato dell'ordine
• 22. Fornire tutte le necessarie precisazioni del progetto/informazioni sul premio del progetto a
• il Project Manager secondo il budget del progetto; consiglia il Project Manager su
• diritti contrattuali, re

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Tendering Sr. Manager ist für das Management von hochrangigen Fachleuten bei der Erstellung von technischen und kommerziellen Vorschlägen verantwortlich. Diese Rolle sichert die Genauigkeit und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Ausschreibungen und unterstützt strategische Verkaufsinitiativen.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an People Manager von leitenden Mitarbeitern auf Expertenebene (P20-P40, M20). Zweck der Tätigkeit:

Management der Ausschreibungs- und Verkaufsunterstützungsfunktion des Unternehmens, um die
Ziele der allgemeinen Geschäftspläne und Strategien des Unternehmens

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten:
• 1. Vertretung als Regional Sales Director für die Region SSA, wo dies angebracht ist
2. Gewährleistung der Anwendung von Sulzer-Tools und -Richtlinien, -Verfahren, -Verhaltenskodizes und
• Best Practice Leitlinien
3. Mentoring, Regie, Motivation, Überwachung und Überwachung der Leistung aller
• Mitglieder des zugewiesenen Teams in der SSA-Region
• 4. Identifizieren und Initiieren von Abteilungsschulungen regelmäßig
5. Tag für Tag Überprüfung der Anfragen in Verbindung mit dem Regional Sales Director für SSA Region
• 6. Unterstützung, Unterstützung und Initiierung neuer Kundenvertragsvereinbarungen, sobald und wann sie identifiziert werden
• 7. Zuweisung von Anfragen an die Ausschreibungsressourcen, um eine optimale Nutzung zu gewährleisten
• Ressourcen in allen Gruppen.
• 8. Unterstützung während des Pre-Tender-Prozesses, beginnend mit der Bewertung / Bewertung
• Ausschreibungen, Bewertung von Risikofaktoren, um zu Gebotsentscheidungen zu gelangen, und Schätzung aller
• erforderliches Material, Ausrüstung und Personal müssen in der Lage sein, zuverlässig zu sein
• Kostenschätzungen für Gebotsersatzteile, Service für schlüsselfertige Projekte.
• 9. Studie, Analyse und Bewertung von Ausschreibungsunterlagen und Identifizierung von Risikofaktoren,
• dass die Fachbegriffe den einschlägigen Normen entsprechen und mit dem
• Division Heads und Regional Sales Director für die Gesamtrisikobewertung und
• Angebotsentscheidung für die Region SSA
• 10. Gesamtverantwortung dafür, dass die Kundenanforderungen erfüllt werden
• Erfüllung der SSA-Ziele
• 11. Gesamtverantwortung dafür, dass Ausschreibungen für PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE erfüllt werden
• kaufmännische Richtlinien des Unternehmens und haben die notwendige Unterschrift gemäß
• Mit der Delegierung von Autoritätsrichtlinien
• 12. Gesamtverantwortung zusammen mit dem Regional Sales Director für die Aufrechterhaltung der
• Gewinnmarge bei SSA-Tendern
• 13. Proaktive Beteiligung an der Beschaffung, um sicherzustellen, dass wettbewerbsfähige Ausschreibungen möglich sind
14. Überprüfung und Abschluss der Projektkostenschätzungen, wie sie vom Tendering Engineer erstellt wurden
• in Bezug auf das erforderliche Material gemäß Mengenrechnung (BOQ), Arbeitsaufwand,
• Material-/Ausrüstungs-/ und Personalbedarf während der Ausschreibungsphase; dies
• umfasst alle Systeme, Produkte und Dienstleistungen nach Kundenspezifikationen / -anforderungen.
• 15. Abschluss der Schätzung aller direkten und indirekten Kosten und Konsolidierung der Ausschreibungsunterlagen für die Überprüfung und Genehmigung durch das Management.
• 16. Stellen Sie in Verbindung mit dem Verkauf sicher, dass das vorläufige eTOA- und eTOA-Tool
• in Übereinstimmung mit den eTOA-Vorschriften für Ausschreibungen verwendet, die diese erfüllen
• Kriterien
• 17. Gesamtverantwortung dafür, dass initiierte Projekte den Unternehmensanforderungen entsprechen
• in Bezug auf Auswahl, Preis, Bedingungen und Vorlaufzeit
• 18. Gesamtverantwortung, um sicherzustellen, dass die Auftragseingabedokumentation in
• in Übereinstimmung mit den Übergaberichtlinien und -verfahren und den Unternehmenskennzahlen.
• 19. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Tender-Margen für die Bestellung korrekt sind.
• 20. Gesamtverantwortung dafür, dass das Verkaufsteam angemessen unterstützt wird und
• dass Projekte zeitnah und professionell gestartet werden
• 21. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Übergabebesprechungen mit Projekten effektiv sind und zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf führen
• Übergang vom Pre-to-Post-Order-Status
22. Geben Sie alle notwendigen Projektklärungen / Informationen bei der Projektvergabe an
• den Projektleiter gemäß Projektbudget; berät den Projektleiter
• Vertragsrechte, re
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le gestionnaire principal d'appel d'offres est chargé de gérer les professionnels de haut niveau dans la préparation des propositions techniques et commerciales. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude et la compétitivité des appels d'offres et soutient les initiatives stratégiques de vente.
Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse aux gestionnaires de personnes d'un plus haut niveau d'experts (P20–P40, M20). But du travail :

Gestion de la fonction d'appel d'offres et de soutien aux ventes de l'entreprise
objectifs des plans et stratégies d'entreprise globaux de l'entreprise

Principales tâches et responsabilités:
1. Deputing pour le directeur régional des ventes pour la région SSA, le cas échéant
• 2. Assurer l'application des outils et des politiques, procédures, codes de conduite et
• lignes directrices pour les meilleures pratiques
• 3. Mentoring, direction, motivation, supervision et suivi des performances de tous
• membres de l'équipe allouée dans la région SSA
4. Recenser et lancer régulièrement la formation des départements
5. Examen quotidien des demandes de renseignements en collaboration avec le directeur régional des ventes pour la région de l'ASS
6. Appuyer, aider et lancer de nouveaux contrats avec les clients au fur et à mesure qu'ils sont identifiés
• 7. Attribution des demandes de renseignements à la ressource de l'appel d'offres pour une utilisation optimale de cette ressource
• ressources dans tous les groupes.
• 8. Fournir un appui pendant le processus pré-appel d'offres en commençant par l'évaluation
• les appels d'offres, l'évaluation des facteurs de risque pour arriver à des décisions d'adjudication et l'estimation de l'ensemble des
• le matériel, l'équipement et la main-d'œuvre nécessaires doivent être en mesure d'arriver à des résultats fiables;
• les prévisions de coûts pour les offres de pièces détachées, le service à des projets clés en main.
9. Étudier, analyser et évaluer les documents d'appel d'offres et identifier les facteurs de risque,
• que les termes techniques soient conformes aux normes pertinentes et coordonnent
• Chefs de division et Directeur régional des ventes pour l'évaluation globale des risques et
• décision de soumission pour la région SSA
10. Responsabilité globale de veiller à ce que les exigences du client soient satisfaites
• atteindre les objectifs de l'ASS
• 11. Responsabilité globale de veiller à ce que les appels d'offres pour le RPP, le COPS, le SGE, le ST & FE se rencontrent
• les lignes directrices commerciales de l'entreprise et avoir la signature nécessaire conformément
• avec les directives de délégation de pouvoirs
• 12. Responsabilité globale, conjointement avec le Directeur régional des ventes
• marge bénéficiaire sur les offres SSA
• 13. S'engager activement dans la passation des marchés pour garantir la possibilité d'une mise en concurrence
14. Examiner et finaliser les prévisions de dépenses du projet telles qu'elles ont été établies par l'ingénieur chargé des appels d'offres
• en termes de matériel requis selon la facture de quantité (BOQ), la quantité de travail,
• les besoins en matériel/équipement/et en main-d'œuvre pendant la phase d'appel d'offres;
• comprend tous les systèmes, produits et services aux spécifications/exigences du client.
15. Achever l'estimation de tous les coûts directs et indirects et regrouper les documents d'appel d'offres pour examen et approbation par la direction.
• 16. S'assurer en conjonction avec les ventes que l'outil eTOA préliminaire et eTOA est
• utilisé conformément aux exigences du règlement eTOA pour les appels d'offres satisfaisant à cette exigence
• critères
17. Responsabilité générale de veiller à ce que les projets lancés répondent aux exigences des entreprises
• en termes de sélection, prix, modalités et délais
• 18. Responsabilité globale de s'assurer que les documents d'entrée de commande sont remplis en
• conformément aux directives et procédures de transfert et aux ICR de l'entreprise.
• 19. Veiller à ce que les marges d'appel d'offres soient exactes pour l'entrée des commandes.
• 20. Responsabilité globale de veiller à ce que l'équipe de vente soit adéquatement soutenue et
• que les projets soient lancés en temps voulu et de manière professionnelle;
21. Veiller à ce que les réunions de transfert avec les projets soient efficaces et aboutissent à un bon déroulement
• passage de l'état avant à celui après l'ordre
• 22. Fournir toutes les précisions et informations nécessaires sur l'attribution du projet
• le gestionnaire de projet selon le budget du projet;
• les droits contractuels,

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role As a Territory Sales Lead, you will oversee and inspire a regional team of Sales Engineers across the South UK, driving growth and strengthening Sulzer’s presence in key markets. You’ll help deliver innovative solutions for the maintenance, repair, and optimisation of rotating equipment across our full service portfolio. Your Main Responsibilities
• Lead and support a regional team of Sales Engineers in promoting Sulzer’s full portfolio of service solutions for rotating equipment - including inspection, overhaul, repair, upgrades, and replacement parts.
• Lead monthly order intake performance for the South UK region, taking full ownership of targets and consistently delivering in line with business forecasts and commitments.
• Drive growth in Sulzer Services key markets , focusing on electric motors, generators, pumps, turbines, compressors, and other critical rotating machinery used across power generation, water, oil & gas, chemicals, and industrial sectors.
• Pursue new business opportunities, championing Sulzer’s products, technologies, and services , supporting the team in presenting solutions that address complex engineering challenges.
• Champion the use of Salesforce , ensuring all opportunities within the South UK team are accurately logged, maintained, and progressed in accordance with Sulzer’s gate process.
• Collaborate closely with peers across the UK & Nordics region, fostering a strong team ethos and maintaining alignment on goals, strategy, and best practice.
• Represent Sulzer at key industry and customer events , strengthening brand presence, building relationships, and enhancing Sulzer’s reputation within the regional market. What You’ll Need to Succeed
• Proven experience in technical sales leadership , managing a regional or field-based sales team.
• Strong knowledge of rotating machinery service industry, across pumps, gearboxes, compressors, motors, generators etc
• Excellent communication, coaching, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify and articulate technical concepts to all stakeholders.
• A proactive, results-oriented mindset with the ability to drive team performance and cultivate new opportunities.
• A strategic thinker with strong analytical skills and the ability to translate insights into action.
• A Full UK Driving Licence and willingness to travel extensively within the territory. What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Enjoy 33 days of holiday, including service days.
• A defined bonus scheme based on company and personal performance.
• Prioritise your well-being with confidential support and guidance through our Employee assistance programmes
• Access a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle. Eligible employees can also apply for a Costco membership for additional exclusive offers.
• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways focused on your professional development Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role leads the Field Service & Engineering organization with full responsibility for the planning, execution, and documentation of field jobs, services, and projects. The position ensures delivery in line with defined scope, timelines, and budgets, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and quality. By leading the local center of competence, the role strengthens regional capabilities, reduces reliance on global mobilization, shortens response times, and ultimately enhances customer satisfaction and profitable service delivery. Key Responsibilities
• Lead global field service execution, including outages, overhauls, inspections, troubleshooting, and commissioning
• Own global service performance, covering safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost, margins, and customer satisfaction
• Drive the regionalization of field services by developing local skills, certifications, tools, and standardized execution practices
• Define and implement the regional field service operating model in line with global policies and standards
• Act as the primary customer interface during service execution and support Sales & Tendering with execution concepts, feasibility reviews, and cost inputs
• Lead and develop local and regional Field Service Engineers and Supervisors, fostering a strong safety culture and service mindset
• Plan and optimize regional resources, coordinating cross‑regional support only where specialized expertise or peak capacity is required
• Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and compliance with global EHS and quality requirements, while feeding field learnings back into global organizations Your Profile
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline
• 10+ years of experience in field service or service operations within turbomachinery, power generation, or rotating equipment
• Proven leadership experience managing multi‑disciplinary field service teams
• Strong background in outage execution, maintenance, and troubleshooting
• Experience with regionalization, localization, or operating model transformation is highly desirable
• Strong safety leadership, customer focus, and cost‑ and risk‑aware decision‑making skills What we offer you
• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave
• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution
• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)
• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals
• Free parking on-site
• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution
• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts
• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols. This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization. Key Responsibilities include reviewing customer purchase orders & material BOM. Review drawings carefully to determine make or buy depending on costs and schedule. Handle multiple reports as needed to monitor multiple jobs and assist production with schedule. Assist in troubleshooting and basic maintenance. Collaborate with team members to meet production goals. Skills & Qualifications May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role. Basic mechanical and technical skills. Attention to detail and ability to follow instructions. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Familiarity with safety and quality procedures. Willingness to learn and grow in a manufacturing environment. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Health savings account matching

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Overall co-ordination, functional management, and leadership of all the Services Division’s sales activity needs of the Company's customers within Sub-Saharan African Region in order to meet the objectives of the company's overall business plans and strategies. Overall co-ordination, functional management, and leadership of all the Company’s tendering activities. Effective co-ordination with the Flow Division to align sales initiatives with the company’s objectives and ensure sustainable business growth. Main tasks and responsibilities 1. Sales Strategy Development and Execution: a. Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve business goals and revenue targets. b. Coordinate specific objectives of the Sales Strategy with regards to the assigned functional area, liaising with relevant departments of the company. c. Identify new market opportunities, trends, and emerging markets to drive business expansion. d. Set quarterly and annual sales goals, forecasts, and performance metrics. e. Effective client contact, relationship building, and management processes are in place (including acting on feedback from Customer Satisfaction Surveys) to positively influence the client and create a pre-disposition to view Sulzer as the preferred source of supply. f. Application of Sulzer sales and commercial policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines 2. Team Leadership and Management: a. Lead, coach, and mentor the sales team to ensure high performance and continuous development. b. Conduct performance evaluations, set clear KPIs, and provide actionable feedback. c. Collaborate with HR on recruiting, hiring, and onboarding new sales team members. 3. Revenue Growth and Client Relationship Management: a. Drive revenue growth by expanding the client base, maximizing customer retention, and improving client satisfaction. b. Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders. c. Lead negotiations, secure high-value deals, and manage complex sales cycles. 4. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Alignment: a. Work closely with marketing, product development, and customer service to align sales efforts with overall company objectives. b. Collaborate with the finance team to set accurate sales budgets and forecasts. c. Ensure consistent communication and alignment across the business on sales initiatives. d. Review tenders and manage tendering process with the Head of Tendering. e. Ensure that handover meetings and documentation are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status. 5. Market and Competitor Analysis: a. Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform sales strategies. b. Conduct market research and analysis to identify new business opportunities and potential growth areas. 6. Reporting and Performance Tracking: a. Develop and present regular sales performance reports to senior management, highlighting key insights, challenges, and successes. b. Use data and analytics to track performance and optimize sales processes and approaches. c. Ensure the sales team leverages CRM systems effectively for pipeline management and tracking. 7. All other duties as relevant to the position. Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required
• Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering or a related field (MBA preferred).
• Proven experience (8+ years) in sales management, with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
• Experience in rotating equipment industry is preferred.
• Strong background in managing high-performance sales teams.
• Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
• Strong strategic thinking and business acumen.
• Excellent neg

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The entry-level Internal Quality Auditor is responsible for the execution of day-to-day quality assurance activities. This includes setting operational objectives, ensuring adherence to quality standards, and resolving routine quality issues. Key Responsibilities:
• Implement and maintain QESH management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
• Ability and willingness to travel to Service Centers across the US 5-7 times per year.
• Conduct internal audits, inspections, and risk assessments across production areas.
• Lead incident investigations, identify root causes, and track corrective actions.
• Provide training and guidance to employees on QESH policies and safe work practices.
• Monitor and report on QESH KPIs, including non-conformities, near misses, and environmental metrics.
• Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and lean manufacturing efforts
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate QESH into daily operations.
• Maintain documentation and prepare for external audits and customer inspections.
• Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory quality standards.
• Investigate and resolve routine quality issues.
• Support audits and continuous improvement initiatives Requirements:
• Intermediate knowledge of MS Word MS Excel required
• Basic knowledge or MS SharePoint and MS PowerPoint preferred
• 1+ years of experience in Internal Quality Audits preferred but not required
• Knowledge of quality assurance practices and tools.
• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
• Effective communication and documentation abilities.
• Familiarity with manufacturing environments.
• Experience in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 environments preferred What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. A propos du rôle Soutien dans cette tâche variée Vous êtes les personnes-ressources de votre secteur de soutien pour atteindre nos objectifs stratégiques et opérationnels grâce au soutien professionnel côté RH tout au long du cycle de vie des employés. Dans le travail quotidien, cela comprend:
• Assurer une planification durable de la demande de personnel en étroite coordination avec les domaines spécialisés dans le cadre de la stratégie d'entreprise
• Soutenir le recrutement ciblé de spécialistes et de gestionnaires y compris. Soutien au processus d'embarquement
• coopération étroite avec les cadres en ce qui concerne un large éventail de questions et de thèmes liés au droit du travail et à la négociation collective dans le travail de tous les jours
• conseil et maintien des employés dans toutes les questions relatives au personnel
• soutien aux gestionnaires dans le domaine de la gestion des performances
• accompagnement professionnel des processus de séparation et de hors-bord
• Ggf. Mise en œuvre/participation à des projets de personnel locaux/mondiaux
• Coopération active dans le développement et l'optimisation des processus personnels
• Coopération productive et professionnelle avec d'autres parties prenantes internes et externes (y compris les comités d'entreprise, les syndicats, les demandeurs, la communauté des RH et les prestataires de services externes) Pour réussir à ce stade, vous devez apporter les éléments suivants:
• Curiosité, ouverture et empathie pour l'établissement rapide de contacts personnels et de réseaux professionnels
• Force de communication dans l'environnement local et mondial (les compétences linguistiques en allemand et en anglais sont nécessaires pour cela)
• L'initiative propre et l'orientation cible dans le rôle de personne de contact indépendante dans le domaine des soins
• Savoir-faire très bien fondé en matière de ressources humaines (droit du travail, droit fiscal / droit SV), idéalement de l'environnement industriel / service
• Compétences en TI professionnelles (bureau SM, systèmes RH), ainsi que l'affinité informatique
• Connaissances spéciales (par exemple, autres langues étrangères, connaissance des conventions collectives métallifères, jour de travail, SAP) sont un plus
• volonté de voyager (création à définir) Il fait partie d'une équipe de RH dévouée et motivée, qui soutient plusieurs sites de production et de services à travers l'Allemagne avec un total d'environ 780 employés. Dans cette tâche, vous pouvez profiter d'un haut degré d'espace de conception et de conditions-cadres attrayantes. Avez-vous des questions sur ce travail ? Contactez Nina Rufer (nina.rufer@sulzer.com). Nous sommes heureux de vous entendre ! Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Admin Coordinator is responsible for independently handling administrative tasks and coordinating support activities. This role works autonomously and may guide other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. PASADENA, TEXAS, USA Summary: The Estimating Coordinator provides essential support in the valuation and processing of incoming projects. Key responsibilities include maintaining data integrity within Microsoft Dynamics and facilitating clear communication between the company and its clients during the initial job intake phase. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: o Develop detailed repair estimates including labor, parts, and materials using internal systems and vendor quotes o Collaborate with service technicians, ASM’s and engineers to determine scope of work and timelines o Communicate clearly with clients regarding repair options, costs, and schedules o Coordinate with procurement and vendors to source parts and materials o Work with NPS group as needed to provide replacement options to our customers o Maintain accurate records of estimates, work orders, and customer communications o Ensure compliance with safety standards and industry regulations o Support preventative maintenance planning and rebuild programs o Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities and process improvements Qualifications: · 2+ years of experience in estimating or service coordination within oil & gas or heavy industrial equipment preferred · Strong mechanical aptitude and understanding of oilfield machinery and systems preferred · Proficiency in estimating software and Microsoft Office Suite · Excellent communication and customer service skills · High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects · Familiarity with OSHA and industry safety standards · Technical certifications or vocational training in mechanical or industrial repair is a plus WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lean Manager is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• At factory level, use lean manufacturing principles to achieve operational business targets.

• Assist supervisor and managers with action plan to achieve company objectives.

• Support manufacturing improvements through tooling and equipment design and equipment specification development.

• Improve On Time Delivery and Lead Times though the implementation of continuous flow, layout optimization, pull-system and speed up flows by coaching and/or leading lean principles workshops.

• Contribute to Factory Improvement Plan.

• Review continuous improvement plans and cost-saving projections, challenging where necessary, and provide feedback that drives additional improvements.

• Support continuous failure analysis in cooperation with affected areas.

• Improve Root Cause Analysis knowledge and utilization within the organization.

• Prepare and submit performance reports as required.

• Support corporate initiatives as defined by the Management Team.

• All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of Personal Protective Equipment.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Nous recherchons un/une Technicien(ne) Stand d’Essai pour rejoindre notre équipe. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités : 1. Procéder au montage des équipements mécaniques conformément aux plans établis et aux procédures applicables au sein de la plateforme d’essai. 2. Installer l’instrumentation nécessaire pour les essais. 3. Raccorder les circuits de puissance électrique simple. 4. S’assurer de la disponibilité du banc d’essai entre chaque essai. 5. Procéder au 1er niveau de maintenance des équipements du stand. 6. Travaux ponctuels à réaliser en espace confiné (Fosses, Ballons) 7. Travaux en hauteur occasionnels 8. Conduite de chariot élévateur et pontier/élingueur (CACES 3,4,5) 9. Travaux par point chaud (frettage/défrettage) 10. Manipulation de produits chimique (N1) Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin : Le technicien doit pouvoir travailler en autonomie avec des tierces personnes affectées de façon occasionnel au stand d’essais. Le technicien doit être force de proposition afin de garantir la qualité des essais Afin de garantir une présence pendant les essais, il est demandé au technicien d’essai une flexibilité sur les horaires de travail dans le respect du cadre législatif hebdomadaire. Compétences métier – technique
• Compétences en Machines tournantes (Pompes, Turbines, compresseurs) : pratique opérationnelle sur site (après une expérience en maintenance, mise en service, réparation)
• Compétences métrologie (utilisation des instruments de mesure)
• Compétences financières opérationnelles (suivi des budgets, respect des temps « gammes », commandes du matériel)
• Connaissances des règles HSE applicables au sein d’un atelier
• Expérience de travail dans SAP : réalisation des fiches de non-conformité, recherche d’informations pour l’ordonnancement de la charge, montage pompe, turbine, compresseur & moteur, validation factures, demandes d’achats)
• Anglais de base
• Connaissances Word, excel (niveau de base) Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire
• Culture sûreté Vous serez basé en Ile de France, dans les Yvelines, à Buchelay. Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO (rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com) et nous serons heureux de vous répondre! What we offer you
• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe
• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER
• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe
• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)
• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation – RTT
• Et bien d'autres... Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. About the role This a Temporary 6 Months contract The Talent Acquisition specialist is responsible for supporting recruitment processes, including candidate sourcing, screening, and coordination. This role ensures a smooth hiring experience and contributes to the organization’s talent acquisition goals. Key Responsibilities
• Manage requisitions and candidate pipelines in Workday Create and maintain job requisitions in Workday, ensuring accuracy of job details, approvals, and status updates while actively managing candidates through each stage of the hiring workflow.
• Screen and assess candidates Review applications, conduct initial screenings, and evaluate candidates against role requirements, ensuring a consistent and high-quality shortlisting process.
• Coordinate interviews via Workday Schedule and manage interviews using Workday tools, partnering with hiring managers and ensuring a seamless and professional candidate experience.
• Maintain data accuracy and system integrity Ensure all candidate and requisition data in Workday is up to date, complete, and compliant with internal standards and audit requirements.
• Support recruitment reporting and analytics Generate and analyze recruitment reports (e.g., time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) to support data-driven hiring decisions.
• Ensure compliance with policies and local regulations Follow standardized recruitment processes, maintain proper documentation, and ensure adherence to internal policies and applicable labor laws.
• Drive sourcing and talent pipeline initiatives Support proactive sourcing strategies using internal tools and external platforms, while maintaining candidate pipelines within Workday.
• Contribute to employer branding initiatives Support job posting optimization, candidate communications, and employer branding efforts to enhance the organization’s attraction strategy. Skills & Qualifications A Bachelors degree in Human resources or similar (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–6 years of relevant experience recruiting in a similar industry (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role. Demonstrated experience recruiting in in the Middle East, Caspian and North Africa regions. Technical hiring understanding Energy market knowledge Good understanding of recruitment processes. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group IT Engineering Specialist is responsible for developing and maintaining software and cloud-based applications, ensuring performance, security, and scalability. This role supports project delivery and contributes to technical innovation. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Purpose of the Job (summarized) To ensure the continued development and support of Application Integration portfolio within the business organisation. Ensuring that the business is kept at an efficient, functioning state regarding its integrated applications applications / processes. We need Integration Developer in our Sales Tools team, reporting to the AGM Sales Tools, Global Delivery Center within the Global IT Team. We are looking for a self-driven. Integration Developer Your job General Tasks:
• Develop and maintain Application Integration solutions (real-time / batch)
• Supporting and maintaining integration solutions and related components e.g. databases, queues
• Designing and modelling of databases, tables, stored procedures according to solution requirement
• Create / configure / fine tune / monitoring queues (MSMQ, Azure Service Bus queue, ActiveMQ)
• Scheduling and deployment
• Coordinate with different teams for fixing integration issues / new implementations
• Talend monitoring
• Monitoring, fixing non-working and broken jobs
• Monitoring the health of Talend remote engine / run-time servers. Give suggestions accordingly.
• Talend infrastructure; keeping Talend infrastructure up to date according to predefined schedule
• Patching, upgrades, deployment, etc.
• Debugging and optimizing implementations Technical:
• Experience with (a) modern integration platform(s).
• Should be well-versed with SQL (database designing, create tables, stored procedures)
• Hands-on experience with creating / configuring / maintaining ActiveMQ / MSMQ / Azure Service Bus queue
• Developing APIs / web services in Talend
• Knowledge on FTP / SFTP / APIs / WEB services
• Sound knowledge of JSON / XML
• Knowledge of java scripts
• Experience on integration with SAP / Salesforce / MS Dynamics CRM
• Experience with Talend Cloud Real-Time Big Data Platform
• Nice to have – Talend certification; experience with Talend infrastructure, e.g. installation/upgrade of remote engines / runtimes will be an added advantage Experience required in/with:
• Essential – willingness to expand their knowledge of the above
• A globally acting company and working in international project teams
• ~ 10 years overall experience in similar role out of which ~ 6-7 years in Talend
• Integration around Salesforce and SAP
• Salesforce platform events
• Talend data mapper Education/Qualification: o Any graduate with the above-mentioned professional experience We offer In an international environment, you will take over global responsibilities. You will work in an international team and in different cultures. This position enables to further personal development. If you can identify yourself with this challenge, then we would like to get to know you! About the role Job Summary The Service Center Manager is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards. Heading & responsible for complete service center repairs activities, implementation of Lean principle & develop the service center with required Improvising in existing process Main accountabilities and tasks
• Monitor, Manage, Control & solutions giving for all repairs pumps & Turbo equipment received for the repairs and overhaul at Vadodara service center.
• Leading & administer the service center team of around 20 guys with their day today work, follow-ups and guidance.
• Develop the existing service center with adopting good industrial practices & growing service center to excellence working on digitalization
• RFC Planning, Sales Commitment on Monthly, quarterly & Yearly basis. with dispatches by On time accuracy level and minimize the order cycle time by implementing best practices in place.
• Responsible for growth of repair business, quality and faster repair works, resulting in customer satisfaction.
• Interdepartmental coordination among Tendering team, procurement, Engineering & Sales functions for relevant subjective matters.
• Regular Meetings with concerns interdepartmental for timely Order intake and sales planning.
• Main KPI - Monthly RFC sales, Ontime delivery & Order Cycle time, & Safety walks & safety observations Monthly targeted
• Responsible for closing the cases of Warranty cases, profit margin assurance, Cash Collections & business growth.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role ​Company Overview: Sulzer Services is an independent provider of services and equipment repairs for the Rotating Equipment industry. Sulzer Services specializes in the repairs and overhaul of gas turbines, steam turbines, compressors, pumps and electromechanical equipment for the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, and Power Generation industries. Position Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Early Career Programs Specialist to develop and execute our internship and new-hire rotational programs. This role will also provide support to the Training Program Manager with strategic initiatives. Additional responsibilities include internal communications such as newsletters, program updates, department calendars, e-learning content creation, and designing promotional content for training programs. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience in designing, implementing, and evaluating developmental programs that provide emerging talent with meaningful learning experiences. This role requires a blend of project management, instructional design, and stakeholder collaboration to ensure program success and alignment with organizational goals. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Develop and execute comprehensive new hire rotational programs that align with organizational objectives and provide participants with structured learning experiences.
• Internship program: establish program and enhance for growth throughout the region and product lines.
• Work closely with department managers and HR to define program goals, identify skill gaps, and ensure alignment with business needs.
• Lead the recruitment process, including sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and facilitating onboarding to integrate interns and new hire rotational employees effectively.
• Manage all logistical aspects of the programs, including scheduling, venue arrangements, coordinating with volunteers, and resource allocation.
• Monitor and assess program effectiveness through feedback, performance metrics, and evaluations to ensure continuous improvement.
• Assist the Training Program Manager in developing and implementing training strategies that align with organizational goals including but not limited to developing e-learning content, maintaining training calendars, and developing procedures.
• Maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring accurate entry and upkeep of training records, course schedules, and participant data. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Proven experience as a Program Coordinator or similar role, with a track record of coordinating comprehensive internship and rotational programs in a corporate environment.
• 3–5 years of experience in training and development, program coordinator, or a similar role.
• Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage timelines, logistics, and multiple stakeholders.
• High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, managers, and external partners.
• Proficiency with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning platforms.
• Ability to analyze data and assess the effectiveness of training programs.
• Familiarity with instructional design theory and adult learning principles.
• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Mot

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tax Jr. Analyst is responsible for assisting with basic tax-related tasks, including data entry, document preparation, and administrative support. This role works under close supervision and follows established procedures. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities Indirect Tax Compliance
• Prepare, analyze, and file indirect tax returns (U.S. Sales & Use Tax, Canada GST/HST, and VAT in South America), ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.
• Use automation tools such as Vertex Returns and Avalara, reconciling information against accounting records (SAP/Dynamics), accounts receivable, and accounts payable.
• Set up and maintain new tax jurisdictions as needed, including system configuration/parameterization.
• Manage the electronic filing of returns and payments, as well as manual preparation when automation is unavailable.
• Prepare property tax renditions and coordinate payment requests.
• Manage annual tax license renewals, ensuring timely compliance. Stakeholder Management
• Address internal and external inquiries related to indirect taxes (tax rate determination, taxability criteria, etc.).
• Support audit processes by compiling, validating, and providing required information.
• Maintain, analyze, and cleanse customer records, tax reports, and supporting documentation (exemption/resale certificates, export evidence, among others).
• Collaborate with finance, legal, and operations teams to ensure tax compliance and process improvements. Profile Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in Mexican VAT (knowledge of U.S., Canada, and/or South America is a plus).
• Experience with tax automation tools (Vertex and Avalara highly preferred).
• Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP and/or Dynamics.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, reconciliations, data analysis).
• Intermediate to advanced English level (B1/B2+) for professional communication.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
• Good communication and teamwork abilities. What we offer you
• Benefits Over law
• Saving found
• Training
• Christmas bonus over low
• Development plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. With our recent £1 million investment, our Ellon facility is now a Centre of Excellence, providing cutting-edge support for electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and turbo-compressors. We are looking for a skilled Gas Compressor Technician to join our team. As a Gas Compressor Technician, you will be working directly on the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of gas compressors. You will play a key role in ensuring that our customers' equipment is serviced to the highest standards, meeting industry specifications and maintaining operational efficiency Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:
• Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components
• Diagnosing and repairing mechanical faults in a variety of compressor types
• Precision fitting, machining, and assembly work as required
• Performing dynamic and functional testing on overhauled equipment
• Collaborating with engineering and quality teams to ensure compliance with technical specifications
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in line with HSE requirements To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Experience in the overhaul and maintenance of gas compressors or similar rotating equipment
• Proficiency in mechanical fitting, assembly, and fault diagnosis
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals
• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork
• Awareness of Health, Safety, and Environmental regulations What we offer you
• Competitive basic salary.
• 33 days of annual leave.
• Defined pension contribution.
• Confidential support and guidance through our Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle.
• Discounted Personal Car Leasing - available for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards to celebrate your dedication.
• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• Free and secure onsite parking, with electric charging facilities.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Résumé du poste Nous recherchons un Ingénieur QESH (Qualité, Environnement, Santé, Sécurité) pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'élaboration, de la mise en œuvre et du maintien des systèmes de gestion intégrés QESH afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire et l'amélioration continue des performances. Responsabilités du poste * Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique et les objectifs QESH en accord avec la stratégie du groupe. * Assurer la conformité avec les réglementations nationales et internationales en matière de qualité, d'environnement, de santé et de sécurité. * Développer, maintenir et améliorer le système de management intégré QESH (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001). * Réaliser des audits internes et externes QESH et suivre les plans d'actions correctives et préventives. * Analyser les incidents, accidents et non-conformités, et proposer des solutions pour éviter leur récurrence. * Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance QESH. * Animer et sensibiliser le personnel aux bonnes pratiques QESH par des formations et des communications régulières. * Gérer la documentation QESH (procédures, instructions, enregistrements). * Assurer la veille réglementaire QESH et anticiper les évolutions. * Participer à l'analyse des risques professionnels et environnementaux.
• Qualifications du poste * Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé en QESH, QHSE, ou domaine équivalent. * Minimum 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, idéalement dans un environnement industriel. * Solide connaissance des normes ISO 9001, ISO 14001 et ISO 45001. * Maîtrise de la réglementation française en matière de QESH. * Capacité à analyser, synthétiser et résoudre des problèmes complexes. * Excellentes compétences en communication, pédagogie et leadership. * Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l'organisation. * Maîtrise du Pack Office. * Anglais courant (écrit et oral) indispensable.
• What we offer you X Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Als Teil der Business Unit Water & Industrial der Sulzer AG vertreibt die Sulzer Flow Germany GmbH Produkte und Lösungen zur mechanischen und biologischen Reinigung von kommunalem und industriellen Abwasser. Als Service-Techniker sind Sie unser Gesicht zum Kunden. Auf Tages-Montagen untersuchen und lösen Sie auftretende Probleme in Kundenanlagen. Sie werden eingesetzt im Rahmen von Neumontagen, Inbetriebnahmen, Umbaumaßnahmen, Revisionen, Wartungen, Befundungen und Reparaturen von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen. In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Prüfung, Wartung & Reparatur von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen am Einbauort
• Neuinstallation von Pumpstationen, Hebeanlagen und Schaltanlagen am Einbauort
• Störungsanalysen
• Beratung unserer Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:
• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker/in (oder Elektroniker/in / Industriemechaniker/in oder vergleichbar)
• Idealerweise Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten (wird sonst als Weiterbildung durch uns durchgeführt)
• Erste Berufserfahrung als Servicetechniker/in von Vorteil
• Grundkenntnisse in Word und Excel
• Führerschein Klasse B
• Reisebereitschaft (ca. 80% Tagesreisen) What we offer you Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, sowie ausgezeichnete Zukunftsperspektiven.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Proporcionar diagnóstico, asistencia técnica, entrenamiento y servicios de mantenimiento para bombas y equipos relacionados en las instalaciones del cliente. El candidato puede estar basado en Lima o Arequipa. Funciones básicas
• Realizar la instalación, puesta en marcha y arranque de bombas y equipos asociados en las instalaciones del cliente.
• Realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y las inspecciones de las bombas para garantizar un desempeño y una fiabilidad óptimos.
• Diagnosticar y solucionar problemas mecánicos, eléctricos y del sistema de control con bombas y componentes relacionados.
• Utilizar documentación técnica, esquemas y herramientas de diagnóstico para identificar y resolver problemas de forma eficaz.
• Coordinarse con los clientes para programar visitas de servicio, comunicar actualizaciones de proyectos y abordar cualquier duda o pregunta.
• Proporcionar formación y asistencia in situ a los clientes sobre el funcionamiento correcto y los procedimientos de mantenimiento de las bombas.
• Colaborar con los equipos internos para escalar y resolver problemas técnicos complejos según sea necesario.
• Documentar las actividades de servicio, incluidas las tareas de mantenimiento, el uso de piezas y las interacciones con los clientes, de forma clara y organizada.
• Cumplir los protocolos de seguridad y las políticas de la empresa mientras se trabaja en las instalaciones del cliente.
• Actuar como enlace entre los clientes y la empresa para garantizar un alto nivel de satisfacción del cliente.
• Proveer de entrenamiento a los clientes en el mantenimiento y operación de las bombas
• Documentar oportunidades de desarrollo de servicios dentro de las cuentas clave de la compañía Condiciones de trabajo
• Este puesto requiere viajar con frecuencia a las instalaciones de los clientes, lo que puede implicar la exposición a diversas condiciones ambientales y exigencias físicas.
• Los ingenieros de servicio de campo pueden tener que trabajar en horarios flexibles, incluidas noches y fines de semana, para adaptarse a los horarios de los clientes y a las solicitudes de servicio urgentes Requisitos
• Licenciatura o experiencia equivalente en ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería electromecánica, ingeniería eléctrica o un campo relacionado.
• Inglés intermedio o avanzado, requerido.
• Experiencia demostrada trabajando con bombas, preferiblemente en un servicio de campo o mantenimiento.
• Conocimientos sólidos de principios mecánicos, dinámica de fluidos y sistemas eléctricos.
• Dominio de la localización y reparación de averías en equipos mecánicos y eléctricos.
• Excelentes dotes de comunicación, tanto verbal como escrita, con capacidad para interactuar profesionalmente con clientes y compañeros.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y gestionar el tiempo eficazmente a fin de cumplir los plazos de servicio.
• Disponibilidad para viajar a las instalaciones de los clientes cuando sea necesario, a veces con poca antelación.
• Permiso de conducir válido y un historial de conducción limpio.
• Fuerte compromiso con la seguridad y cumplimiento de las directrices de seguridad.
• Se valorarán las certificaciones en mantenimiento de bombas o campos técnicos pertinentes.
• La e xperiencia con clientes mineros de la Zona Sur de Perú es un plus.
• Aptitud del Anexo 16 y Anexo 16A .
• Tener una certificación PMI o conocimiento probado en gestión de proyectos es un plus What we offer you Annual bonus Health Insurance Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerla

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Bei Sulzer unterstützen wir Ihre kontinuierliche Entwicklung nicht nur durch Lernprogramme, sondern auch durch Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten am Arbeitsplatz. Treiben Sie Ihre Karriere proaktiv voran und entwickeln Sie Ihr Know-how weiter – so können Sie zu Lösungen beitragen, die unsere Leben sicherer, intelligenter und nachhaltiger gestalten. Sie suchen einen neuen Wirkungsbereich bei einem renomierten Unternehmen und sind bereit die berühmte Extrameile freiwillig mit Rückenwind zu gehen? Dann sind Sie bei uns im Team genau richtig: Als Area Sales Manager (m/w/d) betreuen Sie eigenverantwortlich Ihren bestehenden Kundenstamm im Bereich der Baustellenentwässerung und bauen diesen durch gezielte Vertriebsmaßnahmen weiter aus. Dabei werden Sie unterstützt durch unser Sulzer-internes Netzwerk, sowie durch unsere internen technischen Fachstellen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: In dieser herausfordernden Aufgabe verantworten Sie in den PLZ Gebieten 35000 -36999, 50000 bis 57999, 6 – 9 den Verkauf von Sulzer-Produkten aus dem Bereich der Baustellenentwässerung. Dies beinhaltet unter anderem:
• Beratung von Kunden und Interessenten im Verkaufsgebiet PLZ 35000 -36999, 50000 bis 57999, 6 – 9
• Erweiterung von Vertriebspartnerstruktur
• Betreuung der Bestandskunden und Akquise von Neukunden
• Persönliche technische Beratung und Betreuung großer Baustellen
• Prüfung von Kundenanforderungen auf technische Machbarkeit und die Entwicklung passender Lösungskonzepte
• Projektverfolgung, Auftragsverhandlung, Auftragsklärung
• Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung und Durchführung technischer Präsentationen und die Teilnahme an Verkaufsverhandlungen
• Unterstützung bei der Beobachtung und Analyse der Markt- und Wettbewerbssituation
• Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Umsetzung der kurz- und mittelfristigen Absatzziele
• Reklamationsbearbeitung in Zusammenarbeit mit Kundendienst
• Teilnahme an Messen, Tagungen und sonstigen dienstlichen Veranstaltungen
• Unterstützung bei Marketing- und Verkaufsfördermaßnahmen
• Ausbau und Stärkung der Marktposition und nicht zuletzt deutliche Steigerung der Umsätze
• Durchführung von Kundenschulungen Ihr Profil:
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Außendienst, idealerweise im technischen Vertriebsumfeld
• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Pumpentechnik und Zubehör sowie idealerweise im Tief- und Spezialtiefbau
• Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung

Dabei werden Sie unterstützt durch unser Sulzer-internes Netzwerk, sowie durch unsere internen technischen Fachstellen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Vertrieb aller Sulzer Produkte (Kreiselpumpen, Rührwerke, rotierende Maschinen in der Industriesparte etc,) in der der Region Süd-Westdeutschland (PLZ 6xxxx, 7xxxx). Vertriebsgebiet ist individuell je nach Wohnsitz leicht anpassbar in der angegebenen Vertriebsregion.
• Eigenverantwortliches Gebietsmanagement mit Verantwortung für den Auftragseingang (inkl. Großkundenbetreuung)
• Neukundenakquise sowie Pflege und Ausbau bestehender Kundenkontakte im Vertriebsgebiet
• Technische Ausarbeitung und Kalkulation von Angeboten sowie Verhandlungsführung bis zum Vertragsabschluss (unterstützt durch unseren Vertriebsinnendienst sowie unsere technischen Experten)
• Sicherstellen eines zielgerichteten Monitoring, Nachverfolgen und Forecasting der offenen Angebote
• Beobachten und Analysieren von Markt, Wettbewerb und Trends
• Durchführen von technischen Präsentation und Teilnahme an Messen Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich sein, sollten Sie mitbringen:
• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (idealerweise Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik etc.) bzw. alternativ eine gleichwertige Kombination aus Techniker-Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung
• Mindestens erste Vertriebserfahrung im Bereich erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte bzw. Dienstleistungen, bevorzugt im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau (Pumpen- / Rührwerken- Kenntnisse von Vorteil)
• Erfahrung aus Marktsegmenten wie Papier- und Zellstoffindustrie, industrielle Abwasserbehandlung, Düngemittel, Metalle, Bergbau, Lebensmittelindustrie, Biotreibstoffe oder Chemieindustrie sind von Vorteil
• Sehr hohe intrinsische Motivation etwas bewegen zu wollen
• Gute IT-Kenntnisse (MS Office, idealerweise SAP) sowie Social-Media-Affinität
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift)
• Hohe Reisebereitschaft (ca. 50% Reiseanteil) What we offer you Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, eine adäquate Vergütung sowie gute Zukunftsperspektiven. Treiben Sie Ihre Karriere proaktiv voran und entwickeln Sie Ihr Know-how weiter – so können Sie zu Lösungen beitragen, die unsere Leben sicherer, intelligenter und nachhaltiger gestalten. • Vertrieb aller Sulzer Produkte (Kreiselpumpen, Rührwerke, rotierende Maschinen in der Industriesparte etc,) in der der Region Süd-Westdeutschland (PLZ 6xxxx, 7xxxx). Vertriebsgebiet ist individuell je nach Wohnsitz leicht anpassbar in der angegebenen Vertriebsregion.

• Neukundenakquise sowie Pflege und Ausbau bestehender Kundenkontakte im Vertriebsgebiet
• Technische Ausarbeitung und Kalkulation von Angeboten sowie Verhandlungsführung bis zum Vertragsabschluss (unterstützt durch unseren Vertriebsinnendienst sowie unsere technischen Experten)
• Sicherstellen eines zielgerichteten Monitoring, Nachverfolgen und Forecasting der offenen Angebote
• Beobachten und Analysieren von Markt, Wettbewerb und Trends
