descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role El Ingeniero de Tendering es el responsable de centralizar y elaborar las propuestas técnico-económicas para los centros de servicio de Antofagasta, Santiago y Concepción. Su misión principal es transformar los hallazgos técnicos de los talleres en cotizaciones competitivas, rentables y rápidas. Este rol requiere una coordinación constante con Operaciones y Planificación para asegurar que los costos y plazos ofrecidos sean realistas, actuando como un facilitador crítico para mejorar la satisfacción del cliente interno y externo. Responsabilidades Principales
• Elaboración de Cotizaciones: Desarrollar presupuestos detallados para la reparación de bombas centrífugas y servicios en terreno, integrando costos de mano de obra, repuestos y servicios de terceros.
• Análisis Técnico-Económico: Realizar evaluaciones profundas de los requerimientos del cliente para asegurar que la solución propuesta sea técnicamente viable y económicamente óptima para Sulzer.
• Gestión de Proveedores: Buscar, evaluar y negociar con proveedores de servicios externos para mejorar los márgenes de los proyectos y reducir costos operativos.
• Coordinación Interna (S&OP): Trabajar estrechamente con los Supervisores de los Centros de Servicios y el Planificador para validar la disponibilidad de recursos y los tiempos de entrega (Lead Times) antes de enviar ofertas.
• Optimización de Planillas y Herramientas: Desarrollar y mantener herramientas de cálculo (Excel avanzado/Software) que permitan estandarizar los precios y acelerar el tiempo de respuesta al cliente.
• Uso de ERP (SAP): Ingresar y gestionar las cotizaciones en el sistema, asegurando la correcta carga de datos para la posterior conversión en órdenes de venta.
• Seguimiento y Mejora Continua: Analizar la tasa de éxito de las ofertas enviadas y proponer ajustes en la estrategia de precios para mejorar la competitividad en el mercado minero e industrial. Requisitos y Cualificaciones
• Educación: Ingeniero Civil o Ejecución Mecánica (Excluyente)
• Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia demostrable en áreas de servicio técnico, mantenimiento o ingeniería de propuestas para equipos rotativos de alta complejidad.
• Disponibilidad: Disponibilidad para viajar (30%) a los centros de Antofagasta, Santiago y Concepción para relevamiento técnico de proyectos complejos. Conocimientos Técnicos
• Sólidos conocimientos en sistemas de bombeo e hidráulica aplicada.
• Habilidad para interpretar planos de fabricación y hojas de datos técnicos.
• Experiencia en evaluación de daños y reportabilidad técnica.
• Capacidad de negociación con proveedores.
• Excel avanzado (macros y tablas dinámicas) para modelamiento de costos.
• Deseable manejo de SAP u otros ERP industriales. What we offer you Ofrecemos
• Salario y beneficios alineados con el mercado.
• Bono anual acorde a los objetivos corporativos y personales.
• Seguro de salud y dental. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Optimización de Planillas y Herramientas: Desarrollar y mantener herramientas de cálculo (Excel avanzado/Software) que permitan estandarizar los precios y acelerar el tiempo de respuesta al cliente.
• Uso de ERP (SAP): Ingresar y gestionar las cotizaciones en el sistema, asegurando la correcta carga de datos para la posterior conversión en órdenes de venta.
• Seguimiento y Mejora Continua: Analizar la tasa de éxito de las ofertas enviadas y proponer ajustes en la estrategia de precios para mejorar la competitividad en el mercado minero e industrial. Requisitos y Cualificaciones
• Educación: Ingeniero Civil o Ejecución Mecánica (Excluyente)
• Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia demostrable en áreas de servicio técnico, mantenimiento o ingeniería de propuestas para equipos rotativos de alta complejidad.
• Disponibilidad: Disponibilidad para viajar (30%) a los centros de Antofagasta, Santiago y Concepción para relevamiento técnico de proyectos complejos. Conocimientos Técnicos
• Sólidos conocimientos en sistemas de bombeo e hidráulica aplicada.
• Habilidad para interpretar planos de fabricación y hojas de datos técnicos.
• Experiencia en evaluación de daños y reportabilidad técnica.
• Capacidad de negociación con proveedores.

About the role Job Summary The Sr. (Field) Service Engineering Lead is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer locations. The role includes diagnosing malfunctions, performing maintenance, and providing on-site training to customer personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. The Service Engineer & Field Auditor is responsible for delivering on-site technical expertise, auditing customer installations, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience throughout the project lifecycle. By combining deep technical knowledge with a proactive and consultative approach, this role supports Sulzer’s commitment to reliability, performance, and customer satisfaction. Main tasks and responsibilities : Provide on-site technical support for commissioning, troubleshooting, failure analysis, and training in the operation and maintenance of Sulzer equipment. Audit customer installations and propose tailored solutions that optimize production, reliability, and efficiency. Translate customer needs into concrete recommendations (e.g., equipment upgrades, spare parts strategies, maintenance optimization, or process improvements). Ensure an optimal customer journey, from pre-sales to final delivery, with proactive, transparent, and passionate engagement at every stage. Proactively engage with customers, anticipate needs, and identify opportunities for value creation. Comply with Sulzer’s quality policies, safety standards, and environmental regulations on both company premises and customer sites. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the company’s processes, services, and team environment. Participate in and actively support company initiatives Initially, to adhere to Sulzer policies: Code of Business Conduct, Authority and Approval Procedures, Risk Management, Travel policies, etc… HSE Responsibilities :
• Ensure compliance with safety instructions, use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
• Proactive intervention in the event of a dangerous situation.
• Propose improvements in terms of safety. Competencies and behavior required (What strengths needed?) Management Competencies: Results driven, Proactive, reliable, and capable of working independently as well as in cross-functional teams. Leadership Competencies: Exceeding customer expectations, Ensuring accountability and integrity, Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication and interpersonal skills Profile: Mechanical engineer or equivalent technical background Industrial Competencies : Strong technical expertise in rotating equipment, commissioning, maintenance, and failure analysis. Ability to perform audits, analyze findings, and recommend practical, value-added solutions. Adaptability and problem-solving skills in challenging field environments. Professional experience: - Proven experience in field service engineering, technical support, or equipment auditing, ideally in fertilizers, or rotating equipment industries. - Local experience and local markets knowledge - Experience in customer-facing roles, with demonstrated ability to manage relationships across different stages of the project lifecycle. - Knowledge of safety and environmental standards applicable to industrial sites
• Strong technical skills
• Problem-solving and conflict management
• Open for changes, demonstrates willingness to change
• International in thinking and acting
• Autonomous

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We have an exciting opportunity for a Spare Parts Business Owner to strengthen our aftermarket operations and accelerate growth across France and international markets. In this pivotal commercial and operational role, you will drive the development of the spare parts portfolio, enhance customer satisfaction, and ensure strong economic and operational performance. If you combine business acumen with solid technical understanding - and enjoy working at the intersection of sales, operations, and product strategy - this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact. Based at our site in Saint-Quentin Your main tasks and responsibilities
• Manage the complete spare parts portfolio, including range definition, offer structure, pricing policy, and product life‑cycle decisions.
• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for spare parts in alignment with group policy, identify high‑potential business segments in collaboration with service teams.
• Define and implement pricing strategies, discount frameworks, and margin optimization measures, Lead initiatives aimed at improving profitability and competitiveness.
• Operational Coordination (≈50%): Collaborate closely with Logistics, Production, and Purchasing to ensure availability and reliability of spare parts.
• Optimize inventory levels, lead times, order processing, and prioritization, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives in forecasting, planning, and sourcing.
• Maintain KPIs and reporting including backlog, overdue backlog, lead time, workload, and warranty performance.
• Act as the central point of contact for domestic and international spare parts customers.
• Prepare monthly dashboards and drive progress plans based on performance insights. To succeed in this role, you will need
• English level B2.
• Understanding of industrial equipment such as pumps, rotating systems, turbines, or similar mechanical assemblies.
• Knowledge of spare parts characteristics, functions, constraints, compatibility, and substitution options.
• Ability to read and use technical documentation (drawings, BOMs, specifications, supplier references).
• Strong B2B business development experience in an industrial environment.
• Familiarity with spare parts sales processes: costing, quotation, negotiation, contracts, and T&Cs.
• Proficiency in pricing strategies, margin management, and bundled or kit‑based product offerings.
• Understanding of aftermarket service models (maintenance, retrofits, upgrades, parts). What we offer you
• A key role within a global and innovative industrial organization.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our team as Global Commercial Excellence Manager in our Water & Industry Business Unit and play a key role in driving growth and profitability. In this role, you will work closely with the Global Commercial Excellence team, contributing to global initiatives and strategies while driving pricing and value management, optimizing go-to-market models, and enabling sales teams with tools and insights for consistent execution within the Business Unit. The role can be based at any of our European Operations Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Collaboration with sales leadership and commercial excellence teams to co-create Go-to-Market strategies in your business unit by driving channel strategy, key account management, business partner enablement, account and territory planning in collaboration with the global commercial excellence team.
• Ensure adoption of the global sales process and methodology within your business unit by promoting best practices, monitoring compliance, and identifying areas for improvement. Take ownership of driving corrective actions and implementing enhancements in collaboration with the global Commercial Excellence teams
• Establish and standardize robust data and analytics frameworks to support consistent pipeline reviews and accurate forecasting across commercial teams. Ensure alignment of tools, metrics, and methodologies to drive visibility, accountability, and strategic decision-making
• Drive Pricing & Value Management by implementing pricing governance, value-based pricing, discount controls, and margin optimization working in tandem with the global commercial excellence team.
• Ensure accurate and structured customer data in CRM systems to enable effective segmentation, precise targeting, and full sales lifecycle management. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Master degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (MBA preferred) and 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial excellence, pricing, or sales operations.
• Knowledge of Pricing & Value Management, including value-based pricing, discount governance, and margin optimization.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, methodologies, and account management practices in B2B environments.
• Hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and data-driven forecasting.
• Advanced analytical skills with ability to perform analytics and build actionable insights.
• Excellent stakeholder management and change leadership skills to drive adoption across functions and regions. What we offer you
• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction. This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Votre mission ? Assurer le développement des parts de marché et, par extension, du chiffre d’affaires en tenant compte des objectifs commerciaux définis et des instructions de travail en vigueur. Pour ce faire, vous devrez:
• Etablir et déployer un plan d’actions commerciales dans le cadre de la stratégie d’entreprise et des objectifs commerciaux qui lui sont impartis.
• Fidéliser son portefeuille Clients.
• Prospecter de nouveaux marchés ou nouveaux Clients.
• Assurer la promotion des gammes de produits en détectant et en analysant les besoins des Clients et Prospects afin de leur proposer des solutions techniques appropriées.
• Communiquer de manière active avec les clients afin d’établir une relation de confiance et développer l’activité.
• Concevoir les études de faisabilité technique avec l’équipe des commerciaux sédentaires.
• Etablir et suivre les offres commerciales établies.
• Effectuer les relances appropriées.
• Négocier et rédiger les contrats en s’assurant des conditions de réalisation des commandes (prix, délais…).
• Suivre la réalisation des prestations techniques.
• Analyser les résultats des ventes. What we offer you Envie de mettre votre expertise au service de projets qui comptent vraiment ? Nous recherchons un Sales Engineer, pour le business Water. Au cœur de nos opérations, vous jouerez un rôle clé : analyser, sécuriser, optimiser et garantir un niveau d’excellence à toutes les étapes. Vous serez force de proposition sur des solutions innovantes, travaillerez au plus près du terrain et collaborerez avec des équipes passionnées, prêtes à relever les défis techniques et réglementaires de demain. Chez nous, vous trouverez :
• un environnement où votre expertise est valorisée
• une mission porteuse de sens et d’impact concret
• un terrain d’innovation permanent
• de vraies opportunités d’évolution dans un groupe en mouvement Si vous avez envie de progresser, d’apporter votre vision et de faire bouger les lignes, alors rejoignez-nous ! Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: Sie verantworten in dem Verkaufsgebiet Rheinland und Rheinland-Pfalz den Verkauf von Sulzer-Produkten aus dem Bereich der Abwassertechnik inklusive Serviceleistungen. Dies beinhaltet unter anderem:
• Außendienst im Bereich der kommunalen Wassertechnologie

• Prüfung von Kundenanforderungen auf technische Machbarkeit und die Entwicklung passen-der Lösungskonzepte
• Projektverfolgung, Auftragsverhandlung, Auftragsklärung und Projektbegleitung während der Abwicklungsphase
• Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung und Durchführung technischer Präsentationen und die Teil-nahme an Verkaufsverhandlungen
• Unterstützung bei der Beobachtung und Analyse der Markt- und Wettbewerbssituation
• Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Umsetzung der kurz- und mittelfristigen Absatzziele
• Teilnahme an Messen, Tagungen und sonstigen dienstlichen Veranstaltungen
• Unterstützung bei Marketing- und Verkaufsfördermaßnahmen
• Ausbau und Stärkung der Marktposition und nicht zuletzt deutliche Steigerung der Umsätze Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen: Folgende Voraussetzungen machen Sie zu unserem idealen Kandidaten:
• Sie haben eine abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung, z. B. als Techni-ker, Ingenieur der Elektrotechnik oder im Maschinenbau
• Sie sind ein Vertriebsprofi mit langjähriger Außendiensterfahrungen und nachweislichen Ver-triebserfolgen, sind belastbar und verfügen über eine ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz
• Sie verfügen möglichst über Vorkenntnisse im Vertrieb von beratungsintensiven Produkten, im besten Fall im Bereich der Pumpentechnik, bei Rührwerken und Zubehör
• Ihre Stärke ist, neben einer überzeugenden Verkaufsrhetorik, Verhandlungsgeschick und ab- schlussstarken Verhandlungsführung, die ausgeprägte Kunden- und Verkaufsorientierung
• Zusätzlich zu einer verantwortungsvollen, selbstständigen Arbeitsweise verfügen Sie über die Fähigkeit, sich selbst zu organisieren und zu motivieren
• Im sicheren Umgang mit der deutschen Sprache, durch Ihr Auftreten und Ihre ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten schaffen Sie es, Kunden zu begeistern
• Einen Wohnort und nutzbare Kundenkontakte im Vertriebsgebiet können Sie vorweisen
• Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, soziale Kompetenz und die Bereitschaft zu flexibler Reisetätigkeit im Verkaufsgebiet (teilweise mit Übernachtungen) runden Ihr Profil ab

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is looking for a driven and commercially minded Account Manager to grow and develop our relationships with major Water Utility providers across the Southern Regions. You’ll manage an established customer base, identify new opportunities within those accounts, and take ownership for revenue growth across both Capital and Service & Aftermarket portfolios. This is a strategic, customer-facing role for someone who thrives on autonomy, consultative selling, and long-term partnership building — with a genuine opportunity to progress into leadership as the account base grows. Key Responsibilities
• Managing and developing existing Water Utility accounts across the Southern Regions.
• Identifying and converting new business opportunities within those accounts across Capital equipment and Aftermarket services.
• Acting as the primary point of contact, building strong technical and commercial relationships at multiple stakeholder levels.
• Owning the number: forecasting, pipeline management, and delivering against growth targets.
• Working closely with internal Engineering, Service, and Commercial teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Growing these accounts to a scale where you will have the opportunity to develop and lead your own team in future. What We’re Looking For
• Experience as an Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or Business Development professional within Water Utilities, Engineering, Pumps, Rotating Equipment, or related industrial sectors.
• A strong understanding of the Water sector’s operational and regulatory environment.
• Proven ability to grow accounts, uncover opportunities, and close technical solutions.
• Confident communicator with the ability to build trust and credibility.
• Commercially sharp, organised, and capable of managing a complex regional territory.
• Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable owning both the customer relationship and commercial outcomes. What we offer you
• A competitive base salary
• An annual scheme that rewards company success and individual impact, featuring significant multipliers for exceptional results and role-modeling our core values
• Company car or allowance, including EV options.
• 33 days annual leave and home-working flexibility with full diary autonomy.
• Defined contribution pension scheme and Long Service Awards.
• Continuous professional development through our dedicated Learning Pathways.
• Costco membership, discounted car leasing, and a wide range of retail/lifestyle discounts. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise innovante, reconnue pour son savoir‑faire et ses équipes passionnées ? Vous aimez être au cœur des projets techniques, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, production et engineering ? Ce poste est fait pour vous ! En tant qu’ Ingénieur Technico-commercial sédentaire / Indoor Tendering Sales Engineer , vous jouez un rôle clé dans la réussite commerciale : vous préparez, coordonnez et optimisez les offres qui feront la différence auprès de nos clients. Au sein de l’équipe chiffrage, vous êtes le pilier central de la phase avant‑vente , garantissant la pertinence technique, la compétitivité et la fiabilité de chaque offre. Votre rôle :

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role At Sulzer, we keep the world’s water flowing. As a global engineering powerhouse, we design, maintain, and service mission‑critical pumping equipment that supports drinking water supply, wastewater networks, flood control, industrial utilities, and energy infrastructure across the planet. Across Ireland, demand for world‑class Water & Wastewater solutions has never been stronger. Internally, Ireland is recognised as one of the fastest‑growing strategic markets for Sulzer—so we’re investing. This brand‑new role is key to our growth plans, and we’re looking for a commercially driven Sales Engineer to help us strengthen our Service & Aftermarket success nationwide. In this role, you’ll be the technical and commercial bridge between customers and our market‑leading engineering capability. You will:
• Develop and grow Service & Aftermarket business across municipal Water & Wastewater markets and selected industrial sectors
• Build strong, long‑lasting relationships with utilities, contractors, consultants, and framework partners
• Identify opportunities for maintenance, repairs, upgrades, retrofits, replacement pumping solutions, and performance optimisation
• Conduct site visits, troubleshoot customer challenges, and recommend the right engineering solution
• Work closely with our local service centre and wider Sulzer network to deliver outstanding customer experience
• Drive revenue and margin growth through proactive account management and strong pipeline development If you enjoy combining technical expertise with commercial impact, this role gives you the best of both. What you bring
• Technical background in mechanical, electrical, water, wastewater, or related engineering disciplines
• Proven experience in a field‑based sales, service, or customer‑facing engineering role
• Strong communication skills with the ability to influence, challenge, and build trust
• A proactive, self‑motivated mindset—and the ambition to help build a high‑growth territory
• Understanding of the municipal water sector is highly beneficial. What we offer you
• A fully remote, home‑based role where you manage your own schedule and workload
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Car or Car Allowance
• 26 Days holiday (exclusive of bank holidays)
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Employee Assistance Program
• Company Sick pay scheme
• Company Income Continuance Scheme Although this is a remote, home‑based role, candidates must be permanently based in the Republic of Ireland and fully permitted to work in Ireland . We cannot offer visa sponsorship for this position. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met ongeveer 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer als Workshop Technician (monteur) en help mee om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Het analyseren, reviseren en repareren van pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in onze werkplaats te Maastricht-Airport
• Machinale werkzaamheden
• Opstellen van analyserapporten
• Uitvoeren van testen in de proefstand Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig:
• Succesvol afgeronde technische mbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar
• Ervaring met montage van of service aan Rotating Equipment is een pré maar geen must
• Affiniteit met elektrotechniek is een pré
• Technisch inzicht, je bent een echte sleutelaar
• Je beschikt over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen
• Je bent accuraat en werkt gestructureerd
• Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is een must, Engelse taal is een pré
• Je beschikt over enige computerervaring (Word, Excel)
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling What we offer you Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Jaarlijkse prestatiebonus
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow in Maastricht als Field Service Technician (monteur) Rotating Water Equipment en help onze service in de Benelux naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol word je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Preventief en correctief onderhoud aan onze producten: pompen, mixers en beluchters in afvalwater- en industriële toepassingen op locatie bij onze klanten in de Benelux. Dit betreft hoofdzakelijk mechanische en deels elektrotechnische en besturingstechnische werkzaamheden
• De uitvoering van renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten
• Als visitekaartje van Sulzer denk je proactief mee over potentële verbeteringen en commerciële kansen en ben je onze belangrijkste ambassadeur bij onze klanten
• Consignatie- / wachtdienst en af en toe een externe overnachting zijn voor jou geen probleem Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie heb je nodig:
• Een technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van werktuigbouwkunde
• Ervaring met rotating equipment in een industri ë le setting is een pre
• Ervaring en affiniteit met elektrotechniek en PLC/ meet- en regeltechniek inzake toepassingen in (industriële) pompen/ rotating equipment is een pre
• Voldoende kennis van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift is een must
• (Basis) kennis van de Franse en Engelse taal is zeer gewenst
• Uitstekend ontwikkelde communicatieve vaardigheden
• Affiniteit met een technisch commerciële serviceorganisatie
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling
• Een geldig rijbewijs CE/ C1E is een pre . What we offer you Jouw Arbeidsvoorwaarden:
• Sulzer biedt je een meer dan goed salaris inclusief vakantiegeld
• Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus
• Een royaal aantal vakantie- en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)
• Een volledig ingerichte servicewagen, mobiele telefoon en laptop Locatie: Onze activiteiten vinden plaats in de Benelux en worden aangestuurd vanuit ons Service Center in Maastricht-Airport, waar je indien nodig aanwezig kunt zijn. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in Nederland en België en is in deze regio met ongeveer 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer als (Technisch) Werkvoorbereider en help mee in onze verdere groei en om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Voorbereiden van onderhouds- en modificatiewerkzaamheden aan de installaties/machines of onderdelen hiervan
• Opstellen van werkpakketten inclusief tekeningen, materialen, veiligheidsinstructies en planningen
• Coördineren van werkzaamheden met klanten, eigen Field Service Engineers, Workshop Engineers en externe partijen
• Aanvragen en beoordelen van offertes van leveranciers en aannemers
• Bewaken van voortgang, kosten en kwaliteit tijdens de voorbereiding en uitvoering
• Ondersteunen bij storingsanalyses en het implementeren van structurele verbeteringen
• Zorgen voor naleving van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsnormen (bijv. VCA, ISO, ATEX)
• Beheren van technische documentatie en onderhoudsplannen in het onderhoudsbeheersysteem of administratie. Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig :
• MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar
• Aantoonbare ervaring in een industriële omgeving (bijv. industriële/communale waterzuiveringen, procesindustrie; chemie, food, pharma, metaal, energie)
• Kennis van industriële installaties, onderhoudsprocessen en technische regelgeving
• Ervaring met onderhoudsbeheersystemen en MS Office
• Bekend met LEAN, TPM of andere verbetermethodieken is een pré
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatorisch sterk What we offer you Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden: Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Een prestatiebonusregeling
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT) Locatie: Je werkt je samen met je collega’s vanuit onze locatie in Maastricht- Airport en af en toe ook bij onze klanten in de Benelux. We werken in onze moderne locatie met eigen werkplaats in een informele sfeer op een professionele manier met elkaar samen. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in Nederland en België en is in deze regio met ongeveer 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer als (Technisch) Werkvoorbereider en help mee in onze verdere groei en om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Voorbereiden van onderhouds- en modificatiewerkzaamheden aan de installaties/machines of onderdelen hiervan
• Opstellen van werkpakketten inclusief tekeningen, materialen, veiligheidsinstructies en planningen
• Coördineren van werkzaamheden met klanten, eigen Field Service Engineers, Workshop Engineers en externe partijen
• Aanvragen en beoordelen van offertes van leveranciers en aannemers
• Bewaken van voortgang, kosten en kwaliteit tijdens de voorbereiding en uitvoering
• Ondersteunen bij storingsanalyses en het implementeren van structurele verbeteringen
• Zorgen voor naleving van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsnormen (bijv. VCA, ISO, ATEX)
• Beheren van technische documentatie en onderhoudsplannen in het onderhoudsbeheersysteem of administratie. Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig :
• MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar
• Aantoonbare ervaring in een industriële omgeving (bijv. industriële/communale waterzuiveringen, procesindustrie; chemie, food, pharma, metaal, energie)
• Kennis van industriële installaties, onderhoudsprocessen en technische regelgeving
• Ervaring met onderhoudsbeheersystemen en MS Office
• Bekend met LEAN, TPM of andere verbetermethodieken is een pré
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatorisch sterk What we offer you Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden: Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Een prestatiebonusregeling
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT) Locatie: Je werkt je samen met je collega’s vanuit onze locatie in Maastricht- Airport en af en toe ook bij onze klanten in de Benelux. We werken in onze moderne locatie met eigen werkplaats in een informele sfeer op een professionele manier met elkaar samen. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van o.m. pompen, roerwerken, vermalers en beluchting in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met bijna 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow in Maastricht als Field Service Technician (monteur) Flow Equipment Midden-Zuid NL en help onze service in de Benelux naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol word je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Preventief en correctief onderhoud aan onze producten: pompen, mixers en beluchters in afvalwater- en industriële toepassingen op locatie bij onze klanten in de Benelux. Dit betreft hoofdzakelijk mechanische en deels elektrotechnische en besturingstechnische werkzaamheden
• De uitvoering van renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten
• Als visitekaartje van Sulzer denk je proactief mee over potentële verbeteringen en commerciële kansen en ben je onze belangrijkste ambassadeur bij onze klanten
• Consignatie- / wachtdienst en af en toe een externe overnachting zijn voor jou geen probleem Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie heb je nodig:
• Een technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van werktuigbouwkunde
• Ervaring met rotating equipment in een industri ë le setting is een pre
• Ervaring en affiniteit met elektrotechniek en PLC/ meet- en regeltechniek inzake toepassingen in (industriële) pompen/ rotating equipment is een pre
• Voldoende kennis van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift is een must
• (Basis) kennis van de Franse en Engelse taal is zeer gewenst
• Uitstekend ontwikkelde communicatieve vaardigheden
• Affiniteit met een technisch commerciële serviceorganisatie
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling
• Een geldig rijbewijs CE/ C1E is een pre What we offer you Jouw Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Sulzer biedt je een meer dan goed salaris inclusief vakantiegeld
• Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus
• Een royaal aantal vakantie- en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)
• Een volledig ingerichte servicewagen, mobiele telefoon en laptop Locatie: Onze activiteiten vinden plaats in de Benelux en worden aangestuurd vanuit ons Service Center in Maastricht-Airport, waar je indien nodig aanwezig kunt zijn. Je vertrekt naar onze klantlocaties veelal vanuit thuis. Je bent woonachtig in de regio Midden NL (Nijmegen, Breda, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Eindhoven) of Zuid NL. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Position Summary: This role supports the engineering, configuration, and validation of High Stator Turbo (HST) Compressors within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department. Responsibilities include developing sales‑order‑specific mechanical and automation designs, reviewing electromechanical schematics, and creating the bill of materials (BOM) within the ERP system. The position collaborates with cross‑functional teams (Project Managers, Tendering, Sales, and Manufacturing, to prepare technical submittals) ensure accurate order configuration, and release finalized engineering packages to Production. The role also provides hands‑on mechanical support, including product testing and troubleshooting Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
• Review project scope and specifications and hold hand-off meetings as needed to ensure team alignment
• Prepare and manage submittal packages to ensure timely, accurate customer approvals
• Learn the HST products, serve as the SME, and bring that expertise to the local team
• Assist in designing and building HST infrastructure in the USA
• Support Tendering Activities
• Support ORE Activities as needed
• Train HST team as necessary.
• Support Procurement and MRB, Quality Assurance Team
• Act as liaison between other teams in Finland and China
• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the SAP ERP system
• Review and verify mechanical drawings and BOMs prepared by other ORE team members to ensure accuracy and compliance
• Design motor control electrical schematics by interpreting specifications, quotes, purchase orders, and company scope worksheets.
• Enter parts and create assemblies of motor control designs in the ERP system for procurement and electrical production assembly
• Support the Project Engineer with motor control design documentation for sales order submittals.
• Review sales-order-specific electrical schematics (drawings and BOMs) created by other ORE team members
• Provide electrical review and support to other departments assigned by the ORE Manager
• Support field service technicians during installation and acceptance of products
• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as necessary Education & Experience: Required: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field (or equivalent practical experience with rotating equipment, industrial controls, or electromechanical systems)
• 3 – 7 years of experience in mechanical, electromechanical, or automation engineering.
• Experience with rotating machinery, compressors, turbomachinery, motors, VFDs, or similar high‑speed equipment preferred.
• Hands‑on experience reading or generating mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and BOMs.
• Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred).
• Experience supporting manufacturing, production, or test environments.
• Understanding of industrial automation, motor control, or electromechanical system integration is a plus.
• Ability to collaborate across cross‑functional and international teams. Skills: Required: CAD, SolidWorks, Siemens TIA, HMI In-touch Experience in 3D modelling and drafting SAP System Experience Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook,

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le gestionnaire du centre de services est chargé de superviser une équipe de professionnels techniques dans la prestation d'un soutien technique aux clients. Ce rôle assure l'exécution efficace des opérations de service, règle les problèmes techniques complexes et maintient un niveau élevé de satisfaction de la clientèle. Le gestionnaire joue un rôle clé dans l'établissement des objectifs de l'équipe, la gestion du rendement et le respect des normes de service. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux gestionnaires de personnes de 4 ans et plus à des rôles d'experts expérimentés. Résumé : Responsable des activités dans notre service Garantie et pièces détachées. Fonctions essentielles :
• Aider notre clientèle, y compris nos représentants, distributeurs et centres de services agréés, avec leurs besoins techniques et de service
• Dirige le tir initial sur le terrain et accélère le soutien technique et technique au besoin
• Assurer la satisfaction et la fidélité de la clientèle en consultant, en aidant et en réglant les demandes, les demandes et les plaintes, tant verbalement que par écrit
• Gère les appels entrants de manière efficace et efficiente par le biais d'un service à la clientèle proactif et possède les connaissances et la capacité de traiter les appels d'enquête générale, ainsi que les appels techniques
• Exposer des compétences interpersonnelles fortes, est positif, agréable, respectueux et axé sur le client
• Crée une expérience satisfaisante pour le client en utilisant des techniques professionnelles de service à la clientèle, en personnalisant et en mettant l'accent sur la valeur ajoutée
• Résoudre les questions/problèmes de manière efficace et efficiente
• Initie les autorisations de retour et crée le dossier client
• Effectue des déterminations de garantie basées sur des évaluations effectuées par des rapports d'évaluation interne et externe du centre de service agréé
• Logs rapports aux unités de fabrication pour les réclamations de garantie de recharge arrière
• Accélérer le service et les commandes de garantie à travers le système jusqu'à la fin
• Suivre les procédures de qualité selon la norme ISO 9001.
• Obligations de sécurité:
• Tous les employés comprennent et sont en mesure d'expliquer la structure et les objectifs du SBP.
• Tous les employés suivent les règles de sécurité.
• Tous les employés ont « le droit et le devoir d'intervenir » en cas de problème de sécurité. En outre, l'acceptation d'une intervention devrait être acceptée de manière positive car elle aurait pu prévenir un accident.
• Tous les employés sont tenus de se conformer à toutes les instructions de travail, à toutes les politiques et à toutes les affiches ou instructions affichées concernant la sécurité, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'utilisation correcte des EPI requis en tout temps. Responsabilités secondaires : · Résoudre les plaintes des clients · Exécute d'autres fonctions selon l'affectation Responsabilités en matière de surveillance · Aucune Qualifications · Diplôme collégial de préférence ou expérience professionnelle égale · 5 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle · Fortes compétences en informatique, y compris mais non limitées à Windows XP / Microsoft Office / Utilisation du Web · Compétences organisationnelles supérieures · Capacité à plusieurs tâches, respect des calendriers et des échéances · Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et de travailler en équipe · Fond mécanique dans l'équipement rotatif a plus Exigences physiques: · Levée jusqu'à 25 livres · Dactylographie Ce que nous vous offrons
• Temps libre payé concurrentiel
• 12 jours fériés payés par année
• Programme de bonus annuel
• Avantages médicaux, dentaires et de vision complets
• Société d'assurance-vie payée à court terme et à long terme
• 6% 401K ou Roth Company Match avec Vesting Immédiate
• Cotisations à la sécurité de retraite versées par l'entreprise après 1 an d'emploi
• Remboursement des frais de scolarité/assistance éducative
• Remboursement trimestriel de gymnastique Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme un employeur de premier plan en 2026

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Expert is responsible for providing technical expertise during the sales process, supporting the development of tailored solutions for clients, and ensuring alignment between customer needs and product capabilities. This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Role Overview In this role, you will actively shape and develop the Metals market in Mexico by working closely with end customers, EPCs, and distributors to create tailored technical and commercial solutions. Leveraging our portfolio of pumps, mixers, and water treatment solutions, you will help customers improve process efficiency, reliability, and sustainability , in line with the strategic objectives of the Flow Division within the Water & Industry business unit. Through regular customer engagement, strong technical understanding, and personal networking, you will build long‑term partnerships and position Sulzer as a trusted solution provider across the Mexican metals industry Key Responsibilities Market Development & Sales Strategy
• Implement and execute the sales strategy for the Metals segment in Mexico.
• Actively develop the market by identifying new opportunities, key accounts, and strategic projects.
• Build a sustainable pipeline that supports long‑term growth and profitability. Customer, EPC & Distributor Engagement
• Establish and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with customers, EPCs, and selected distributors.
• Ensure early involvement in project development phases to influence technical solutions and specifications.
• Act as the main technical and commercial interface between Sulzer and assigned customers. Solution Development
• Analyze customer processes and operational challenges.
• Leverage deep knowledge of the Sulzer portfolio to develop customized, competitive, and value‑adding solutions.
• Demonstrate clear customer value through improved performance, reliability, lifecycle cost reduction, and sustainability. Proposals & Contract Management
• Prepare and manage formal technical and commercial proposals, ensuring clarity in scope, pricing, delivery, and contractual terms.
• Coordinate internally with engineering, product management, service, and operations teams to deliver accurate and competitive offers.
• Support negotiations and order intake in line with margin and risk guidelines. Market & Trend Monitoring
• Monitor market developments, customer investment plans, and competitor activity.
• Translate market intelligence into targeted sales and marketing actions.
• Contribute to segment strategy, forecasting, and opportunity planning. Success in This Role Looks Like
• Strong presence and credibility in the Mexican metals industry
• Early positioning in EPC‑driven projects
• Consistent opportunity creation and conversion
• Long‑term customer partnerships and repeat business
• Profitable growth aligned with Flow Division strategy What we offer you NA Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste** En tant que Technicien de Service (Field Service Technician) chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance préventive et corrective, ainsi que du dépannage de nos équipements sur les sites de nos clients. Vous assurerez un service de haute qualité, garantissant la satisfaction client et le bon fonctionnement de nos produits. Responsabilités** * Effectuer des interventions de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les pompes, agitateurs et autres équipements Sulzer Ensival Moret. * Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements, proposer des solutions techniques et les mettre en œuvre. * Réaliser des installations et mises en service d'équipements neufs. * Former les clients à l'utilisation et à la maintenance de premier niveau des produits. * Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés et précis (rapports techniques, feuilles de temps, etc.). * Gérer son stock de pièces détachées et outils de manière autonome. * Assurer un reporting régulier à son responsable et aux équipes internes (ventes, support technique). * Respecter scrupuleusement les règles de sécurité, les procédures internes et les normes en vigueur. * Participer à la veille technologique et à l'amélioration continue des processus.
• Qualifications** * Diplôme de niveau Bac+2/3 en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique, ou équivalent. * Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en maintenance d'équipements industriels, idéalement dans le domaine des pompes ou des machines tournantes. * Solides connaissances en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel. * Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques (mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques). * Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure. * Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit d'équipe. * Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et au service client. * Permis de conduire B valide (déplacements fréquents sur le territoire national). * Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral) indispensable. * Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus.
• What we offer you . Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Responsabilités** * Effectuer des interventions de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les pompes, agitateurs et autres équipements Sulzer Ensival Moret. * Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements, proposer des solutions techniques et les mettre en œuvre. * Réaliser des installations et mises en service d'équipements neufs. * Former les clients à l'utilisation et à la maintenance de premier niveau des produits. * Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés et précis (rapports techniques, feuilles de temps, etc.). * Gérer son stock de pièces détachées et outils de manière autonome. * Assurer un reporting régulier à son responsable et aux équipes internes (ventes, support technique). * Respecter scrupuleusement les règles de sécurité, les procédures internes et les normes en vigueur. * Participer à la veille technologique et à l'amélioration continue des processus. 
• Qualifications** * Diplôme de niveau Bac+2/3 en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique, ou équivalent. * Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en maintenance d'équipements industriels, idéalement dans le domaine des pompes ou des machines tournantes. * Solides connaissances en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel. * Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques (mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques). * Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure. * Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit d'équipe. * Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et au service client. * Permis de conduire B valide (déplacements fréquents sur le territoire national). * Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral) indispensable. * Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus. 
• What we offer you . Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The (Field) Service Team Lead is responsible for supervising professional-level employees in the field service team. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Ihre Aufgaben
• Fachliche Führung und Koordination der Servicetechniker sowie Begleitung der lokalen Servicekoordinatoren bei regionalen Themen
• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen operativen Servicebetriebs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Einsatzplanung

• Erfahrung in industriellen Anwendungsbereichen, idealerweise in der Pumpen‑, Abwasser‑, Rechen‑, Filter‑ oder Gebläsetechnik
• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, Qualitätsanforderungen und technische Regelwerke
• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations‑ und Teamfähigkeit
• Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands (bis ca. 30 %)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Résumé du poste** En tant que Technico-commercial sédentaire chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez un élément clé de notre équipe commerciale, chargé de développer et de maintenir d'excellentes relations avec nos clients, tout en assurant la promotion et la vente de nos solutions techniques. Responsabilités** * Gérer un portefeuille de clients existants et le cas échéant, prospecter de nouveaux clients par téléphone et par e-mail. * Analyser les besoins techniques des clients et leur proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits (pompes, agitateurs, etc.). * Élaborer des offres commerciales détaillées et techniques, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de production. * Négocier les conditions commerciales et conclure les ventes. * Assurer le suivi des commandes, de la réception à la livraison, en coordination avec les services internes. * Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients et les conseiller sur l'utilisation de nos produits. * Participer à l'élaboration de la stratégie commerciale et au reporting des activités. * Maintenir une veille technologique et concurrentielle sur le marché.
• Qualifications** * Diplôme technique (Bac+2 à Bac+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou équivalent. * Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en vente de produits techniques industriels, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes ou équipements rotatifs. * Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. * Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office). * Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe. * Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et proactivité. * La maîtrise de l'anglais technique est un plus.
• What we offer you ; Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The jobholder will work closely with Regional Head of Sales, Segment heads, and their own team to drive Strategic and Tactical initiatives (GDP), manage the marketing team, ensure integration and utilization of business optimization tools, and generally support the sales management team. The position will ensure GDP initiatives are organized and executed monthly and facilitate the data collection of the required TTI’s. Regional marketing will prioritize activities that are in alignment with these initiatives. Business excellence processes and tools (Salesforce, CPQ, etc.) will be supported by driving adoption and execution of the tools monitoring utilization and escalating any roadblocks or lack of adoption issues as well as overseeing new product order entry management. A background in LEAN/VBSS or similar is considered beneficial to identify opportunities to simplify business processes especially from an internal efficiency and/or customer perspective. Targeted location: Within traveling distance of Easley, SC Main accountabilities and tasks
• Organize and support the GDP initiatives
• Partner with the segment heads to develop, track, and report on the various action plans
• Work with business analyst personnel to automate the collection of TTI data
• Collect and communicate performance data, market insights, and opportunities to assist sales teams and services (collect KPI’s, structure data, visual management, etc.)
• Coordinate Regional marketing managers’ activities
• Combine marketing promotion, analytics, and GDP/initiatives together to coordinate and focus resources
• Oversee management of marketing communication and Marketing Initiatives
• Support channel partners development programs
• Support sales leadership to create and manage the communication flow on the main social internal and external
• Focus on execution and waste removal in business processes, primarily in Sales and Service activities Drive Sales Support department providing data intelligence to sales leaders to facilitate businesses.
• Organize and oversee data mining, accessibility to data in various systems (ERPs)
• Management level dashboard creation and maintenance
• Support Business Intelligence data collection and Analysis.
• Coordinate with other functions that SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf and other main systems are developed according to business requirements.
• Liaise with Finance and with Strategy (Budgeting Process, by Segment, by Region, by Product)
• Regular Pipeline Review and CRM maintenance
• Trainer for SalesForce
• Rolling Forecast management, both for OI (Order Intake) and Sales
• Partner with sales leaders and corporate business development personnel to track timely execution of key tasks
• Assist with preparation for corporate presentations and reports What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program
• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
• Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance
• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting
• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment
• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role leads and develops Direct and Regional Sales Managers, implements sales strategies, and supports the Pulp and Paper market. This position has direct accountability for all PPI sales activities, both direct and indirect, in the USA. This role will necessitate effective collaboration and coordination with operations, procurement, quality, and other relevant departments. Essential Functions:
• Achieve sales growth targets by developing and executing annual sales plans.
• Lead the RSM’s, monitor individual performance against goals, and provide coaching, mentoring, and training.
• Responsible for ownership and personal management of the direct corporate accounts. Develops trust and solid partnerships with Corporate and OEM accounts. Negotiates and manages agreements with both.
• Engages collaboratively with technical associations and partners with leading technical universities.
• Analyze and identify market trends, and the competition to jointly develop strategic plans for expanding sales of new and existing products.
• Travel, as necessary within the assigned territory. Other Duties:
• Must possess superior presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.
• Experience with multiple direct reports and a proven history of leading teams.
• Superior analytical, strategic thinking, leadership skills.
• Demonstrated success through focus, good judgment, and decision-making.
• Keen sense of teamwork and business goal alignment.
• Well-developed sense of urgency to deliver results.
• Excellent relationship and people skills. Supervisory Duties:
• Network of Regional Sales Managers and Application Specialists covering the PPI market. Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a similar technical degree preferred. MBA is a plus.
• At least 10-15 years’ regional sales experience.
• At least 5 years people management experience. What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Bajo la posición de Orden entry & tendering, el Especialista en Entrada de Órdenes es responsable de ingresar, gestionar y dar seguimiento a todas las órdenes de materiales y servicios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares establecidos, así como de las directivas, procedimientos de trabajo y políticas vigentes de la compañía. Adicionalmente, colabora en la generación de cotizaciones, brinda apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas y, previa solicitud, realiza otras tareas relacionadas acordes a su función. Responsabilidades:
• Gestionar los pedidos de clientes desde la recepción de la orden hasta su correcta facturación.
• Asegurar la conciliación de los pedidos recibidos con las cotizaciones previamente emitidas o con las listas de precios vigentes.
• Ejecutar y controlar todas las funciones asociadas a la entrada de pedidos y facturación, incluyendo aquellos relacionados con la fabricación de productos para clientes.
• Realizar la entrada de pedidos en SAP, manteniendo comunicación permanente y coordinando la planificación con el equipo de ventas, hasta su facturación.
• Elaborar cotizaciones comerciales, asegurando el correcto uso de precios, condiciones comerciales y políticas internas.
• Brindar apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas, incluyendo gestión documental, actualización de información en sistemas, apoyo en informes y coordinación interna.
• Elaborar y presentar informes de ventas periódicos.
• Demostrar habilidad para seguir métodos y procedimientos establecidos, trabajo en equipo, criterio profesional, atención al detalle y capacidad de comunicación clara y concisa, tanto oral como escrita.
• Asegurar la correcta calidad de la información comercial y contractual en SAP, cumpliendo con políticas internas y estándares de compliance.
• Apoyar análisis básicos de ventas, backlog y desempeño comercial, contribuyendo a la mejora continua de los procesos.
• Coordinar con fábrica y logística para validar fechas de entrega, disponibilidad y condiciones de despacho
• Colaborar en iniciativas de mejora continua en procesos de order entry, cotizaciones y tendering. Requisitos:
• Técnico de Nivel Superior o Universitario
• 5 años mínimos de experiencia previa contrastable en posición similar
• Tener habilidades sociales y capacidad para resolver problemas en un grupo de trabajo
• Manejo de idiomas español e inglés, competencias completas.
• Dedicación (aprender, adaptar, gestionar), Disposición y Compromiso.
• Buen conocimiento del entorno informático, incluido SAP y la suite Office. What we offer you Beneficios:
• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.
• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.
• Seguro médico y dental. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction. This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Responsabilidades:
• Responsable de realizar presentaciones a los clientes con el fin de asesorar, formar y promocionar nuestros productos y servicios, relacionados con los procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales (bombas y mixers sumergibles, aireadores, trituradoras, tamices, decantadores, filtros).
• Trabajar de manera multidisciplinaria con los otros departamentos para preparar planes de ventas y ofertas, garantizando la precisión técnica y financiera.
• Trabajar con el equipo de ventas en general para identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de mercado.
• Establecer y mantener relaciones efectivas con los clientes, comprender sus necesidades y promover la comprensión por parte del cliente de nuestra oferta de productos, sistemas y/o servicios.
• Crear valor agregado para el cliente y, a continuación, alinearse para ofrecer una solución, garantizando una experiencia positiva para el cliente.
• Preparar planes de ventas y realizar revisiones periódicas de la situación para mantener los volúmenes de pedidos, y gestionar los procesos administrativos de ventas.
• Promocionar activamente todo el portafolio de productos Sulzer en los mercados asignados.
• Alcanzar o superar los objetivos de venta acordados para el segmento o región.
• Desarrollar e implementar estrategias comerciales consistentes con los objetivos de Sulzer.
• Preparar y acompañar activamente las ofertas para los clientes en las regiones y segmentos asignados.
• Responsable por la proyección precisa de ventas para su región y cuentas relacionadas.
• Revisar órdenes de compra, contratos, términos y condiciones para las cuentas y clientes asignados.
• Preparación de ofertas en coordinación con el departamento de ofertas y propuestas, garantizando que se cumplen los aspectos técnicos y financieros adecuados, incluidos los precios y las condiciones comerciales.
• Visitas constantes a los clientes para desarrollo de nuevos mercados.
• Visitas con clientes importantes y buscar prospectos potenciales. Requisitos:
• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia como ingeniero de ventas y/o ingeniero de aplicaciones en el área de gestión de agua urbana y/o industrial.
• Titulado en ingeniería industrial, mecánica, hidráulica o afín.
• Experiencia en ventas directas e indirectas a clientes industriales.
• Conocimientos sobre procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales, bombas centrífugas y motores eléctricos.
• Cartera de clientes/relaciones existentes en los mercados de industrias y aguas municipales, incluyendo O&M, EPC, empresas de ingeniería y usuarios finales
• Disponibilidad para viajes (50% del tiempo)
• Dominio de Microsoft Office (Excel) y Sales Force.
• Manejo de inglés intermedio.
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente.
• Proactivo.
• Motivado, con un historial demostrado de obtención de resultados por encima de los objetivos y las expectativas. What we offer you Beneficios:
• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.
• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.
• Seguro médico y dental. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce an

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Applications Engineer is responsible for evaluating customer requirements and developing technical and commercial proposals for industrial equipment solutions. This role serves as a critical link between customers, sales teams, and internal engineering/manufacturing to ensure accurate, timely, and competitive responses to inquiries. This position operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting distributors, OEMs, EPCs, and end users across a wide range of applications. Applications include Pulp and Paper, Biofuels, Foods, Chemical processing, Mining / Metals, Industrial wastewater, and Auxiliary equipment in other segments as needed. The Applications Group is a dynamic organization with both junior and senior engineers who possess a wide range of experience and competencies. This is a great opportunity to contribute to a growing company and offers great mentorship opportunities to enhance professional development. This role is designed as a foundational position with clear visibility into commercial strategy and customer engagement, offering a defined pathway into Accounts Management and outside sales roles. This role is based out of our Easley, SC office. Key Responsibilities: Proposal & Technical Evaluation
• Review customer RFQs, specifications, and datasheets to determine appropriate product selection
• Perform pumping equipment sizing, selection, and configuration
• Generate detailed quotations including scope, pricing, and lead time Customer & Sales Support
• Serve as a technical resource for internal sales teams and external customers
• Support distribution network with product selection, troubleshooting, and application guidance
• Participate in distributor and customer calls, visits, and training as needed
• Support sales efforts by contributing to technical sales strategy, participating in customer discussions, and developing an understanding of commercial drivers behind winning opportunities Cross-Functional Coordination
• Work closely with the Project Management team to define documentation packages, testing requirements, and customer deliverables early in the quotation phase to ensure accurate scope, compliance, and execution readiness.
• Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain to confirm feasibility, lead times, and cost
• Work with global teams when required to support international or specialized opportunities
• Ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal capabilities Quote and Opportunity Management
• Manage multiple RFQs simultaneously in a high-volume environment
• Maintain accurate records of opportunities, quotes, and communications in Salesforce (CRM system) Continuous Improvement & Team Support
• Identify opportunities to improve quoting efficiency, accuracy, and standardization
• Support development of tools, templates, and documentation
• Assist in training new team members and sharing application knowledge Secondary Responsibilities:
• Perform other duties as assigned. Supervisory Responsibilities:
• None Qualifications:
• Required
• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or related field.
• 0-5 years of related engineering experience (industrial, process, applications, pumps & hydraulics preferred)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines
• Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal)
• Willingness to travel as needed
• Preferred
• Experience with pumps, fluid systems, or rotating equipment
• Exposure to reading specifications and technical drawings
• Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce) and/or ERP systems (SAP)
• Experience working with distributors or in a customer-facing role Key
