descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Project Engineer is responsible for the design and execution of packaged control and power solutions from order kickoff through FAT and turnover. Typical scope includes control system design, MCCs, MV/LV VFDs, RVSSs, PLSs, RTUs, and field instrumentation. This role owns technical coordination, submittals, documentation, schedule/budget tracking for the I&C portion, and factory acceptance testing readiness and execution. The I&C Project Engineer is not responsible for installation, however, is responsible for customer engagement, witnessing FAT testing on location, etc.. Travel Requirements & Working Conditions
• Travel: Up to 25–40% based on project needs (regional and occasional out-of-state).
• Typical travel purposes: Customer/site walks, design coordination meetings, pre-FAT reviews, customer witness FAT, inspections, interface meetings with the GC/EC/customer, troubleshooting, and post-shipment technical support meetings (non-installation).
• Duration: Most trips 1–3 days; occasional trips up to 1 week for major FATs or multi-package projects.
• Schedule flexibility: Ability to travel on short notice at times to support critical project milestones (e.g., customer witness FAT windows).
• Physical demands: Ability to work in shop and industrial environments around large equipment; may require standing/walking for extended periods, and climbing ladders/stairs.
• Site conditions: Exposure to industrial hazards (noise, dust, weather, moving equipment) while adhering to required PPE and site safety rules. Scope of Supply (Typical)
• Control system design (instrumentation and control architecture, integration, and interfaces)
• MCC lineups and associated controls
• Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and controls (as applicable)
• Reduced Voltage Soft Starters (RVSS) and controls (as applicable)
• RTUs / PLC panels (as applicable to contract)
• Field instruments (specified instruments and accessories)
• Switchboards (SWBD) as part of package supply (startup/energization excluded) Associated drawings, submittals, test documentation, owner trainings, and FAT execution Core Responsibilities 1) Control System Design (Primary Technical Ownership) Develop the overall control system approach based on project requirements, including:
• Control architecture (RTU/PLC/remote I/O concepts where applicable)
• Communications and integration philosophy (protocols, network topology, addressing strategy)
• Power and control interface requirements between MCC/VFD/RVSS/RTU and instrumentation Produce and/or review design deliverables as required by the contract and internal standards:
• I/O lists, instrument lists, control narratives/cause & effect (when required)
• Loop diagrams, termination drawings, and interconnects
• Panel drawings (wiring diagrams, layouts, BOMs) and integration details
• Network diagrams and communications mappings (when applicable) Ensure designs are buildable, testable (FAT-ready), and aligned with customer standards and project constraints. Coordinate design reviews and address comments to closure prior to shop release. 2) Project Execution & Coordination (Delivery Ownership)
• Own the I&C/controls portion of project execution: deliverables, schedule, budget awareness, and quality.
• Review contract documents and customer standards; translate requirements into a deliverables list and execution plan.
• Coordinate across internal engineering, integration teams, procurement, QA, and project stakeholders.
• Manage submittal flow: compile, review, and submit vendor data; track comments; close out resubmittals.
• Provide clear status updates; maintain action-item logs, decision records, and interface registers.
• Manage change

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Assembly Finishing Technician to join our manufacturing team. In this role, you will be responsible for the final blending, grinding, and polishing of cast pump impellers. Using a variety of pneumatic (air) hand tools, you will remove excess material, establish precise geometric radii, and achieve specified surface finishes critical to fluid dynamics and pump efficiency. Key Responsibilities
• Precision Grinding: Operate various air-powered grinding tools, die grinders, and polishing equipment to blend and finish internal and external impeller vanes.
• Blueprint & Spec Compliance: Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to ensure all contours, radii, and surface finishes meet strict tolerances.
• Quality Inspection: Use precision measuring instruments (such as radius gauges, calipers, and surface roughness testers) to self-inspect work and ensure quality compliance.
• Defect Removal: Identify and eliminate casting defects, burrs, sharp edges, and parting lines without compromising the structural integrity of the component.
• Equipment Maintenance: Perform routine daily maintenance on pneumatic tools, including oiling, changing out abrasive wheels/burrs, and reporting mechanical issues.
• Safety & Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, organized workstation and strictly adhere to all safety protocols, including the mandatory use of PPE (respirators, hearing protection, and face shields).
• Impeller Balancing : Execute single- and two-plane balancing of impellers to meet specified balance quality grades and customer requirements. Analyze imbalance conditions and apply corrective grinding while maintaining geometric integrity of critical features. Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: 1–3 years of experience in metal finishing, deburring, or precision grinding within a foundry, aerospace, or heavy machinery manufacturing environment.
• Tool Proficiency: Proven expertise using pneumatic die grinders, angle grinders, pencil grinders, and various abrasive media (carbide burrs, flap wheels, scotch-brite pads).
• Technical Literacy: Ability to read blueprints and understand geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) related to radii and surface finishes (e.g., Ra values).
• Dexterity & Detail: High level of manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and a keen eye for visual defects.
• Education: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification in welding, machining, or manufacturing is a plus. Physical Requirements
• Ability to stand, bend, and reach for extended periods (8+ hour shifts).
• Capability to lift and maneuver components weighing up to 50 lbs.
• Strong grip strength and tolerance for prolonged exposure to hand-arm vibrations from pneumatic tools.
• Ability to work comfortably in an environment with ambient noise and airborne dust (protective equipment provided). What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program
• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance
• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting
• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment
• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities
• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.
• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.
• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.
• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).
• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.
• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.
• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.
• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging equipment. Required Qualifications
• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .
• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.
• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.
• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.
• Must supply basic personal hand tools. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.
• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.
• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.
• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components. Competencies
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.
• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Unisciti al nostro team di Sulzer Turbo Services, parte di Sulzer Services, che è uno dei fornitori indipendenti più avanzati al mondo di riparazione, revisione e manutenzione all'interno del settore turbine. Offriamo ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo un supporto solido, orientato al cliente e flessibile per le loro turbine a gas. Unisciti al nostro orgoglioso e altamente qualificato equipaggio internazionale come Field Service Engineer per le turbine a gas industriali pesanti Il ruolo può essere basato in qualsiasi paese europeo con una presenza di Sulzer. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per:
• Monitoraggio o gestione degli aspetti tecnici e della qualità delle revisioni e delle attività di servizio basate sulle specifiche tecniche
• Discutere le riparazioni e i metodi da effettuare con ingegneri e team di assistenza. Definire i fattori critici e stabilire la portata e i rischi
• Fornitura meccanica fuori sito e direzione tecnica e supervisione in loco durante gli eventi di manutenzione (ispezione, revisioni, messa in servizio) di Power Generation Facilities utilizzando turbine a gas prodotte da Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric e MHI
• Fornire meccanica fuori luogo e direzione tecnica in loco e supervisione durante gli eventi di manutenzione (ispezione) di proprietà del cliente Impianti che utilizzano attrezzature rotanti
• Assicurare l'installazione accurata / tiro guai / manutenzione & diagnostica delle turbine a gas industriali pesanti attrezzature rotanti secondo Sulzer Specifiche, istruzioni di ingegneria, disegni e istruzioni di processo
• Gestione delle attività del sito come la pianificazione/integrazione/monitoraggio delle risorse e dell'assistenza tecnica basata sull'ambito di lavoro contrattuale concordato
• Supervise i dipendenti del contratto, la manodopera fornendo indicazioni, istruzioni, monitorare la qualità e il progresso durante le revisioni della turbina a gas
• Il sostegno alle attività di servizio sul campo in un ruolo di back-office
• L'evoluzione dei servizi e dei prodotti relativi alle attrezzature rotanti Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica
• 5 anni di esperienza in attrezzature rotanti, ingegneria e manutenzione di turbine a gas
• Esperienza per comprendere e implementare disegni meccanici (sezione, costruzione, montaggio dwg, P&ID, allineamento specifica, procedura di lavaggio / soffiaggio, specifica di tubazioni, ecc.)
• Molto buone competenze linguistiche in inglese
• Un atteggiamento proattivo, flessibile e problem solving
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di fare un impatto significativo e guidare la strategia globale attraverso la struttura di marketing.
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• Eccitanti opportunità di crescita e di progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione.
• Opportunità significative per i viaggi globali. Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. We provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Gas Turbines. Come join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Field Service Engineer for Heavy Industrial Gas Turbines The role can be based in any European country with a Sulzer presence. In this role you will be accountable for:
• Monitoring or managing the technical aspects and quality of the overhauls and service activities based upon the technical specifications
• Discussing the repairs and methods to be carried out with engineers and field service team. Stating the critical factors and establishing the scope and risks
• Providing mechanical off site and on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections, revisions, commissioning) of customer owned Power Generation Facilities utilizing Gas Turbines manufactured by Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric and MHI
• Provide mechanical off site and on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections) of customer owned Facilities utilizing rotating equipment
• Ensure accurate installation/trouble shooting/maintenance & diagnostics of the rotating equipment heavy industrial gas turbines according to Sulzer Specifications, engineering instructions, drawings & process instructions
• Manage site activities like planning/integration/monitoring of resources and technical assistance based on agreed contractual work scope
• Supervise contract employees, manpower by providing directions, instructions, monitor quality and progress during Gas Turbine overhauls
• The support of field service activities in a back-office role
• The developments on rotating equipment related services and products To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering
• 5 years’ experience in rotating equipment, Gas Turbines engineering and hands-on maintenance
• Experience to understand and implement mechanical drawings (section, construction, assembly dwg, P&ID, alignment specification, flushing/blowing procedure, piping specification, etc.)
• Very good English language skills
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills What we offer you
• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy across the marketing structure.
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.
• Significant opportunities for global travel. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Überwachung oder Verwaltung der technischen Aspekte und Qualität der Überarbeitungs- und Servicetätigkeiten auf der Grundlage der technischen Spezifikationen
• Die mit Ingenieuren und Felddienstteam durchzuführenden Reparaturen und Methoden zu diskutieren. Die kritischen Faktoren zu prägen und Umfang und Risiken zu ermitteln
• Bereitstellung von mechanischem Off-Site und vor Ort technische Leitung und Überwachung bei Wartungsereignissen (Inspektionen, Revisionen, Inbetriebnahme) von kundeneigenen Stromversorgungsanlagen unter Verwendung von Gasturbinen von Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric und MHI

• Vergewissern Sie sich die genaue Installation/Trouble Schießen/Wartung & Diagnostik der rotierenden Ausrüstung schwere Industriegasturbinen nach Sulzer Spezifikationen, technische Anweisungen, Zeichnungen & Prozessanleitung

• Unterstützung von Felddienstaktivitäten in einer Backoffice-Rolle
• Entwicklung von Dienstleistungen und Produkten mit rotierenden Geräten Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
• Bachelor in Maschinenbau
• 5 Jahre Erfahrung in rotierenden Anlagen, Gasturbinen-Engineering und manuelle Wartung
• Erfahrung, mechanische Zeichnungen zu verstehen und zu implementieren (Abschnitt, Konstruktion, Montage dwg, P&ID, Ausrichtungsspezifikation, Spül- / Blasverfahren, Rohrleitungsspezifikation usw.)
• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
• Eine proaktive, flexible und problematische Einstellung
• Ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Was wir Ihnen anbieten
• Chance, einen signifikanten Einfluss zu haben und die globale Strategie in der gesamten Marketingstruktur voranzutreiben.
• Zusammenarbeit und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Schwerpunkt Innovation und Exzellenz.
• Spannende Chancen für professionelles Wachstum und Wachstum in einer dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Industrie.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Rejoignez notre équipe Sulzer Turbo Services, qui fait partie de Sulzer Services, l'un des fournisseurs indépendants les plus avancés au monde en matière de réparation, de révision et d'entretien dans l'industrie des turbines. Nous fournissons à nos clients dans le monde entier un support solide, orienté vers le client et flexible pour leurs turbines à gaz. Venez rejoindre notre équipe internationale fière et hautement qualifiée en tant qu'ingénieur de service sur le terrain pour les turbines à gaz industriels lourds Le rôle peut être basé dans n'importe quel pays européen avec une présence Sulzer. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable :
• Suivi ou gestion des aspects techniques et de la qualité des travaux de révision et des activités de service sur la base des spécifications techniques
• Discuter des réparations et des méthodes à effectuer avec les ingénieurs et l'équipe de service sur le terrain. Indique les facteurs critiques et établit la portée et les risques
• Fourniture d'une direction et d'une supervision techniques mécaniques hors site et sur place lors d'événements de maintenance (inspections, révisions, mise en service) d'installations de production d'électricité appartenant à des clients utilisant des turbines à gaz fabriquées par Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric et MHI
• Fournir une orientation et une supervision techniques mécaniques hors site et sur place pendant les opérations d'entretien (inspections) des installations appartenant à la clientèle utilisant du matériel rotatif
• Assurer une installation / tir / entretien / diagnostic précis de l'équipement rotatif turbines à gaz industrielles lourdes selon les spécifications Sulzer, instructions techniques, dessins et instructions de processus
• Gérer les activités du site telles que la planification, l'intégration et le suivi des ressources et de l'assistance technique sur la base de la portée convenue des travaux contractuels
• Superviser les employés contractuels, la main-d'œuvre en fournissant des directives, des instructions, surveiller la qualité et les progrès lors des révisions de turbine à gaz
• Appui aux activités des services extérieurs dans un rôle d'arrière-garde
• L'évolution des services et produits liés au matériel rotatif Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Licence en génie mécanique
• 5 ans d'expérience dans les équipements rotatifs, l'ingénierie des turbines à gaz et l'entretien pratique
• Expérience de la compréhension et de la mise en oeuvre des dessins mécaniques (section, construction, montage dwg, P&ID, spécification d'alignement, procédure de rinçage/déflage, spécification de tuyauterie, etc.)
• Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais
• Une attitude proactive, flexible et de résolution de problèmes
• Excellentes compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication Ce que nous vous offrons
• La chance d'avoir un impact significatif et d'orienter la stratégie mondiale dans toute la structure de commercialisation.
• Un environnement de travail collaboratif et solidaire mettant l'accent sur l'innovation et l'excellence.
• Possibilités de croissance et d'avancement professionnels dans une industrie dynamique et en évolution.
• Possibilités importantes pour les voyages mondiaux. Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Start your career at Sulzer’s Birmingham HQ Service Centre, the hub of our UK operations and home to world‑class engineering, customer support and service delivery teams. This apprenticeship is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive and eager to learn how a busy technical service centre runs behind the scenes. You’ll gain real administrative experience while supporting the teams that keep major engineering projects moving. Job Responsibilities
• Provide day‑to‑day administrative support to workshop, engineering and management teams.
• Help manage incoming enquiries, emails and phone calls, ensuring they reach the right people promptly.
• Assist with scheduling jobs, creating work orders and updating internal systems.
• Prepare documents, reports and basic spreadsheets to support operational workflows.
• Help maintain accurate records for jobs, parts, orders, and compliance documentation.
• Support purchasing and logistics tasks, such as raising purchase orders and tracking deliveries.
• Assist with reception duties, welcoming visitors and contractors to the service centre.
• Learn to use industry-standard software, internal systems and digital tools.
• Help organise meetings, training sessions and internal events.
• Contribute to continuous improvement by keeping processes and paperwork tidy, accurate and consistent. Job Qualifications
• 5 GCSEs (or equivalent) at grade 4/C or above, including English and Maths.
• Strong communication skills with a professional, confident approach.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
• Highly organised with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritise tasks.
• Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to completing an apprenticeship in administration.
• Eligibility to work in the UK. What we offer you
• Increasing pay throughout the apprenticeship
• Mentoring and support from expert technicians
• Training and development programme
• Work with new technologies and exciting applications
• Sponsored educational opportunities and pathways to higher education
• Opportunity to complete part of your apprenticeship at another site in the UK
• Opportunity to work abroad with customers all over the world
• Potential for a permanent role with Sulzer upon successful completion of the apprenticeship
• Continuous progression within the company
• Apprentice community of over 80 apprentices across the UK
• 33 days holiday, inclusive of bank holidays
• Pension plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Sulzer is seeking an experienced Interim Payroll Implementation Specialist to support the transition of UK payroll operations into a streamlined shared services model using Strada. You will lead the review, standardisation, and implementation of payroll processes across 7 legal entities (c.1300 employees), ensuring a compliant, efficient, and scalable solution. Sulzer is seeking an experienced Interim Payroll Implementation Specialist to support the transition of UK payroll operations into a streamlined shared services model using Strada. You will lead the review, standardisation, and implementation of payroll processes across 7 legal entities (c.1300 employees), ensuring a compliant, efficient, and scalable solution. Key Responsibilities
• Assess current payroll processes, identifying risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities to standardise
• Streamline and align processes to a shared services operating model
• Lead end-to-end payroll implementation (configuration, data migration, parallel runs, and go-live)
• Ensure compliance with UK payroll legislation (HMRC)
• Deliver change management, stakeholder engagement, and training
• Provide post-go-live (“hypercare”) support to ensure stability
• Support governance, controls, and continuous improvement
• About You
• Proven payroll implementation or transformation experience
• Strong multi-entity payroll expertise
• Experience driving process standardisation and improvements
• Knowledge of UK payroll legislation
• Experience with Strada (Workday desirable)
• Strong stakeholder management and project delivery skills
• Qualifications & Experience
• CIPP qualification (or equivalent) OR significant payroll experience Why Join? This is a high-impact role where you will drive excellence and help streamline payroll operations during a key transformation programme. What we offer you Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for driving sales growth and expanding Sulzer’s market presence within the mining sector. The role combines strong technical understanding with commercial execution to position Sulzer as the preferred OEM partner for reliability, performance, and lifecycle value, while actively engaging with end users, EPCMs, consultants, and channel partners, particularly in greenfield and brownfield projects. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Development & Sales Growth
• Identify and secure new business opportunities in mining (open-pit and underground operations)
• Develop and execute strategic account plans for key mining customers
• Meet and exceed sales targets, order intake, and profitability objectives 2. Technical & Solution-Based Selling
• Develop and propose fit-for-purpose pump solutions aligned with customer operational requirements
• Support customers with:
• Equipment selection guidance
• System optimisation recommendations
• Performance improvement initiatives
• Conduct site assessments, condition reviews, and failure analysis support
• Collaborate with internal engineering and service teams to deliver reliable, high-performance solutions 3. Customer Relationship Management
• Build and maintain strong relationships with:
• Mine engineers
• Maintenance and operations teams
• Plant managers
• Procurement departments
• Position Sulzer as a trusted reliability partner , focusing on:
• Plant availability

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center
• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers
• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.
• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.
• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.
• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.
• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields
• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable
• Very good written and verbal communication skills
• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)
• Fluent English skills
• Any other European language is a plus
• Analytical and problema solving skills What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. To visit customers and promote Sulzer spare parts sales To coordinate with Sulzer CSS Industry Sales team and customers and assist to resolve the technical issues and win more parts/product sales. To analyze the installed base volume and find potential companies to appoint as CSS channel partners at those appropriate regions. To monitor, manage and support channel partners to enhance the Sulzer parts sales. To visit customer plants and submit technical and commercial proposals to replace inefficient older pumps for both Sulzer/competitor pumps to maintain sustainable installed base volume. To approach proactively with customers and submit quotes and technical proposals for parts sales and customer system upgrading using Sulzer Sense system. To visit customers and promote Sulzer TB seal sales and win orders. To attend customer complaints at site and resolve the customer complaints To troubleshoot and resolve the technical issues at the customer site To carry out installation supervisions and inspections at customer site and give feedback to the customer about possible To carry out testing and commissioning of the equipment at the customer site To conduct the customer trainings for installation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of the equipment To report to CSS Manager on daily activities and weekly work schedules. Requirements
• Degree or Diploma In Electrical or Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering
• Minimum 3 years working experience in Industry Pumps and various industry process systems would be preferable
• Market/product knowledge in various Industry products application and process would be preferable sales experience would be added an advantage.
• Willing to travel extensively within the country of appointment and other countries as and when required Valid Driving license What we offer you Career Opportunities Medical Benefit Saving Plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. To visit customers and promote Sulzer spare parts sales To coordinate with Sulzer CSS Industry Sales team and customers and assist to resolve the technical issues and win more parts/product sales. To analyze the installed base volume and find potential companies to appoint as CSS channel partners at those appropriate regions. To monitor, manage and support channel partners to enhance the Sulzer parts sales. To visit customer plants and submit technical and commercial proposals to replace inefficient older pumps for both Sulzer/competitor pumps to maintain sustainable installed base volume. To approach proactively with customers and submit quotes and technical proposals for parts sales and customer system upgrading using Sulzer Sense system. To visit customers and promote Sulzer TB seal sales and win orders. To attend customer complaints at site and resolve the customer complaints To troubleshoot and resolve the technical issues at the customer site To carry out installation supervisions and inspections at customer site and give feedback to the customer about possible To carry out testing and commissioning of the equipment at the customer site To conduct the customer trainings for installation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of the equipment To report to CSS Manager on daily activities and weekly work schedules. • Degree or Diploma In Electrical or Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering
• Minimum 3 years working experience in Industry Pumps and various industry process systems would be preferable
• Market/product knowledge in various Industry products application and process would be preferable sales experience would be added an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Elevate la vostra carriera con un'opportunità appena creata a Sulzer, in quanto costruiamo una capacità di business Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) all'interno della nostra divisione Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). PPR si concentra sulla manutenzione e il miglioramento delle attrezzature rotanti critiche in settori come l'energia, l'acqua e la produzione. Operare in un ambiente di mercato dinamico significa che la domanda è meno prevedibile e i progetti spesso comportano l'ingegneria su misura o inversa, rendendo la pianificazione più complessa — e molto più interessante — che in un ambiente di produzione tradizionale. Come Analista commerciale di pianificazione dell'inventario e delle operazioni, vi aiuterà a plasmare questa capacità da zero, guidando il processo decisionale guidato dai dati tra le squadre nel Regno Unito, Europa e Africa. Connetterai più sistemi, migliorando la visibilità e consentendo una pianificazione più allineata e previsionale. Lavorando attraverso Salesforce, SAP, D365 e Qlik Sense, Tagetik e altri sistemi trasformerete i dati complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni che supportano le decisioni operative e strategiche in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Cosa farai
• Analizzare le tendenze della domanda utilizzando i dati CRM, collaborando strettamente con i team Sales, Service e Tendering
• Combina i dati delle prestazioni interne con informazioni sul mercato esterno per informare la pianificazione della domanda
• Valutare i dati sul lato dell'offerta in più entità di produzione, identificare rischi e opportunità
• Progettare e mantenere cruscotti e report che forniscono visibilità attraverso le pipeline di vendita e piani operativi
• Tradurre i dati in metriche e visualizzazioni significative per migliorare la previsione e il monitoraggio delle prestazioni
• Presenti approfondimenti e raccomandazioni nelle recensioni mensili di SiOP, azioni di guida e miglioramento continuo
• Stabilire e migliorare la governance dei dati, la coerenza e le migliori pratiche nei sistemi
• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con Finanza, Operazioni e Vendite – allineare le squadre intorno ad una singola versione della verità Cosa stiamo cercando
• Esperienza comprovata (c.5+ anni) in un ruolo analitico, preferibilmente nell'ingegneria del negozio di lavoro, nell'ambiente di produzione o di servizio (ma non necessario).
• Forte esperienza con gli strumenti BI (Power BI e/o Qlik Sense), con la capacità di costruire cruscotti d'impatto
• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi ERP/CRM (ad esempio SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte modellazione dei dati e capacità di Excel
• Una mentalità curiosa e risolutiva dei problemi con la capacità di individuare le tendenze e sfidare i presupposti
• Confident stakeholder management skills, con esperienza che influenza le funzioni
• Confortevole lavoro in un ambiente veloce e meno strutturato in cui è possibile modellare i processi, non solo seguirli
• Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente attraverso la regione EMEA Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ruolo a casa completamente remoto con viaggi occasionali in tutte le regioni.
• Uno stipendio base competitivo
• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali
• Assicurazione medica privata
• 33 giorni di ferie annuali.
• Contributi pensionistici definiti.
• Accesso a Medicash che ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni, come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.
• Supporto confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping e l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.
• Noleggio auto personale scontato per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.
• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.
• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• In qualità di titolare del premio Bronzo del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e Volontari Cadet Adulti con politiche di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre a una crescente rete militare interna. Zolfo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Elevate your career with a newly created opportunity at Sulzer, as we build out a best-in-class Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) capability within our Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR) division. PPR focuses on servicing and enhancing critical rotating equipment across industries such as energy, water and manufacturing. Operating in a dynamic aftermarket environment means demand is less predictable and projects often involve bespoke or reverse engineering, making planning more complex — and far more interesting — than in a traditional manufacturing setting. As a Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst, you will help shape this capability from the ground up, driving data-led decision making across teams in the UK, Europe and Africa. You will connect multiple systems, improving visibility and enabling more aligned, forward-looking planning. Working across Salesforce, SAP, D365 and Qlik Sense, Tagetik and other systems you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support both operational and strategic decisions in a fast-moving, evolving environment. What You will Be Doing
• Analyse demand trends using CRM data, partnering closely with Sales, Service and Tendering teams
• Combine internal performance data with external market insights to inform demand planning
• Assess supply-side data across multiple manufacturing entities, identifying risks and opportunities
• Design and maintain dashboards and reports that provide visibility across sales pipelines and operational plans
• Translate data into meaningful metrics and visualisations to improve forecasting and performance tracking
• Present insights and recommendations in monthly SiOP reviews, driving actions and continuous improvement
• Establish and improve data governance, consistency and best practices across systems
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Operations and Sales — aligning teams around a single version of the truth What We are Looking For
• Proven experience (c.5+ years) in an analytical role, preferably in job-shop engineering, manufacturing or service environment (but not necessary).
• Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI and/or Qlik Sense), with the ability to build impactful dashboards
• Experience working with ERP/CRM systems (e.g. SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Strong data modelling and Excel capability
• A curious, problem-solving mindset with the ability to spot trends and challenge assumptions
• Confident stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing across functions
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, less structured environment where you can shape processes, not just follow them
• Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region What we offer you
• A fully remote home-based role with occasional travel across regions.
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Private Medical Insurance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Erhöhen Sie Ihre Karriere mit einer neu geschaffenen Gelegenheit bei Sulzer, da wir eine erstklassige Vertriebs-, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP)-Fähigkeit innerhalb unserer Division Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR) aufbauen. PPR konzentriert sich auf die Wartung und Verbesserung kritischer rotierender Geräte in Industrien wie Energie, Wasser und Produktion. Das Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Aftermarket-Umfeld bedeutet, dass die Nachfrage weniger vorhersagbar ist und Projekte oft maßgeschneiderte oder umgekehrte Engineering beinhalten, was die Planung komplexer und viel interessanter macht als in einer traditionellen Fertigungsumgebung. Als Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst helfen Sie, diese Fähigkeit von vornherein zu gestalten und datengesteuerte Entscheidungen über Teams in Großbritannien, Europa und Afrika zu treiben. Sie verbinden mehrere Systeme, verbessern die Sichtbarkeit und ermöglichen eine ausgerichtete, zukunftsgerichtete Planung. Gemeinsam mit Salesforce, SAP, D365 und Qlik Sense, Tagetik und anderen Systemen werden komplexe Daten in klare, handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse umgewandelt, die sowohl operative als auch strategische Entscheidungen in einer schnelllebigen, sich entwickelnden Umgebung unterstützen. Was Sie tun werden
• Analyse der Nachfragetrends mit CRM-Daten, enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebs-, Service- und Ausschreibungsteams
• Kombinieren Sie interne Leistungsdaten mit externen Markteinsichten, um die Nachfrageplanung zu informieren
• Assess liefernde Daten über mehrere Fertigungseinheiten hinweg, Risiken und Chancen identifizieren
• Design und Wartung von Dashboards und Berichten, die eine Sichtbarkeit über Vertriebspipelines und Betriebspläne bieten
• Übersetzen Sie Daten in aussagekräftige Metriken und Visualisierungen, um Prognosen und Performance-Tracking zu verbessern
• Aktuelle Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen in monatlichen SiOP-Bewertungen, Fahraktionen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
• Aufbau und Verbesserung der Daten-Governance, Konsistenz und Best Practices in allen Systemen
• Interoperativ mit Finanzen, Operationen und Vertrieb zusammenarbeiten – Teams rund um eine einzige Version der Wahrheit ausrichten Was wir suchen
• Bewährte Erfahrung (ca. 5+ Jahre) in einer analytischen Rolle, vorzugsweise in der Job-Shop-Engineering, Fertigung oder Service-Umgebung (aber nicht notwendig).
• Starke Erfahrung mit BI-Tools (Power BI und/oder Qlik Sense), mit der Fähigkeit, schlagzähe Dashboards aufzubauen
• Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit ERP/CRM-Systemen (z.B. SAP, D365, Salesforce)

• Eine neugierige, problemlösende Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Trends zu erkennen und Annahmen herauszufordern
• Vertraute Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit Erfahrung Einfluss auf Funktionen
• Bequeme Arbeit in einer schnelllebigen, weniger strukturierten Umgebung, in der Sie Prozesse formen können, nicht nur folgen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Augmentez votre carrière grâce à une opportunité nouvellement créée chez Sulzer, alors que nous développons une capacité de vente, d'inventaire et de planification des opérations (SiOP) au sein de notre division Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). La RPP met l'accent sur l'entretien et l'amélioration des équipements rotatifs essentiels dans les industries comme l'énergie, l'eau et la fabrication. L'exploitation dans un environnement dynamique de marché secondaire signifie que la demande est moins prévisible et que les projets impliquent souvent une ingénierie sur mesure ou inverse, rendant la planification plus complexe — et bien plus intéressante — que dans un contexte de fabrication traditionnel. En tant qu'analyste commercial de l'inventaire des ventes et de la planification des opérations, vous aiderez à façonner cette capacité à partir de la base, en conduisant la prise de décision axée sur les données à travers les équipes au Royaume-Uni, en Europe et en Afrique. Vous connecterez plusieurs systèmes, améliorant la visibilité et permettant une planification plus alignée et tournée vers l'avenir. En travaillant avec Salesforce, SAP, D365 et Qlik Sense, Tagetik et d'autres systèmes, vous transformerez des données complexes en informations claires et exploitables qui soutiennent les décisions opérationnelles et stratégiques dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Ce que vous ferez
• Analyser les tendances de la demande à l'aide de données CRM, en partenariat étroit avec les équipes Ventes, Service et Appel d'offres
• Combiner les données internes sur les performances et les perspectives du marché extérieur pour éclairer la planification de la demande
• Évaluer les données relatives à l'offre dans plusieurs entités manufacturières, en identifiant les risques et les possibilités
• Concevoir et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord et des rapports qui offrent une visibilité sur l'ensemble des pipelines de vente et des plans opérationnels
• Traduire les données en mesures et visualisations significatives pour améliorer les prévisions et le suivi des performances
• Présenter des points de vue et des recommandations dans les examens mensuels des PON, les actions de pilotage et l'amélioration continue
• Établir et améliorer la gouvernance des données, la cohérence et les meilleures pratiques entre les systèmes;
• Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle avec Finance, Opérations et Ventes – aligner les équipes autour d'une seule version de la vérité Ce que nous cherchons
• Expérience éprouvée (c.5+ années) dans un rôle d'analyse, de préférence dans l'ingénierie des ateliers, la fabrication ou l'environnement de service (mais pas nécessaire).
• Forte expérience avec les outils BI (Power BI et / ou Qlik Sense), avec la capacité de construire des tableaux de bord impactés
• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP/CRM (par exemple SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte capacité de modélisation des données et d'Excel
• Un état d'esprit curieux et résolvant les problèmes avec la capacité de repérer les tendances et de contester les hypothèses
• Compétences en gestion des parties prenantes avec une expérience influant sur l'ensemble des fonctions
• Travail confortable dans un environnement rapide et moins structuré où vous pouvez façonner les processus, pas seulement les suivre
• Volonté de voyager occasionnellement dans la région de l'EMEA Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un rôle entièrement isolé à domicile avec des déplacements occasionnels entre les régions.
• Un salaire de base compétitif
• Régime annuel de primes personnelles basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle
• Assurance médicale privée
• 33 jours de congé annuel.
• Cotisations définies.
• L'accès à Medicash vous aide à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Leeds Service Centre. This is a pivotal, leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Leeds service centre brings together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating equipment. Supporting customers across key sectors including power generation, renewables, water, and general industry, the team is focused on reliability, innovation, and delivering strong customer outcomes. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Own the P&L for the Leeds Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.
• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.
• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.
• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.
• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.
• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).
• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.

• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across in an Service / Aftermarket / Industrial Engineering environment

• A track record of driving transformation, growth, or organisational change.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Key Responsibilities
• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center
• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL
• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.
• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.
• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.
• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.
• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations. Skills & Qualifications
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields
• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable
• Very good written and verbal communication skills
• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)
• Fluent English skills
• Analytical and problem-solving skills What we offer you
• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )
• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching
• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition
• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)
• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance
• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving. A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference. We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities
• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes
• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures
• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding
• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers
• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time Job Qualifications
• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)
• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors
• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings
• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Paid overtime opportunities
• Annual companywide bonus
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tendering Manager is responsible for managing a team of professionals in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals. This role ensures the accuracy and competitiveness of tenders and supports the sales process with technical expertise. 1. Deputizing for Regional Sales Director where appropriate 2. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines 3. Mentoring, directing, motivating, supervising, and monitoring the performance of all members of the allocated team 4. Identify and initiate department training on a regular basis 5. Day to day review of enquiries in conjunction with the Regional Sales Director 6. Support, assist and initiate new client contract agreements as and when identified 7. Allocation of enquiries to the tendering resource ensuring optimum use of that resource in all groups. 8. Provide support during the pre-tender process starting from evaluating/assessing tenders, assessing risk factors to arrive at bid decisions, and estimating all the required material, equipment, and manpower needs to be able to arrive at reliable cost estimates for bidding spares, service to turnkey projects. 9. Study, analyze and evaluate tender documents and identify risk factors, ensure that technical terms comply with the relevant standards and coordinates with the Division Heads, and Regional Sales Director for the overall risk assessment and bid decision. 10. Overall responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst meeting SPZA targets 11. Overall responsibility to ensure that tenders for PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE meet company commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the delegation of authority guidelines 12. Overall responsibility together with the Regional Sales Director for maintaining the profit margin on SPZA tenders 13. Proactively engage with procurement to ensure competitive bidding is possible 14. Review and finalize project cost estimates as prepared by the Tendering Engineer in terms of the required material as per bill of quantities (BOQ), amount of work, material/ equipment/ and manpower requirements during the tendering phase; this includes all systems, products and services to client specifications/ requirements. 15. Finalize estimation of all direct and indirect costs and consolidate tender documents for management review and approval. 16. Ensure in conjunction with sales that the Preliminary eTOA and eTOA tool is utilized in line with the eTOA regulation requirements for tenders meeting this criteria 17. Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time 18. Overall responsibility to ensure that Order Entry Documentation is completed in accordance with handover guidelines and procedures and company KPIs. 19. Ensure tender margins are accurate for order entry. 20. Overall responsibility to ensure that the sales team are adequately supported and that projects are launched in a timely and professional manner 21. Ensure that handover meetings with projects are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status 22. Provide all the necessary project clarifications/ information upon project award to the Project Manager as per the project budget; advises the Project Manager on contractual rights, remedies which has been taken into consideration during tendering. 23. Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement. 24. All other duties as relevant to the post. 
• Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required  Relevant experience within related

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Pump Mechanic is responsible for repairing and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities
• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications
• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components
• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report
• Investigating and determining root cause failure
• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM
• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements
• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment
• Performing final testing and inspections Qualifications / Requirements
• Analytical and interpersonal skills
• Attention to detail
• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment
• Minimum five (5) years of pump repair experience
• Ability to work with limited supervision
• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites
• Ability to work overtime What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holiday
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Welds, fabricates and reconditions components and parts to customers, OEM and industry standards using basic oxy-acetylene brazing techniques, shielded metal arc, gas metal arc, gas tungsten arc, submerged arc and other resistance welding operations. Cut materials and components require specification using oxy-acetylene, air arc and plasma equipment. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping, fitting and welding. Job Responsibilities:
• Sets up and operates welding and cutting equipment under limited supervision.
• Works within appropriate weld procedure guidelines to meet customer/contract specifications and apply knowledge of metals and alloys being welded or cut.
• Performs any other work necessary to finish and fit parts to required customer specifications including some pipe fitting/welding.
• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up based upon weld procedures being utilized and work order requirements.
• Maintains a safe, neat and orderly workstation.
• Maintains welding equipment as required to keep machines in good operating condition and maintains welding supplies and consumables in appropriate storage environment per specifications.
• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required.
• Provides information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in process work during or prior to a shift change as required
• Assists other team members as directed, including training and assisting less experienced coworkers.
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide Quality Management effort.
• Performs other duties as assigned.
• Works overtime as requested. Qualifications:
• Minimum of two years’ experience in cutting, welding and fabrication of various metal and alloy components
• Ability to learn and pass various weld certification test (s),
• Ability to read and interpret drawings and blueprints, apply knowledge of weld rods, weld wire, weld equipment settings and basic math skills.
• Possess basic hand tools, basic precision measuring tools and proper safety shoes and attire as specified by a minimum tool requirements list specific to the facility requirements.
• Able to carry out other tasks as diercted by supervisor (In absence of welding assignments).
• High School Diploma
• Must be able to complete pre-employment weld testing for 6G weld certification. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities
• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.
• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.
• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.
• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.
• Support production teams to minimize downtime.
• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.
• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.
• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.
• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.
• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.
• Complete all company-required training programs. Required Qualifications
• High School Diploma or GED required.
• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.
• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.
• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.
• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.
• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and within a team environment. Preferred Skills
• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.
• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.
• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.
• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred. Physical Requirements
• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.
• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment. Work Environment
• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.
• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.
• PPE required at all times. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur du développement de l'excellence opérationnelle mondiale

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sulzer è leader globale nell'ingegneria dei fluidi, con oltre 180 anni di innovazione, operante in oltre 160 sedi in tutto il mondo e generando ricavi annuali superiori a 3,5 miliardi di franchi. All'interno dei nostri Servizi, siamo specializzati nella manutenzione, riparazione, aggiornamento e ottimizzazione di apparecchiature rotanti come pompe, turbine, motori e compressori. Lavoriamo con i clienti nei settori dell'energia, del petrolio e del gas, dei prodotti chimici, dell'acqua e dell'industria per mantenere l'infrastruttura essenziale in esecuzione in modo efficiente, affidabile e sostenibile, riducendo i tempi di fermo, estendendo la vita delle risorse e migliorando le prestazioni in tutto il mondo. Mentre continuiamo a rafforzare le nostre operazioni globali, stiamo ora cercando un Global Operational Excellence Development Manager per aiutare a guidare la trasformazione attraverso la nostra rete di servizi internazionale, incorporando le migliori pratiche, migliorando l'efficienza e migliorando l'esperienza del cliente in scala. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per:
• Condurre e implementare iniziative di eccellenza operativa globale nel nostro business Servizi
• standardizzazione, ottimizzazione e digitalizzazione del processo di trasmissione attraverso catene di valore end-to-end
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza, l'efficienza e la redditività del cliente
• Partner con le parti interessate in tutte le regioni per tradurre la strategia in esecuzione
• Fornire progetti di trasformazione su larga scala in un'organizzazione globale e decentrata
• Metodologie del campione Lean e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo
• Sviluppare quadri, strumenti e governance per sostenere l'eccellenza operativa

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Sulzer est un leader mondial en ingénierie des fluides, avec plus de 180 ans d'innovation, opérant sur plus de 160 sites dans le monde entier et générant des revenus annuels de plus de CHF 3.5 milliards. Au sein de notre entité juridique Services, nous nous spécialisons dans l'entretien, la réparation, la mise à niveau et l'optimisation d'équipements rotatifs tels que pompes, turbines, moteurs et compresseurs. Nous travaillons avec nos clients dans les secteurs de l'énergie, du pétrole et du gaz, des produits chimiques, de l'eau et de l'industrie pour maintenir les infrastructures essentielles en service de façon efficace, fiable et durable, en réduisant les temps d'arrêt, en étendant la durée de vie des actifs et en améliorant les performances dans le monde entier. • Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités pour améliorer l'expérience client, l'efficacité et la rentabilité

• Mettre en place des projets de transformation de moyenne à grande échelle dans une organisation mondiale et décentralisée
• Méthodes Champion Lean et un état d'esprit d'amélioration continue
• Élaborer des cadres, des outils et une gouvernance pour soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle
• Collaborer à travers les ventes, les opérations et la chaîne d'approvisionnement Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Expérience en excellence opérationnelle / amélioration continue / gestion des opérations
• Réalisation de projets éprouvés dans des organisations internationales matricielles
• Forte connaissance de l'optimisation des processus, des principes Lean et de l'amélioration de la chaîne de valeur
• Expérience de la numérisation des processus et de la transformation informatique
• Compréhension des cadres de modélisation des processus opérationnels
• Engagement fort des parties prenantes et influence les compétences
• Connaissance des systèmes ERP (SAP/D365) et CRM

• Expérience professionnelle des services
• Contexte stratégique / conseil en gestion

• Un rôle hybride avec des déplacements occasionnels entre les régions (30 à 40 % de voyages mondiaux)
