Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. ORANGE, TEXAS, USA RESPONSIBILITIES
• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.
• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).
• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.
• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.
• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.
• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.
• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.
• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.
• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed
• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.
• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.
• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.
• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor QUALIFICATIONS
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Basic mechanical aptitude
• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor. PHYSICAL DEMANDS
• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Own complete service lifecycle from requirements through deployment and support

• 5+ years of experience implementing or managing CPQ solutions or specialized engineering selectors.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group IT Team Lead is responsible for supervising a team of IT support professionals and ensuring the delivery of high-quality IT services across the group. This role coordinates day-to-day IT operations and supports the implementation of IT projects. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Lead the Product Configuration & Pricing Technology subdomain as the single point of accountability for Sulzer's Select, Configure, Price, Quote (SCPQ) landscape. You will own the strategic roadmap, platform governance, and end-to-end service delivery for configuration and pricing technologies supporting our global Tendering and Product Management operations. Drive our transformation from fragmented local tools to a unified global SCPQ platform approach Your main tasks and responsibilities: Strategic Roadmap & Platform Governance
• Drive the Sulzer SCPQ strategy in collaboration with Business and Excellence teams
• Define and implement the SCPQ platform consolidation roadmap, moving from fragmented local tools to unified global approach
• Make architecture and customization decisions ensuring global scalability and One Sulzer alignment Business Partnership
• Partner closely with Product Management and Tendering teams to align technology with product roadmaps
• Act as the bridge between engineering requirements and commercial needs
• Translate complex engineering logic and product rules into scalable software solutions Service Ownership
• Own complete service lifecycle from requirements through deployment and support
• Manage and prioritize SCPQ platform backlog based on business value and strategic alignment
• Coordinate with CRM and ERP teams for cohesive end-to-end solution delivery
• Monitor platform performance and continuously improve user experience Team Management
• Lead a team of CPQ specialists and developers in India
• Set priorities, assign work, and ensure team alignment with roadmap objectives
• Plan team capacity and growth based on business and technology needs
• Conduct performance reviews and support career development To succeed in this role, you will need:
• 5+ years of experience implementing or managing CPQ solutions or specialized engineering selectors.
• Deep understanding of complex pricing logic, technical product configuration, and quoting workflows.
• Experience working with engineered-to-order or complex manufacturing environments is highly valued
• Proven track record managing diverse stakeholders across Engineering, Sales, Product Management, and IT
• Strategic mindset to move from fragmented local tools to a global platform approach.
• Strong analytical skills to translate engineering logic into software requirements.
• Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus. What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Product Manager per modellare il futuro di Industrial Water Treatment Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions è un luogo in cui le menti imprenditoriali crescono. Stiamo cercando un Product Manager per Industrial Treatm ent Solutions per modellare le ambizioni di crescita nel trattamento, un talento che è pronto a prendere la proprietà e fare un impatto reale. Stiamo ora cercando un Product Manager proattivo e focalizzato sul cliente per portare le nostre tecnologie globali collaudate in nuovi mercati regionali. In questo ruolo, si possiede l'adattamento e il lancio dei prodotti esistenti in offerte orientate a soluzioni locali. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team globali e regionali, guiderai i trasferimenti tecnologici, localizzerai i prodotti alle esigenze di mercato e di regolamentazione, e garantirai la piena disponibilità commerciale tra vendite, operazioni e supporto alle applicazioni. Definirai la strategia regionale dei prodotti, insieme ai team locali che daranno informazioni sul mercato, coprendo le esigenze dei clienti, la concorrenza, i prezzi e le normative. Da questo, si costruirà una roadmap focalizzata, business case e KPI, regolare i corsi dove necessario. Potrai condurre la soluzione lancia, modellare proposizioni di valore e prezzi, e consentire ai team di vendita attraverso formazione, strumenti e supporto hands-on. Essendo un esperto di applicazioni di prodotto, lavorerai a stretto contatto con i clienti e gli specialisti interni, supportano i piloti e le implementazioni anticipate e trasformano il feedback in miglioramenti continui dei prodotti. Sei un auto-avviamento con forti capacità di comunicazione e una solida comprensione del trattamento delle acque industriali o soluzioni tecniche simili. L'esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nell'ingegneria dei processi, nello sviluppo aziendale o nelle vendite in un'organizzazione internazionale di matrice è altamente apprezzata. Fluency in inglese e la volontà di viaggiare sono necessari. A Sulzer, troverete un ruolo con reale influenza, varie sfide e spazio per crescere.
• Offriamo un ambiente collaborativo che valorizza innovazione, collaborazione e risultati. Questo ruolo si trova vicino a un ufficio di Sulzer in Europa e preferibilmente in Spagna, Italia, Germania o Francia. Per domande, si prega di contattare il responsabile di reclutamento Erik Edvardsson su erik . edvardsson @sulzer.com Si prega di osservare che questo è un processo di reclutamento in corso e che la posizione potrebbe essere riempita prima della data di chiusura dell'annuncio. Cosa ti offriamo TBD Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are seeking for a Product manager to shape the future of Industrial Water Treatment Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions is a place where entrepreneurial minds grow. We are seeking for a Product Manager for Industrial Treatm ent Solutions to shape the growth ambitions in treatment , a talent who is ready to take ownership and make a real impact. We are now seeking a proactive, customer-focused Product Manager to bring our proven global technologies into new regional markets. In this role, you will own the adaptation and launch of existing products into locally relevant, solution ‑ oriented offerings. Working closely with global and regional teams, you will lead technology transfers , localize products to market and regulatory needs, and ensure full commercial readiness across sales, operations, and application support. You will define the regional product strategy , together with local teams who will give the market insight, covering customer needs, competition, pricing, and regulations. From this, you will build a focused roadmap, business case, and KPIs, adjusting courses where needed. You will lead solution launches, shape value propositions and pricing, and enable sales teams through training, tools, and hands-on support. Acting as a product application expert, you will work closely with customers and internal specialists, support pilots and early deployments, and turn feedback into continuous product improvements. You are a self ‑ starter with strong communication skills and a solid understanding of industrial water treatment or similar technical solutions. Experience in product management, process engineering, business development, or sales in an international, matrix organization is highly valued. Fluency in English and willingness to travel are required . At Sulzer, you’ll find a role with real influence, varied challenges, and room to grow. 
• We offer a collaborative environment that values innovation, collaboration , and results . This role is located close to a Sulzer office in Europe and preferably in Spain, Italy, Germany or France. For questions, please contact the recruiting manager Erik Edvardsson on erik . edvardsson @sulzer.com Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement. 
• What we offer you TBD Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen Produktmanager, um die Zukunft der Industrial Water Treatment Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions zu gestalten, ist ein Ort, an dem Unternehmergeist wächst. Wir suchen nach einem Product Manager für Industrial Treatm ent Solutions, um die Wachstumsambitionen in der Behandlung zu formen, einem Talent, das bereit ist, das Eigentum zu nehmen und einen echten Einfluss zu machen. Wir suchen nun einen proaktiven, kundenorientierten Product Manager, um unsere bewährten globalen Technologien in neue regionale Märkte zu bringen. In dieser Rolle besitzen Sie die Anpassung und den Start bestehender Produkte in lokal relevante, lösungsorientierte Angebote. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit globalen und regionalen Teams führen Sie Technologietransfers, lokalisieren Produkte auf Markt- und Regulierungsanforderungen und sorgen für volle kommerzielle Bereitschaft über Vertriebs-, Betriebs- und Anwendungsunterstützung. Sie werden die regionale Produktstrategie definieren, zusammen mit lokalen Teams, die die Markteinsicht geben, die Kundenbedürfnisse, Wettbewerb, Preisgestaltung und Vorschriften abdeckt. Aus diesem Grund werden Sie eine fokussierte Roadmap, Business Case und KPIs bauen, Anpassung Kurse, wo erforderlich. Sie führen Lösungsvorschläge, Formwertvorstellungen und Preisgestaltung und ermöglichen Vertriebsteams durch Schulung, Tools und Hand-on-Unterstützung. Als Produktanwendungsexperte arbeiten Sie eng mit Kunden und internen Spezialisten zusammen, unterstützen Piloten und Früheinsätze und machen Feedback zu kontinuierlichen Produktverbesserungen. Sie sind ein Selbststarter mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einem soliden Verständnis der industriellen Wasseraufbereitung oder ähnlichen technischen Lösungen. Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Verfahrenstechnik, Geschäftsentwicklung oder Vertrieb in einer internationalen Matrixorganisation ist sehr geschätzt. Fluency in Englisch und Reisebereitschaft sind erforderlich. Bei Sulzer finden Sie eine Rolle mit echtem Einfluss, vielfältigen Herausforderungen und Raum zu wachsen.
• Wir bieten ein kollaboratives Umfeld, das Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und Ergebnisse wertet. Diese Rolle befindet sich in der Nähe eines Sulzer Büros in Europa und bevorzugt in Spanien, Italien, Deutschland oder Frankreich. Für Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an den Rekrutierungsmanager Erik Edvardsson auf erik . edvardsson @sulzer.com Beachten Sie bitte, dass dies ein laufender Einstellungsprozess ist und dass die Position vor dem Abschlussdatum der Werbung ausgefüllt werden könnte. Was wir Ihnen anbieten TBD Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind verpflichtet, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld anzubieten. Wir sind stolz, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Nous cherchons un gestionnaire de produit pour façonner l'avenir du traitement industriel de l'eau Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions est un endroit où les esprits entrepreneurials grandissent. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable de produit pour les solutions de traitement industriel pour façonner les ambitions de croissance dans le traitement, un talent qui est prêt à prendre en charge et faire un impact réel. Nous cherchons maintenant un chef de produit proactif et axé sur le client pour mettre nos technologies mondiales éprouvées sur de nouveaux marchés régionaux. Dans ce rôle, vous serez propriétaire de l'adaptation et du lancement de produits existants dans des offres locales adaptées à la solution. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes mondiales et régionales, vous dirigerez les transferts de technologie, localiserez les produits aux besoins du marché et de la réglementation, et assurerez la pleine disponibilité commerciale des ventes, des opérations et du soutien aux applications. Vous définirez la stratégie régionale des produits, ainsi que les équipes locales qui donneront un aperçu du marché, couvrant les besoins des clients, la concurrence, les prix et les règlements. De là, vous élaborerez une feuille de route ciblée, une analyse de rentabilisation et des KPI, en adaptant les cours au besoin. Vous dirigerez les lancements de solutions, façonnerez les propositions de valeur et les prix, et permettreez aux équipes de vente par la formation, les outils et le soutien pratique. En tant qu'expert en application de produits, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients et les spécialistes internes, soutiendra les pilotes et les déploiements précoces, et transformerez les commentaires en améliorations continues du produit. Vous êtes un ‐ débutant avec de solides compétences en communication et une solide compréhension du traitement industriel de l'eau ou des solutions techniques similaires. L'expérience en gestion de produits, en génie des procédés, en développement des affaires ou en vente dans une organisation matricielle internationale est très appréciée. La maîtrise de l'anglais et la volonté de voyager sont nécessaires. Chez Sulzer, vous trouverez un rôle avec une influence réelle, des défis variés, et de la place pour grandir.
• Nous offrons un environnement collaboratif qui valorise l'innovation, la collaboration et les résultats. Ce rôle est situé à proximité d'un bureau de Sulzer en Europe et de préférence en Espagne, Italie, Allemagne ou France. Pour toute question, veuillez contacter le responsable du recrutement Erik Edvardsson sur erik . edvardsson @sulzer.com Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un processus de recrutement continu et que le poste pourrait être comblé avant la date de clôture de l'annonce. Ce que nous vous offrons À déterminer Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Teknisk orderadminstratör Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB, Mölndal Teknisk orderadminstratör Hos oss skapas möjligheter att växa – nu söker vi en teknisk orderadministratör efter att tjänsten blivit ledig genom intern utveckling och karriär. Är du engagerad, noggrann, uppskattar adminstrativa uppgifter och dessutom har tekniskt intresse läs vidare, du kanske är den vi söker? Vi söker ytterligare en medarbetare till vårt orderteam i Mölndal, med fokus på att stötta våra kommun, industri och energi – kunder på den svenska marknaden. Sulzer utvecklar och tillverkar innovativa lösningar av högsta kvalitet och med senaste teknik inom pumpning, omrörning, luftning och service. Med en egen fabrik i Sverige samt tillgång till ett globalt nätverk av fabriker inom Sulzer erbjuder rollen daglig kontakt och ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, både nationellt och globalt. Du blir en del av ett större order- och offertteam bestående av totalt tio personer, varav hälften arbetar med order- och reservdelshantering, där vi nu söker en ny kollega. Tjänsten har ett tekniskt administrativt fokus med daglig kundkontakt och nära dialog med säljorganisationen. Det här kommer du att arbeta med: I rollen arbetar du med att ta emot och hantera förfrågningar på reservdelar, ta fram offerter samt föra dialog med kunder. Du ansvarar för att lägga in reservdels- och produktorder i SAP, vilket inkluderar konfigurering av produkter utifrån tekniska offerter – från enstaka order till större projekt. Arbetet innebär löpande kontakt med våra producerande enheter internationellt avseende bland annat orderstatus och leveranser. Du säkerställer att kunder får korrekt dokumentation, genomför leveransbevakning och hanterar reklamationer på ett strukturerat sätt. Rollen innebär även ett nära samarbete med och stöd till våra kundansvariga utesäljare. Du har daglig kontakt med svenska kunder och svenska liksom engelska - språket är en naturlig del av arbetet. Detta söker vi hos dig Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, noggrann och engagerad lagspelare som trivs i en administrativ roll med många parallella arbetsuppgifter. Du har en god teknisk förståelse och arbetar strukturerat även när tempot är högt. Vi ser gärna att du har: Teknisk utbildning på gymnasie- eller högskolenivå, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet Erfarenhet av administrativt arbete i affärssystem, där SAP är meriterande Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Förmåga att kommunicera professionellt med både kunder och kollegor Placeringsort Mölndal What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Är du engagerad, noggrann, uppskattar adminstrativa uppgifter och dessutom har tekniskt intresse läs vidare, du kanske är den vi söker? Vi söker ytterligare en medarbetare till vårt orderteam i Mölndal, med fokus på att stötta våra kommun, industri och energi – kunder på den svenska marknaden. Sulzer utvecklar och tillverkar innovativa lösningar av högsta kvalitet och med senaste teknik inom pumpning, omrörning, luftning och service. Med en egen fabrik i Sverige samt tillgång till ett globalt nätverk av fabriker inom Sulzer erbjuder rollen daglig kontakt och ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, både nationellt och globalt. Du blir en del av ett större order- och offertteam bestående av totalt tio personer, varav hälften arbetar med order- och reservdelshantering, där vi nu söker en ny kollega. Tjänsten har ett tekniskt administrativt fokus med daglig kundkontakt och nära dialog med säljorganisationen. Det här kommer du att arbeta med: I rollen arbetar du med att ta emot och hantera förfrågningar på reservdelar, ta fram offerter samt föra dialog med kunder. Du ansvarar för att lägga in reservdels- och produktorder i SAP, vilket inkluderar konfigurering av produkter utifrån tekniska offerter – från enstaka order till större projekt. Arbetet innebär löpande kontakt med våra producerande enheter internationellt avseende bland annat orderstatus och leveranser. Du säkerställer att kunder får korrekt dokumentation, genomför leveransbevakning och hanterar reklamationer på ett strukturerat sätt. Rollen innebär även ett nära samarbete med och stöd till våra kundansvariga utesäljare. Du har daglig kontakt med svenska kunder och svenska liksom engelska - språket är en naturlig del av arbetet. Detta söker vi hos dig Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, noggrann och engagerad lagspelare som trivs i en administrativ roll med många parallella arbetsuppgifter. Du har en god teknisk förståelse och arbetar strukturerat även när tempot är högt. Vi ser gärna att du har: Teknisk utbildning på gymnasie- eller högskolenivå, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet Erfarenhet av administrativt arbete i affärssystem, där SAP är meriterande Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Förmåga att kommunicera professionellt med både kunder och kollegor Placeringsort Mölndal What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water Nordic Water avser nu tillsätta en nya tjänst, Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water tjänsten är baserade på vårt centralkontor i Göteborg Sulzer - Nordic Water Products AB, utvecklar, tillverkar och levererar maskiner och utrustning för vatten- och avloppsvattenrening. Vi har många års erfarenhet och är världsledande inom flera av våra specialområden med produkter såsom DynaSand kontinuerliga sandfilter, Johnson lamellseparator, DynaDisc skivfilter, DynaCloth fiberdiscfilter, DynaBelt bandfilter MevaScreen galler- & rensutrustning samt Zickert slamskrapor. Vi erbjuder såväl enskilda maskinkomponenter som integrerade system och lösningar. Vi har centralkontor i Göteborg samt kontor och serviceenheter i Mariestad, Helsingborg och Fjärås (Kungsbacka). Våra produkter säljs över hela världen genom ett nätverk av egna kontor, representanter och återförsäljare. Nordic Water Sverige omsätter ca 600 miljoner SEK och har ca 100 anställda. Vi erbjuder nu en tjänst med stora möjligheter att själv påverka arbetssätt och rutiner, och det lämnar stort utrymme för eget ansvar och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Som process & applikationsspecialist på Nordic Water kommer du att ingå i vårt kommersiella processdesign- team. Tjänsten är en specialist-tjänst inom produktsegmentet VA-process. Avdelningens huvudsakliga uppgifter är att svara för en fördjupad produkt- och process- & applikations kompetens inom produktområdet, och ge såväl kommersiell som produktorienterad support till den globala säljorganisationen. Fördjupad teknisk expertis, framtagning av nya dimensioneringverktyg samt processrelaterad applikationsguider utifrån företagets produkter och system till projekt över hela värden upptar stor del av arbetsuppgifterna i gruppen. Du kommer att arbeta på kontoret i Göteborg, men resor inom Sverige och internationellt kan förekomma. Flera av projekten kan vara mer av karaktären systemleveranser och därmed tekniskt komplexa, därför ser vi gärna att du har en god känsla för teamwork, samarbete och är utåtriktad.
• Projektleda, planera och genomföra strategiska undersökningar som utgör grunden för nya designverktyg för våra befintliga och nya produkter och applikationer.
• Verifiering och testning av dessa prov i fält (nationellt och utomlands)
• Ansvarig för datainsamling, samt bearbetning av stora dataserier slutsatser och presentation i detaljerade professionella rapporter. Ledarskap, affärsdriven problemlösning och utveckling är något som vi ser den sökande finner stort intresse av. För att lyckas i tjänsten ser vi gärna att du har:
• Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, eller högre akademisk utbildning inom kemi eller likvärdig
• Gärna goda VA-kunskaper eller erfarenhet av liknande verksamhet är meriterande
• Teknikintresse och gärna praktisk/teoretisk erfarenhet.
• Initiativrik med kommersiellt sinne för teknisk problemlösning
• Strukturerad och har förmåga att självständigt leda och ta ansvar för och lösa komplexa uppgifter.
• Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift, övriga språk är meriterande.
• Körkort För ytterligare information och ansökan om tjänsten som Senior VA-process & applikations specialist , kontakta Mattias Feldthusen, Director Products +46 704 202156 E-post: mattias.feldthusen@sulzer.com Tjänsten skall tillsättas omgående och vi vill därför ha din ansökan snarast. What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportu

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in the design and manufacture of pumps and associated equipment for some of the world’s most critical industries. Founded in 1834 and headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 13,500 people worldwide, operating in more than 40 countries, generating annual sales of approximately CHF 3.6 billion. Our pumping technologies support customers across the energy, water and wastewater, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, life sciences and food markets, enabling safe, reliable and efficient fluid handling in demanding applications. The Wexford site is a key contributor to Sulzer’s global pumping portfolio, with a strong focus on product development and engineering support for pumps and associated mechanical equipment. The team works closely with international stakeholders, supporting the design and development of products supplied to customers across global markets About the Role & Opportunity We are seeking a Mechanical Design Technician to join our Product Development team in Wexford. This role plays an important part in supporting the design and development of engineered pump solutions and related equipment, working closely with experienced Project Manager's. You will be involved throughout the design lifecycle, contributing to products that are used worldwide in process‑critical environments. This is a development‑focused role within a structured engineering organisation, offering long‑term technical growth and progression opportunities. Key Duties
• Create and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for pumps and associated mechanical equipment
• Produce detailed manufacturing drawings, assemblies and bills of materials
• Support engineering change requests, design updates and product improvements
• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, testing and quality teams
• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, procedures and documentation requirements What We’re Looking For
• A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline
• Experience creating engineering drawings and CAD models within a mechanical or manufacturing environment
• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, components and technical documentation
• A structured, detail‑orientated approach with good communication skills
• Motivation to learn, develop and build a long‑term career within engineering What we offer you
• Competitive base salary
• Annual Leave: Enjoy 26 days of holiday
• Flexibility: Flexible Working Arrangements
• Pension: Benefit from a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme
• On site parking
• Subsidised Canteen on site
• Maternity / Paternity Leave Top Up
• EV Charging on site (At a reduced rate)
• Long Service Award: We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.
• Employee Assistance Programme: Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Sales Director is responsible for overseeing sales operations within a large region or division, ensuring alignment with business goals and driving revenue growth. This role leads sales teams, manages key accounts, and supports strategic planning. This job profile is intended for senior leaders that support the mid to long-term (3-5 years) strategy development for their functional area, and have ownership of the short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy/operational direction. Requires ability to communicate with and influence executive leadership. Typically manage multiple teams. Main accountabilities and tasks (include KPIs and ESH requirements, if available)
• Regular responsibilities
• Realization of sales objectives by developing existing and new customers
• Expected to frequently travel, i.e. visit customers or relations
• Willingness to follow relevant training courses
• Realization of the objective on order intake and Net Sales (Budget Responsibility)
• Making effective commercial decisions (incl price & profit)
• Ensure a correct translation of customer requirements internally, products and solutions
• Realization of a timely and effective follow-up of the pipeline and quotations
• Initiation and participation in effective customer and order team consultation
• Keeping the relevant customer and project information up-to-date in the systems
• Develop and report forecast as required for OI and Sales
• Continuous evaluation of included risks and opportunities of given FC
• Providing monthly feedback/ input on major activities in our market segments, competitor activities, major orders won or lost etc.
• Responsible for growing sales in the region in line with the Sulzer and WTS 2028 priorities. Ability to develop a plan, execute, and follow up. Use structured deployment methods to ensure clearly defined activities and responsibilities.
• To continually check that our agreed strategy is in line with our customers requirements and market conditions focusing on opportunities where we can achieve a clear number one or two position.
• Key responsibilities:
• Market Conditions
• Voice of Customer
• Strategy Deployment
• Growth Solution sales and follow up
• Market Positioning / Value Add
• Develop the sales organization
• Develop skills to solve customer challenges through application expertise and related technologies
• Ensure utilization and data accuracy in SalesForce and CPQ
• Data accuracy is key and needs to be managed including local policies. Job scope (as applicable, skip irrelevant parameters) Growth focus in stronger market positioning and adding value in solution selling and product sales. Cost optimization, qualified sales channels, increased market penetration. Must be self-initiated and active. Capable to manage multiple open issues at the same time. Key internal / external stakeholders : Working in close cooperation with WTS Management, other regional managers, team leaders, outdoor sales, product- and business development. Relationship to customer (end user, OEM, contractors, or consultant) and their representatives (purchasing, process engineers, engineering offices, etc.): Creating, keeping up and developing good co-operation and negotiations of the best solutions for equipment. Ability to close deals with customers with beneficial circumstances to Sulzer. Decision authority (based on DOA matrix , specific for the job): Educational background
• University degree in Engineering or related field / equivalent education preferred, or
• Proven track record in comparable responsibility within comparable market segment
• High professional use of Microsoft products: Excel, Outlook, Word, etc
• Demonstrable experience with

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsibilities
• Support the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget, providing accurate data and analysis
• Assist in refreshing predictive financial forecasts periodically, ensuring accuracy and relevance
• Help in conducting profitability and performance reporting, providing essential data for decision-making
• Contribute to plan analytics and risk management, assisting in the continuous improvement of financial planning and analysis processes
• Conduct in-depth financial analysis to support business recommendations, under the guidance of senior team members
• Support collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information is available for decision-making
• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, aiding informed purchasing decisions
• Help oversee period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful financial reports and analytics
• Assist in period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough financial tracking and reporting for projects
• Help oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting
• Support the adherence to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) in all financial reporting and processes.
• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role
• Comply with relevant QESH regulations Education and experience
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles
• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is a plus Critical success factors
• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software
• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards
• Strong financial acumen
• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership
• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders Technical & language skills
• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus
• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus
• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
• Proficiency in English What we offer you Medical insurance for self and family Company sponsored transportation facility during week days Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This role supports organizations of various sizes and is designed for individuals who enjoy hands‑on technical work, clear documentation, and contributing to high‑quality production and repair processes.
As part of the team, you will be responsible for inspecting, and testing products according to engineering specifications.

A key part of the role involves creating Job Books that guide mechanics on the shop floor, as well as producing 2D assembly forms and repair instructions used during mechanical inspections and repair activities. Once repair work is completed, you will be responsible for digitizing the Job Books to ensure accurate, organized records of all work performed.

Day‑to‑day, you will visually and mechanically inspect finished goods, identify and document any defects, and communicate issues to the appropriate teams. You’ll help maintain production and inspection equipment, follow all safety and quality procedures, and assist with basic troubleshooting or maintenance tasks as needed. Collaboration is important in this role, and you will work closely with team members to meet production goals and support continuous improvement.

To succeed, you should bring strong mechanical and technical aptitude, attention to detail, and comfort reading and following technical instructions or drawings. A high school diploma is required, and 1–2 years of experience working with turbomachinery is preferred. Familiarity with safety, inspection, and quality standards is helpful, along with good communication and teamwork skills. Just as important is a willingness to learn and grow within a manufacturing environment.

Technical proficiency is essential, particularly with AutoCAD and the Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with any 2D or 3D modeling tools—such as Blender, Polyworks, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Maya, or 3ds Max—is also valuable and will support your success in creating clear, accurate documentation.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Managing Projects

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for reviewing plans, technical specifications and drawings to determine JWC product mix recommendation and pricing to be included in proposals. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
· Effectively respond to the requests and requirements of outside sales team and Consulting Engineers to ensure that current and prospective customers are being communicated consistently on all the Company’s product lines.
· Communicates and follows-up with manufacturer’s representative network to provide specifications and technical sales information to influence Consulting Engineers, contractors and end-user customers.
· Reviews technical specifications and customers’ requirements to determine JWC product mix.
· Completes Formal Quotes and Direct Bids as required.
· Works closely with sales managers, Consulting Engineers to quote and provide correct product mix at a profitable price.
· Follows-up with reps and prospective customers on quotation/proposal status.
· Reviews purchase orders and provide feedback to Contract Administration if terms are unclear or if PO is not valid.
· Resolves customer concerns in a timely manner, understands customer’s needs, applications and specifications.
· Works closely with outside sales staff, R&D and Operations in order to prepare timely and accurate proposals.
· Builds relationships to provide repeat business and excellent customer service.
· Perform other duties and special projects as assigned
Education, Experience & Skills:
Required: Associates Degree in a Technical area or 2 years of related experience
Desirable: CSI specification certification
· 1-2+ years with technical sales, Applications Engineering or Sales Engineering in the North American public works industry. Preferably wastewater treatment industry.
· Excellent oral and written communication skills as well as outstanding overall presentation skills.
· Demonstrated ability to perform equipment take-offs from bid packages.
· Demonstrated ability to read and understand construction drawings and specifications including basic knowledge of motor control electrical schematics
· Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases)
· Highly self-motivated.
· Flexible, reliable, strong work ethic, dependable team player, positive, constructive attitude.
· Outstanding business etiquette skills.
· Knowledge of products and technologies including current and potential applications.

Salary: $75K -90K

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Manager serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget . Key Responsibilities:
• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.
• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.
• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.
• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.
• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.
• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.
• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.
• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions. Skills & Qualifications Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).
• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.
• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).
• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time
• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets. Preferred Assets:
• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.
• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.
• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed). What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Manager serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget . Key Responsibilities:
• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.
• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.
• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.
• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.
• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.
• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.
• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.
• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions. Skills & Qualifications Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).
• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.
• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).
• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time
• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets. Preferred Assets:
• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.
• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.
• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed). What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities
• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Er du opptatt av en bærekraftig fremtid og levende fjorder? Vil du lære og utvikle deg hver eneste dag på jobb? Motiveres du av å ha en salgsjobb som bidrar til renere vann og et bedre miljø? Som oss vet du at vann ikke bare er en ressurs – det er selve grunnlaget for alt liv. Og få ting gir større mening enn å jobbe med løsninger som sikrer at vannet renses, transporteres og forvaltes på best mulig måte. Du ikke bare forstår prosessene – du elsker dem. Enten det handler om flotasjon, mekanisk filtrering eller biologisk rensing, så er du hjemme. Du har gjerne vært tett på anlegg og prosesser tidligere i karrieren, og du vet hva som faktisk fungerer i praksis – ikke bare på papiret. Men du er ikke bare teknisk dyktig. Du er en relasjonsbygger som kundene raskt får tillit til, og du stiller alltid opp når de trenger deg. Salg gir deg energi – ikke fordi du selger, men fordi du løser problemer og skaper verdi for kunder som stoler på din faglige tyngde. Du trives i møte med mennesker, og du har et engasjement som smitter når du presenterer eller holder foredrag. Du er god på å legge planer, liker å kombinere selvstendighet med samarbeid, og mestrer digitale verktøy som en naturlig del av hverdagen. En hverdag som innebærer noe reising for å besøke kunder – nye som gamle – er noe du setter pris på. Høres dette ut som deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg. Oppsummert håper vi at du er:
• En som har erfaring med B2B-salg og som blir motivert av lykkelig kunder
• Opptatt av å bygge tillit og være tilgjengelig for kundene
• Fleksibel og liker å styre hverdagen din selv
• Selvstendig og reiseglad
• Smart, engasjert og god på å løse problemer
• Strukturert og tydelig i kommunikasjonsformen – norsk er arbeidsspråket Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg? Hos Sulzer tror vi på kontinuerlig læring og mulighetene det skaper for fremtiden din. Vi jobber i team for å komme frem til de beste løsningene for våre kunder, og du vil ha ingeniører og fageksperter i ryggen som hjelper deg der det trengs. I Norge har Sulzer kontorer og verksteder i Asker, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Trondheim. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi tilbyr fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og legger til rette for bruk av hjemmekontor. Du får firmabil, og det er ønskelig at du velger en miljøvennlig bil, på den måten bidrar du til å gjøre bedriften mer bærekraftig. Denne stillingen er svært sentral for selskapet vårt, så er vi mest opptatt av å finne det riktige mennesket, som vil trives og ønsker å vokse sammen med oss. Nøyaktig hvor du bor, er ikke så viktig. Søknadsfristen er søndag 14. juni , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende! What we offer you Vi har svært gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi tilbyr fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og legger til rette for bruk av hjemmekontor. Det er tilgang til treningsrom i Fredrikstad og Asker. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo L'Application & Tendering Engineer è responsabile dello sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche e commerciali per impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue municipali e industriali, supportando la preparazione di offerte e gare d'appalto. Il ruolo combina la comprensione dei processi, l'ingegneria delle applicazioni e le attività di gara, con una forte attenzione alla selezione, progettazione e integrazione delle tecnologie di trattamento in base ai requisiti del cliente, ai vincoli di progetto e agli standard applicabili. L'ingegnere funge da interfaccia tecnica tra le vendite, l'ingegneria e le parti interessate esterne, contribuendo alla definizione della soluzione dalla fase iniziale della gara fino alla consegna del progetto. RESPONSABILITÀ CHIAVE: Sviluppo di gare d'appalto e proposte

• Allineare le soluzioni tecniche agli standard e alle specifiche internazionali (ad esempio EN, ISO, standard locali, requisiti specifici del progetto). Supporto post-offerta e consegna del progetto

• Contribuire alla revisione del contratto dal punto di vista tecnico e dell'ambito della fornitura.
• Garantire una consegna strutturata dei progetti aggiudicati al team di esecuzione, inclusa tutta la documentazione tecnica, commerciale e di processo. Condivisione organizzativa e delle conoscenze
• Supportare e guidare gli ingegneri junior che si occupano di candidature o gare d'appalto.
• Contribuire alla standardizzazione di soluzioni tecniche, strumenti e modelli.
• Condividere il know-how sulle tecnologie e sulle applicazioni per il trattamento delle acque reflue all'interno dell'organizzazione. REQUISITI Qualifiche ed esperienza
• Laurea triennale o magistrale in ingegneria ambientale, chimica, meccanica o civile (con chiara esposizione al trattamento delle acque/acque reflue).
• 4–7 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria applicativa, nelle gare d'appalto o nelle vendite tecniche nel settore del trattamento delle acque e delle acque reflue.
• Comprovata esperienza con processi di trattamento delle acque reflue municipali e/o industriali.
• Conoscenza approfondita delle tecnologie di trattamento, della disposizione degli impianti e delle interfacce di processo.
• L'esperienza in gare d'appalto per progetti EPC o del settore pubblico costituisce un forte vantaggio. Competenze tecniche e professionali

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Application & Tendering Engineer is responsible for developing technical and commercial solutions for municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, supporting the preparation of competitive bids and tenders. The role combines process understanding, application engineering, and tendering activities, with a strong focus on selecting, designing, and integrating treatment technologies based on customer requirements, project constraints, and applicable standards. The engineer acts as a technical interface between Sales, Engineering, and external stakeholders, contributing to solution definition from early tender stage through project handover. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Tendering & Proposal Development
• Analyze RFQs, tender documents, and technical specifications related to wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) , both civil and industrial .
• Develop complete technical and commercial proposals , ensuring compliance with process requirements, client expectations, and internal guidelines.
• Coordinate with internal departments (process engineering, mechanical engineering, procurement, finance, projects) to collect inputs for bids.
• Perform cost estimation, material take-offs, and preparation of BOQs for water and wastewater treatment solutions.
• Ensure timely and accurate submission of tenders and clarification responses. Application Engineering & Process Support
• Provide pre-sales technical and process support to Sales and customers.
• Define and recommend process solutions and equipment for:
• Preliminary and primary treatment
• Secondary (biological) treatment
• Tertiary and polishing steps
• Sludge treatment and handling (where applicable)
• Size and configure treatment units and packages (e.g. screens, grit removal, clarification, filtration, sludge equipment).
• Prepare process descriptions, technical datasheets, layouts, and technical clarifications .
• Support and participate in technical meetings, workshops, and presentations with customers, consultants, EPC contractors, and authorities. Client, Consultant & Vendor Interface
• Liaise with clients, consultants, technology partners, and EPC contractors to clarify process and technical aspects during the tender phase.
• Interface with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain quotations, technical data, and delivery information.
• Align technical solutions with international standards and specifications (e.g. EN, ISO, local standards, project-specific requirements). Post‑Bid Support & Project Handover
• Follow up on submitted tenders and support post‑bid technical clarifications and negotiations .
• Contribute to contract review from a technical and scope-of-supply perspective .
• Ensure a structured handover of awarded projects to the execution team, including all technical, commercial, and process documentation. Organizational & Knowledge Sharing
• Support and mentor junior application or tendering engineers .
• Contribute to standardization of technical solutions, tools, and templates .
• Share know‑how on wastewater treatment technologies and applications within the organization. REQUIREMENTS Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering (with clear exposure to water/wastewater treatment).
• 4–7 years of experience in application engineering, tendering, or technical sales within the water and wastewater treatment sector .
• Proven experience with municipal and/or industrial wastewater treatment processes .
• Strong understanding of treatment technologies, plant layouts, and process interfaces .
• Experience in tenders for EPC or public sector projects is a strong advantage. Technical & Professional Skills

• MS Office competente, incluso. Excel e PowerPoint

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Jr. Controller is responsible for supporting the finance team in day-to-day accounting operations, including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. Integral leader in finance & controlling activities, with heavy business partnering ability and will routinely interface with Operations and Sales teams to help monitor, push, forecast and challenge day-to-day operations that influence Revenue, Working Capital, Forecasting. Responsibilities
• Support LE Finance Head to monitor and control and report business performance
• Understands operations and can translate and anticipate financial outcomes
• Familiar with Over Time and Point in Time revenue recognition methods
• Analyses and closes deviations between Actual, RFC and budget including analytical review of the monthly operating results to ensure accurate accounting records are maintained
• Identifies areas for cost process improvement initiatives
• Assesses financial contracts from a cost and risk perspective
• Ensures adherence to cost calculation standards in pre-calculations
• Support LE Finance Head to establish meaningful KPIs and manages tracking and monitoring process
• Supports Balance Sheet review process, including Fixed Asset, WIP and inventory analysis, leading cycle counting
• Plays an integral part in both internal and external audit preparedness and support Qualifications: The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :
• Proficient MS Office, incl. Excel and PowerPoint
• Excellent understanding of integrated ERP, preferably D365
• 5+ years of experience in Controlling
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Business administration What we offer you
• 11 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
